title: IT Engineer 3
description:
The group you’ll be a part of

The Global Information Syetems (GIS) is the organization responsible for delivering and supporting enterprise technology solutions that enable Lam Research's global business operations. The team provides end-to-end IT services, including network infrastructure, end-user support, unified communications, business applications, cybersecurity, cloud services, and digital transformation initiatives. GIS partners closely with business functions and global teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology solutions that support business growth, operational excellence, and employee productivity across all Lam Research locations.

The impact you’ll make

Join Lam as an IT Engineer, where you'll be at the forefront of designing, analyzing, and implementing applications and systems that form the foundation of our infrastructure. As a crucial member of our IT team, you'll contribute your technical assistance and guidance to projects for various systems and infrastructures. Acting as a technical liaison, you'll address complex business problems with automated systems solutions. Your expertise will be instrumental in driving Lam's commitment to innovation and efficiency.

What you’ll do

1. Network Operations & Support

• Plan and coordinate network installation and upgrade schedules for offices (including weekend or holiday work to minimize business impact)

• Lead switch replacement and standard network deployment activities across Taiwan sites

• Coordinate with local vendors for network equipment migration and on-site implementation

• Manage network equipment delivery timeline (switches, WAPs) and ensure readiness for deployment

• Oversee installation of standard network components (e.g., Cisco WAP, switching infrastructure)

• Ensure minimal service disruption during network migration (e.g., using secondary circuits, scheduling off-hours work)

• Support temporary-to-standard network transition for new or temporary operational offices

• Coordinate with firewall/network teams for testing and validation after deployment

2. Unified Communications (UC) Support

• Deploy, configure, and support enterprise UC solutions including Microsoft Teams (Phone System, Rooms), Enterprise telephony (SBC, gateways, analog phones), Video conferencing & AV systems

• Support new office setups (HQ / expansion sites) for UC deployment

• Handle incident troubleshooting (voice, video, messaging issues)

• Provide L2/L3 support for UC-related tickets and service requests

• Ensure system uptime and performance

• Collaborate with global UC teams for incident resolution and project execution

• Coordinate with vendors for UC equipment procurement and installation

3. Server & Infrastructure Management

• Manage and maintain physical and virtual server environments.

• Perform server provisioning, patch management, upgrades, and performance optimization.

• Ensure system availability and data protection through backup and disaster recovery processes.

• Support data center infrastructure, hardware deployment, and rack-and-stack operations.

• Monitor infrastructure performance and proactively resolve system issues to maintain operational stability.

4. Project & Deployment Support

• Participate in infrastructure deployment projects, including new site implementations, office expansions, and technology refresh initiatives.

• Support IT infrastructure components for facility buildouts, including network, unified communications (UC), and server infrastructure deployment.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Security, Cloud, Workplace Services, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge transfer materials to support service readiness and ongoing operations.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Preferred qualifications

Technical Skills

• Solid understanding of networking technologies and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, and VPN.

• Experience with Unified Communications (UC) solutions, such as Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR), VoIP platforms, and conferencing technologies.

• Hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 and Windows server environments, including virtualization platforms.

• Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms, such as ServiceNow, and infrastructure monitoring tools.

Soft Skills

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities with a proactive approach to problem resolution.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

• Capable of working across global teams and supporting business operations across multiple time zones.

• Fluent in both English and Mandarin, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.

description:
Job Summary

The Sr. Associate Regional Health & Safety Specialist position coordinates the execution of activities regarding the deployment and ongoing coordination of the Occupational Health Safety prevention program, ensuring compliance with various legislations as well as the best practices of the industry within the Quebec and Atlantic Region. He/she supports the corporate Senior Health & Safety Specialist, making sure the regional strategy is aligned with the National Health and Safety program. This role will be based in Montréal area.

Section A – Main Responsibilities

·Implements and oversees McKesson Canada’s Occupational Health & Safety prevention program across the Distribution Centres in the Region and coordinate the implementation of the associated activities with each DC H&S lead;

·Ensures implementation and compliance of McKesson Canada Health & Safety policies and procedures through DC H&S Leads, business unit and facility managers;

·Partners with DC H&S Leads, other business area management such as security, human resources, risk management, operations to ensure that all are addressed appropriately;

·Promotes an occupational Health & Safety culture and provide senior technical expertise and consultation to management and DC H&S Leads on Health & Safety prevention issues;

·Participates in investigations, follow-ups and root-cause analysis of significant safety incidents;

·Develops and maintain good relationships with prevention safety agencies and respond to agency inquiries and inspections as required;

·When required, develop external supplier agreements in order to standardize OHS related purchases (personal protection equipment and first-aid supplies) in response to internal client needs;

·Coordinates and lead periodic audits, evaluations and inspections to identify unsafe conditions and practices, follow up to ensure deficiencies are corrected within designated time frames, within the region;

·Identify, monitor market trends, both internal and external, and provide recommendation;

·Assess, develop and coordinate required training for all stakeholders for Health & Safety programs;

·Presence in every distribution center will be important, travelling is required for this role;

·Use statistical reporting tools, provided by the Global Security team, to identify trends and issues requiring attention in order to improve wellness and safety programs.

Section B – Qualifications

·Ability to influence others with a high level in his/ her communication

·Strong communication skills

·Ability to listen and show great teamwork behaviors

·Ability to coach and train leaders, front line employees

·Expertise in Microsoft Office with emphasis on PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Word, Team, One Note

·Experience in a supervisor role, an asset

·3 to 5 years’ experience in a similar position

·Has worked with Leading and Lagging KPI’s related to health and safety. Has to show rigor in the management of those KPI’s

·Master degree with a specialty in health and safety, an asset

·Minimum, collegial degree

·Bilingual proficiency (English and French spoken and written)

·Knowledge of Health Canada’s GMP Regulations, an asset

·Action-oriented, detail-oriented individual with high accountability and solid judgement

·Demonstrates flexibility and adaptability to changing business conditions and priorities.

The incumbent of this position will provide daily support to internal and/or external clients outside Quebec and/or in the United States. Therefore, he/she must be proficient in spoken and written English. Please note that the number of positions requiring English language skills has been limited where possible.

CLS(Coupang Logistics Services)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. CLS는 국토교통부로 지정 받은 택배운송사업자로서 전국단위의 배송캠프에서 업계 최초로 도입한 분류작업전담인력과 직영 전문 배송직 쿠팡친구, 그리고 전국 단위 택배 영업점을 통해 고객에게 최적의 배송서비스를 제공하면서 쿠팡의 로켓배송을 완결하는 역할을 담당하고 있습니다. 로켓배송을 통해 미래 물류의 혁신을 이끌어 온 종합물류서비스 기업으로서 CLS는 로켓배송의 노하우, 인프라, 네트워크 등을 연계하여 물류 혁신을 통한 더 나은 고객감동을 만들어 나갈 것입니다.

직무 소개

CLS OPEX Process Innovation 팀은 한국 퀵커머스 사업 및 대만 사업의 물류 네트워크 확장을 지원하며, 데이터 기반의 의사결정을 통해 운영 효율성 및 고객 경험 개선을 주도합니다.
본 포지션은 신규 FC 런칭, 네트워크 확장, 주문 처리 운영 등 다양한 물류 프로세스 전반에 대한 데이터를 분석하고, 핵심 성과지표(KPI)를 설계하며, 운영 개선 기회를 발굴하는 역할을 수행합니다.
또한 Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Python 기반의 분석 및 자동화 솔루션을 구축하여 물류 운영 조직, 프로그램 매니지먼트 조직 및 리더십의 의사결정을 지원합니다.

업무 내용

1. 물류 운영 및 네트워크 분석
  • 한국 퀵커머스 및 대만 물류 네트워크 운영 데이터를 분석하여 운영 효율화 기회 발굴
  • 신규 FC 런칭 및 네트워크 확장 프로젝트에 대한 데이터 기반 의사결정 지원
  • 주문량, 처리량, 배송 리드타임, 생산성 등 핵심 운영 지표 분석
  • 운영 정책 및 프로세스 개선을 위한 Root Cause Analysis 수행
2. KPI 및 성과관리 체계 구축
  • 비즈니스 목표와 연계된 KPI 및 운영 지표 설계
  • 운영 현황을 실시간으로 모니터링할 수 있는 관리 체계 구축
  • 운영 성과 측정 및 개선 효과 분석
3. 데이터 분석 및 자동화
  • SQL, Python을 활용한 데이터 추출·가공·분석 수행
  • 반복적인 리포팅 및 분석 프로세스 자동화
  • Workflow 도구를 활용한 데이터 파이프라인 구축 및 운영
  • 데이터 품질 관리 및 분석 환경 개선
4. BI 및 리포팅 환경 구축
  • Tableau 또는 Power BI 기반의 대시보드 개발 및 운영
  • 운영 조직 및 경영진을 위한 핵심 지표 시각화
  • Self-Service Analytics 환경 구축 지원
5. Cross-functional 프로젝트 수행
  • Operations, Product, Program Management, Finance 등 다양한 조직과 협업
  • 분석 결과를 기반으로 실행 가능한 개선안을 도출하고 프로젝트 추진
  • 비용 절감, 생산성 향상, 고객 경험 개선 등 비즈니스 성과 창출

자격 요건

  • 데이터 분석 또는 이에 준하는 업무 경험을 7년 이상 보유하신 분
  • 복잡하고 모호한 비즈니스 문제를 데이터 기반의 분석 과제로 구조화하고, 해결 방향을 독립적으로 수립할 수 있는 분
  • 복잡한 SQL을 활용하여 대용량 데이터를 직접 분석하고, 데이터 모델 또는 재사용 가능한 분석 로직을 설계한 경험이 있는 분
  • Python을 활용하여 데이터 처리, 분석, 자동화 또는 업무용 애플리케이션을 직접 개발하고 운영한 경험이 있는 분
  • Airflow 또는 유사한 Workflow Orchestration 도구를 활용하여 데이터 파이프라인을 직접 설계, 구현 및 운영한 경험이 있는 분
  • 단순 리포트 생성이 아닌, 반복 업무와 의사결정 프로세스를 자동화하여 생산성이나 품질을 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • AI Coding Tool 또는 AI Agent를 실제 업무에 적용하여 코드 작성, 분석, 검증, 테스트, 문서화 또는 자동화 프로세스를 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • 자신이 수행한 분석 또는 자동화 프로젝트를 실제 비즈니스 실행으로 연결하고, 매출 증대, 비용 절감, 운영 효율화 또는 고객 경험 개선 등의 성과를 만들어 낸 경험이 있는 분
  • 비즈니스 도메인과 운영 프로세스를 빠르게 이해하고, 데이터에서 발견된 현상을 비즈니스 맥락에 맞게 해석할 수 있는 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자의 요구사항과 관점을 조율하고, 복잡한 내용을 대상에 맞게 명확하고 설득력 있게 전달할 수 있는 분
  • 개별 분석 과제를 넘어 조직의 목표와 전체 프로세스를 이해하고, 우선순위와 중장기 방향을 제안할 수 있는 분
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 과제의 영향도, 긴급도 및 실행 가능성을 판단하여 주도적으로 업무를 추진할 수 있는 분

우대 조건

  • 이커머스, 물류, 플랫폼 또는 대규모 인터넷 서비스 업계 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 마트 또는 분석용 데이터 모델을 설계하고 운영한 경험이 있는 분
  • 대규모 데이터 환경에서 SQL 성능 최적화, 데이터 품질 관리 또는 파이프라인 모니터링 경험이 있는 분
  • AI Agent를 활용한 End-to-End 분석 또는 개발 Workflow를 설계한 경험이 있는 분
  • 제품, 운영, 재무, 엔지니어링, 프로그램 관리 조직 등 다양한 팀과 협업하여 조직 단위의 개선 과제를 추진한 경험이 있는 분
  • 분석 결과를 경영진 의사결정, 사업 전략 또는 운영 정책에 반영한 경험이 있는 분
  • 새로운 분석 방법론, 기술 또는 도구를 조직에 도입하고 확산시킨 경험이 있는 분


전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangls.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Azure Devops Engineer - Immediate Joiners
description:
Azure DevOps Linux L2 Engineer

Experience: 5 to 6 Years

Location; Chennai

Employment Type: Full Time


Role Overview


We are seeking a skilled Azure DevOps Linux L2 Engineer to support and maintain cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, and Linux-based environments. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Azure administration, Linux server management, CI/CD pipeline support, automation, monitoring, and troubleshooting production environments.

Key Responsibilities

Azure Cloud Support

  • Provide L2 support for Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Manage Azure Virtual Machines, Storage Accounts, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancers, and Backup services.
  • Monitor Azure resources using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis.

Linux Administration

  • Administer and support Linux servers (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu).
  • Perform user management, patching, package management, performance tuning, and server hardening.
  • Troubleshoot OS, filesystem, networking, and application-related issues.
  • Manage system logs and service availability.

DevOps & CI/CD Support

  • Support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Manage Azure Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts, and Release Management.
  • Collaborate with development teams for code deployments and release activities.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline failures and deployment issues.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

  • Develop and maintain scripts using Bash or PowerShell.
  • Support Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
  • Automate routine operational tasks and deployments.

Monitoring & Incident Management

  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, and pipelines.
  • Handle incidents, service requests, changes, and problem management activities.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and timely resolution of production issues.
  • Work with L3 teams for escalations and complex troubleshooting.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain SOPs, runbooks, and technical documentation.
  • Participate in change management and release governance processes.
  • Contribute to knowledge management and operational improvements.

Required Skills

Must Have

  • Azure Administration
  • Azure DevOps
  • Linux Administration (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu)
  • CI/CD Pipeline Support
  • Azure Repos & Pipelines
  • Bash/Shell Scripting
  • Incident & Change Management
  • Azure Monitoring & Logging

Good to Have

  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Git
  • PowerShell
  • ServiceNow
  • Azure Backup & Recovery
  • Azure Security & IAM

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  • Terraform Associate Certification

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor‘s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

Key Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting skills
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Ability to work in rotational shifts and production support environments

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We zijn op zoek naar een DevOPS Engineer die ons team in Spijkenisse komt versterken!

Als DevOPS Engineer werk je samen in een ervaren en hecht team. Samen met jouw collega's werk je aan het Pay. platform waar continu nieuwe zaken aan worden toegevoegd en waar aan de hand van functionele eisen ontwerpen worden gemaakt. Vervolgens pas je met deze eisen en ontwerpen configuratie management toe. Naast deze werkzaamheden is het ontwikkelen van nieuwe systemen en het aandragen van technische oplossingen dé uitdaging die jij zoekt. Hierbij houd je altijd rekening met de beveiliging en performance van de techniek.

De waarde die jij toevoegt

  • Afgeronde HBO opleiding;
  • 5 (of meer) jaar ervaring met DevOPS werkzaamheden;
  • Ervaring met Ubuntu/Debian servers;
  • Ervaring met Saltstack;
  • Ervaring met Docker;

title: Associate Consultant – Legal & Public Sector
description:
Strategic Advisory • Research • Analysis • Project Support

Location: Canada / Global
Work Model: Remote / Hybrid with Client-Site Assignments as Required
Engagement: Independent Contractor / Project-Based

The Role

Matrix is seeking Associate Consultants – Legal & Public Sector to join our professional contractor network and support client engagements across legal, public-sector and institutional environments.

This role is suited to professionals who bring strong research, analytical, organizational, writing and project-support capabilities and who can contribute meaningfully to consulting assignments under the direction of a Senior Advisor, Project Lead or other authorized Matrix professional.

Associate Consultants may be assigned to a variety of projects involving organizational research, process analysis, benchmarking, documentation, project coordination, stakeholder support, data analysis and preparation of client deliverables.

Assignments may vary considerably depending on the client's requirements and the consultant's qualifications and experience.

While assignments are primarily remote, contractors may be required to attend client locations for meetings, workshops, interviews, project activities, stakeholder engagement or other approved project requirements.

This is not an employment or trainee position. Contractors are engaged on a project basis and are expected to manage their assigned work independently, using their professional judgment and preferred methods while meeting the requirements and deliverables established in the applicable Work Order.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Analysis

  • Conduct research relevant to assigned client projects.
  • Gather, organize and analyze information from appropriate sources.
  • Conduct benchmarking and comparative research.
  • Identify trends, issues, opportunities and relevant findings.
  • Assist Senior Advisors in developing evidence-based recommendations.
  • Prepare research summaries, briefing materials and analytical notes.

Business & Organizational Analysis

Depending on the assignment:

  • Map organizational processes and workflows.
  • Document current-state and proposed processes.
  • Identify administrative or operational inefficiencies.
  • Assist with organizational and functional analysis.
  • Review procedures, documentation and operational practices.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement.
  • Support development of practical implementation recommendations.

Client Deliverables

Assist with the preparation of:

  • reports;
  • briefing notes;
  • presentations;
  • research summaries;
  • process maps;
  • data summaries;
  • project documentation;
  • meeting materials;
  • recommendations; and
  • other client deliverables.

Contractors are expected to ensure their assigned work is accurate, organized, professionally presented and completed within the agreed project parameters.

Project Support

  • Assist with project planning and coordination.
  • Track assigned activities, deliverables and timelines.
  • Maintain project documentation.
  • Support meeting preparation and follow-up.
  • Coordinate information required from project stakeholders.
  • Assist with status reporting and project updates.
  • Identify issues or delays requiring escalation to the project lead.

Stakeholder & Client Support

  • Participate in authorized client meetings and project discussions.
  • Communicate professionally with client representatives and project stakeholders.
  • Prepare agendas, notes and follow-up materials where assigned.
  • Assist with information gathering and stakeholder interviews where appropriate.
  • Maintain confidentiality and discretion when handling client information.

Legal & Public-Sector Project Support

Depending on qualifications and the specific Work Order, assignments may involve projects relating to:

  • law firm operations;
  • legal administrative systems;
  • public-sector operations;
  • government services;
  • institutional governance;
  • regulatory environments;
  • organizational effectiveness;
  • administrative processes;
  • policy-related research;
  • service delivery;
  • technology implementation; or
  • other areas within the consultant's authorized expertise.

This role provides consulting and administrative project support only. It does not involve providing legal advice, legal representation, legal opinions or other regulated professional advice.

Ideal Profile

We welcome applications from professionals with approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience, including experience in:

  • consulting;
  • professional services;
  • legal administration;
  • government or public-sector environments;
  • business analysis;
  • research;
  • project coordination;
  • policy or program support;
  • operations;
  • administration; or
  • related fields.

Equivalent education and practical experience will be considered.

The successful contractor should demonstrate:

  • strong analytical and critical-thinking skills;
  • excellent written communication;
  • strong research and information-management skills;
  • ability to organize and synthesize complex information;
  • strong attention to detail;
  • ability to prepare professional client materials;
  • sound judgment and problem-solving ability;
  • ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities;
  • professionalism when dealing with clients and stakeholders;
  • discretion when handling confidential information; and
  • ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Education & Professional Background

A degree, diploma or professional training in a relevant discipline is an asset, including:

  • business;
  • public administration;
  • political science;
  • law or legal studies;
  • economics;
  • communications;
  • project management;
  • organizational studies;
  • information management; or
  • another related field.

Candidates with strong practical experience and transferable skills are encouraged to apply.

Technology & Collaboration

Contractors should be comfortable working with common business and collaboration technologies, including:

  • Microsoft Word;
  • Excel;
  • PowerPoint;
  • Outlook;
  • Microsoft Teams;
  • Zoom;
  • SharePoint;
  • cloud-based document-management systems;
  • project-management platforms; and
  • other client- or Matrix-designated systems.

Experience with legal, government or enterprise technology platforms is an asset.

Independent Contractor Engagement

This is an independent contractor, project-based engagement and not an employment position.

Contractors manage their assigned projects independently and are responsible for determining the manner, method, sequence and tools used to perform the work, subject to the applicable Work Order, required deliverables, agreed timelines, confidentiality obligations, security requirements and client-specific requirements.

Matrix provides the client relationship, assignment scope and required deliverables. Contractors independently manage the execution of their assignments and use Matrix's designated online project-management and collaboration platform to receive Work Orders, access assignment information, provide status updates and collaborate with Matrix and authorized client contacts as required.

Contractors may accept assignments based on their availability, qualifications, experience and capacity.

Contractors are responsible for maintaining the professional capabilities, equipment, technology, transportation and other resources necessary to perform their assignments, except where otherwise agreed for a specific project.

Contractors are responsible for their own applicable taxes, government remittances, insurance, business expenses and other obligations arising from their independent business activities.

Nothing in the contractor relationship creates an employment, partnership, joint-venture or agency relationship between the contractor and Matrix or the client.

Work Environment

Assignments may be:

  • fully remote;
  • hybrid;
  • client-site based; or
  • a combination of remote and in-person work.

The location, duration, scope and nature of each assignment will depend on the applicable client Work Order.

Contractors should be comfortable adapting to different organizations, industries, project requirements and professional environments.

Why Work With Matrix

  • Flexible, project-based consulting opportunities.
  • Exposure to diverse organizations and complex client assignments.
  • Opportunities to work alongside experienced Matrix advisors and consultants.
  • Ability to apply your professional expertise across different projects.
  • Remote and hybrid project opportunities.
  • Use of a structured online collaboration and project-management environment.
  • Opportunities to develop a diverse consulting portfolio.
  • Participation in meaningful organizational and institutional improvement initiatives.

Professional Boundaries

Matrix provides non-legal consulting, administrative, operational and strategic services.

Associate Consultants may conduct research, analysis, documentation and project-support activities relating to legal or public-sector environments. However, they do not:

  • provide legal advice;
  • provide legal opinions;
  • interpret legislation or regulations for clients;
  • provide legal representation;
  • determine a client's legal rights or obligations;
  • provide legal strategy; or
  • provide regulated professional advice outside their qualifications and authorized scope.

Where an assignment raises a matter requiring legal or other regulated professional judgment, the matter remains the responsibility of the client's appropriately qualified professional.

Diversity & Inclusion

Matrix is committed to building a diverse and inclusive professional network. We welcome qualified professionals from a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Matrix is committed to equal opportunity and maintaining a respectful professional environment in accordance with applicable Ontario, Canadian and relevant jurisdictional legislation.

All applicant information will be treated confidentially and handled in accordance with applicable privacy requirements.

description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

The Device Platform team owns the backend between Verkada's cloud and the hardware we ship — device provisioning, OTA firmware rollout, and the licensing layer that turns devices into a business. Verkada already operates at millions of devices, and we're scaling the platform for the next order of magnitude — with the consistency, latency, and uptime guarantees our enterprise customers depend on.

Hitting that scale isn't just a technical problem. We're creating the IoT core that every product team across Verkada relies on to accelerate their roadmaps. We do as much cross-team alignment as deep systems design, and hold a high bar on both execution and communication with our peers.

We're five senior engineers today, with a new-grad joining us this summer — and we're hiring more as the platform's reach across Verkada grows. We're high-trust and inclusive: we give and receive feedback directly, we learn out loud, and we get better together because of it.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable Senior DevOps Engineer to join our core engineering team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our infrastructure, responsible for designing, deploying, and maintaining the cloud architecture that powers our cutting-edge AI-native products and intelligence platforms.

Because we build complex, agentic AI workflows and intelligent applications (often requiring strict security and compliance standards), this role goes beyond traditional infrastructure. You will bridge the gap between our AI/ML engineering team and production, ensuring our models and applications scale efficiently, securely, and seamlessly. While our primary ecosystem is Google Cloud Platform (GCP), we operate in a dynamic environment where familiarity with other enterprise platforms like Azure and Salesforce is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & AI Deployment (MLOps)

  • GCP Architecture: Architect, build, and manage highly available, secure, and scalable infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using services like GKE (Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run, Compute Engine, VPCs, and Cloud Storage.
  • AI/ML Product Deployment: Partner closely with data scientists and AI architects to deploy machine learning models, LLMs, and agentic workflows into production.
  • GPU & Compute Management: Optimize and provision infrastructure for AI workloads, managing GPU quotas, scaling policies, and compute costs effectively.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Write, test, and deploy infrastructure using Terraform, ensuring all environments are reproducible and version-controlled.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Pipeline Engineering: Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (via GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Cloud Build) to automate the testing, building, and deployment of both application code and AI models.
  • Containerization: Deep expertise in Docker and Kubernetes. Manage container registries, helm charts, and microservices orchestration.
  • Workflow Automation: Automate routine operational tasks and deployment procedures using Python and Bash scripting.

Cross-Platform Integration & Adaptability

  • Multi-Cloud/Enterprise Integrations: Support the integration of our core GCP products with external client environments, specifically involving Microsoft Azure and Salesforce.
  • Rapid Upskilling: Act as a technical chameleon. If you lack direct experience with Azure or Salesforce architectures, you must demonstrate a proven track record of rapidly acquiring new platform skills to support cross-functional product requirements.

Security, Monitoring, & Reliability

  • Observability: Implement comprehensive logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and Google Cloud Operations (formerly Stackdriver) to ensure high availability of our AI services.
  • Enterprise Security & Compliance: Enforce cloud security best practices (IAM, network security, encryption at rest/transit) to ensure our infrastructure meets the stringent compliance and control-testing requirements of our enterprise clients.
  • Incident Response: Act as a key point of contact for system outages, participating in root-cause analysis and implementing preventative measures.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • GCP Mastery: Proven production experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly GKE, IAM, Cloud Build, and networking components.
  • AI/ML Context: Prior experience deploying AI, ML, or data-heavy applications to production (familiarity with Vertex AI, Hugging Face deployments, or local LLM hosting is a massive plus).
  • Tooling: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Linux administration.
  • Scripting/Coding: Strong programming skills in Python (essential for AI pipelines) and Bash.
  • Agile Mindset: Experience working in fast-paced, product-focused Agile environments.

Preferred Qualifications (The ‘Nice-to-Haves‘)

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure DevOps, Azure Entra ID).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce API integrations and managed packages from an infrastructure perspective.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer Certification (or equivalent).
  • Background in developing infrastructure for fintech, banking controls, or highly regulated domains.

title: Emergency Care Technician : Emergency Department
description:
Primary Duties And Responsibilities

The Emergency Care Technician (ECT) performs select technical procedures and tasks, and assists physicians and nurses in direct patient care in the Emergency Department.

Technical procedures include:

  • EKGs
  • Restraint applications
  • Removal of foley catheters
  • Splint applications
  • Crutch/cane training
  • Visual acuity examinations

The ECT also provides transportation, maintains equipment and supplies as well as participates in a safe patient care environment.

May serve as Lobby Facilitator and assists the triage nurse by performing first aid duties and acting as a liaison between the ED team, patients, and families to patients in the ED Lobby.

May perform other duties as assigned and described within scope of practice.

ECT’s with additional competencies may perform phlebotomy and accucheck.

The Emergency Care Technician (ECT) works directly under the supervision of a licensed Registered Nurse (RN) providing bedside patient care and anticipating patient needs.

We have current openings at Hoag Hospital Irvine. All openings are full-time, night shift.

  • Measuring and recording vital signs, I&O
  • Taking height and weight records
  • Performing routine patient admission and discharge duties
  • Ensuring patient safety is maintained at all times and is documented
  • Performing Clinitek bedside urine test as required (must have annual competency)
  • Immediately informing RN of any changes in patient condition
  • Communicating pertinent information at shift report with oncoming staff
  • Reinforcing patient teaching and reporting patient’s questions to RN
  • Performing other duties as assigned within scope of practice


Education and Experience

  • Recent experience as an EMT or Patient Care Assistant or Military Corpsman, preferred.

Certifications Required

  • Current BLS Certifications required, and

  • Either:

    • Current Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) Certification, or

    • Completion of EMT course, or

    • RN License

Certifications Preferred

  • Phlebotomy Certification

title: Lead Full Stack Developer | AI-Powered FinTech
description:
Job Title: Lead Full Stack Engineer

Job Type: Full Time

Location: Remote


About the Role

We‘re looking for a hands-on Lead Full Stack Engineer to build and scale AI-enabled, cloud-native applications for a fast-paced FinTech product environment. The role will have a strong backend focus (70%) with frontend development (30%), requiring deep expertise in Python, React.js, AWS, and PostgreSQL. You‘ll own features end-to-end, from design and development through deployment, while integrating AI/GenAI capabilities into production applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs using Python.
  • Develop responsive and production-ready frontend applications using React.js.
  • Own features end-to-end, from technical design and implementation to production deployment.
  • Build cloud-native and serverless applications using AWS.
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schemas, queries, indexing, and performance.
  • Integrate LLMs and Generative AI capabilities into production applications.
  • Build AI-powered features including intelligent search, chat interfaces, document processing, and workflow automation.
  • Integrate AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Data Engineering, Analytics, and Engineering teams.
  • Build reusable components, automation tools, APIs, and internal applications.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Ensure applications are secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready.


Required Skills

  • 6+ years of experience in Full Stack / Software Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python and backend development.
  • Strong experience with React.js and modern frontend development.
  • Solid hands-on experience with AWS Cloud, including cloud-native and serverless architectures.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL, including database design, schema management, query optimization, and database operations.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs / Generative AI into production applications.
  • Experience with AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Azure OpenAI, or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, scalable application design, and microservices.
  • Experience building and deploying end-to-end products in production.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Terraform.
  • Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, RDS, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.

What We‘re Looking For

A passionate, hands-on Full Stack Engineer who is strong in Python and comfortable across the frontend, cloud, database, and AI layers. Someone who takes complete ownership of features, enjoys solving complex engineering problems, and is excited about building AI-powered products in a fast-paced FinTech environment

title: Senior Consultant Fullstack Developer
description:
Role: Senior Consultant - Full Stack Developer

Experience: 5 to 8 Years

Location: India - Delhi

Experience

The candidate must have experience taking products from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, production operations, enhancement, and stakeholder adoption with at least 3-4 complete, end-to-end production implementations.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.


Core responsibilities

Architecture and technical leadership

  • Own the technical architecture of AI-enabled enterprise products from discovery to production.
  • Define application boundaries, service contracts, data models, integration patterns, deployment topology, and non-functional requirements.
  • Select appropriate technologies for LLM orchestration, data processing, vector search, workflow automation, and enterprise integration.
  • Produce architecture decision records, solution blueprints, sequence diagrams, API specifications, threat models, capacity plans, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish reusable reference architectures for RAG, AI agents, human-in-the-loop review, model gateways, and workflow automation.
  • Define standards for API design, schema validation, error handling, observability, testing, secure coding, versioning, and release management.
  • Review designs and code produced by other engineers.
  • Lead proof-of-concepts and convert successful prototypes into production-grade implementations.
  • Balance functional requirements, performance, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and delivery timelines.


Full-stack engineering

  • Develop high-performance Python services using FastAPI, Django, Flask, or equivalent frameworks.
  • Build asynchronous processing pipelines using Kafka, Redis Streams, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Service Bus, or equivalent technologies.
  • Develop frontend applications using React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and/or SAPUI5.
  • Build enterprise dashboards, AI workbenches, workflow consoles, document-review interfaces, search applications, approval journeys, and administrative tools.
  • Implement streaming AI responses, structured result views, confidence indicators, citations, source references, audit trails, and human feedback mechanisms.
  • Design and implement analytical, document, metadata, and vector data stores.
  • Build reusable shared libraries, SDKs, frontend components, API clients, authentication modules, and platform services.
  • Develop secure integrations with internal systems, third-party services, data platforms, and enterprise identity providers.


AI and agentic systems

  • Design and productionize RAG systems using document ingestion, chunking, metadata enrichment, embeddings, reranking, retrieval filters, and response generation.
  • Implement AI agents and tool-using workflows with controlled planning, execution, validation, retries, approvals, and escalation.
  • Integrate LLMs from approved providers and model platforms, including enterprise model gateways and SAP Generative AI Hub where applicable.
  • Implement prompt versioning, model versioning, evaluation datasets, golden test cases, regression suites, and quality gates.
  • Establish controls for hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, unauthorized access, and excessive model autonomy.
  • Design model fallback, timeout, retry, caching, token-budget, and cost-control strategies.
  • Implement observability for prompts, responses, model metadata, tool calls, latency, token usage, retrieval quality, user feedback, and failure modes.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineers on model training, fine-tuning, inference optimization, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build AI features that support structured extraction, classification, summarization, recommendations, forecasting, conversational search, and business-process automation.


SAP BTP and enterprise SAP responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of SAP BTP extension and side-by-side applications.
  • Design integrations between SAP BTP, SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Analytics Cloud, and non-SAP systems.
  • Use OData, REST, RFC, events, SAP Gateway, and SAP Integration Suite as appropriate.
  • Work with SAP BTP services such as:
  • SAP HANA Cloud, SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, SAP Generative AI Hub, SAP Integration Suite.
  • SAP Destination and Connectivity services, SAP Business Application Studio, SAP Cloud Foundry.
  • Design SAP-aware RAG solutions using business-process context, authorization-aware retrieval, SAP metadata, and HANA Cloud vector capabilities.
  • Integrate SAP Joule to build AI assistants and agents that interact with SAP business processes under controlled authorization.


Required technical skills

Backend and platform engineering

  • Advanced Python and strong software design ability.
  • FastAPI, Django, Flask, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and asynchronous programming.
  • TypeScript/Node.js for CAP services and enterprise integrations.
  • REST, GraphQL where appropriate, OpenAPI, WebSockets, event-driven systems, and messaging.
  • PostgreSQL, SAP HANA Cloud, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and vector databases.
  • Microservices, modular monoliths, distributed systems, caching, idempotency, retries, circuit breakers, and resiliency patterns.

Frontend engineering

  • Advanced JavaScript, React, Next.js, component architecture, state management, frontend security, and testing.
  • SAPUI5 and Fiori development or the ability to lead SAP UI implementation.
  • Accessibility, responsive design, performance optimization, design systems, and user-centered AI experiences.
  • Experience presenting complex AI outputs, evidence, citations, confidence values, structured data, and workflow states.

AI engineering

  • LLM application architecture and production integration.
  • RAG, embeddings, reranking, vector databases, semantic search, hybrid search, and document processing.
  • Agentic workflows, function calling, tool execution, workflow graphs, and human approval patterns.
  • Prompt engineering, structured generation, JSON schema validation, guardrails, and model routing.
  • Model evaluation, benchmark creation, regression testing, red teaming, safety testing, and feedback analysis.
  • Fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation of open-source models is preferred.
  • Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel, DSPy, or comparable frameworks.
  • Understanding of GPU inference, model serving, batching, quantization, latency, throughput, and cost optimization is advantageous.

SAP and integration

  • Strong experience in SAP BTP application deployment using CDS, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and/or Kyma.
  • SAP AI Core, AI Launchpad, Generative AI Hub, Document AI, and SAP Business AI.
  • SAP S/4HANA integration using OData, REST, RFC, events, and Integration Suite.
  • SAPUI5/Fiori, SAP Gateway, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, XSUAA, role collections, technical users, and enterprise.
  • Understanding of SAP clean-core, side-by-side extensibility, tenant isolation, and lifecycle management.
  • SAP BTP or SAP AI certification is preferred.

Cloud, DevOps, and operations

  • AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and/or SAP BTP.
  • Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
  • OpenTelemetry, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Secrets management, vulnerability scanning, dependency management, image scanning, and software supply-chain security.
  • Disaster recovery, backup, rollback, blue-green or canary release strategies, capacity planning, and production incident management.

Leadership and delivery responsibilities

  • Mentor developers and establish engineering standards.
  • Lead technical discussions with product managers, business analysts, architects, security teams, SAP teams, and senior stakeholders.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
  • Establish requirements traceability from BRD or process requirements to architecture, code, test cases, deployment, and production evidence.
  • Lead estimation, sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical risk management, and delivery reviews.
  • Conduct design, code, threat-model, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across backend, frontend, AI, data, DevOps, SAP, QA, and support teams.
  • Define coding standards, branching strategies, release policies, quality gates, and engineering metrics.
  • Create technical training, reusable templates, reference implementations, and internal documentation.
  • Participate in on-call escalation, incident analysis, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvement.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: Azure DevOps Engineer (AI & Automation)


Location: Noida


Experience: Min 3 Years


Department: Engineering / Infrastructure & Platform


Role Overview


We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the

implementation of AI-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage

repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing,

and code-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and

GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI

native software development lifecycles.


Key Responsibilities


1. DevOps Administration & Repository Management

• Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies

(e.g., Trunk-Based, GitFlow, Feature-Branching) and access governance across

organizations.

• CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi-environment

deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching

and automated quality gates.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform,

Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero-drift environments.

• DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e.g., Gitleaks),

dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps.


2. AI Coding Agent Setup & Branch Workflows


• Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e.g.,

Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform

autonomous task execution across different Git branches.

• Repository Context & Prompts: Author and maintain repository-level context files

(AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to

steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns.

• Multi-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up

issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft

PRs.


3. Automated Code Review & Testing Agents


• Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code-review agents within pull request

workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews

before human sign-off.

• Automated Testing & QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents

analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest

fixes directly in CI.

• Governance & Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and

human-in-the-loop approvals for agent-generated code.


Technical Qualifications


Must-Have Experience


• Core DevOps (2+ Years): Hands-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker,

Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation).

• Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies,

and repository permissions.

• AI Coding Tools & SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot

(Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code

CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol).

• Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node.js for

building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations.


Nice-to-Have Experience


• Experience building multi-agent orchestrations (e.g., CrewAI, LangChain, or custom

sub-agents).

• Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with

internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems.

• Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost

optimization.

Expected 90-Day Deliverables


Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch

protection rules across all development projects.

Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code

reviews and unit test generation.

Month 3: Fully operationalize an end-to-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be

assigned to branch-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.

title: Vice President, International Youth Federation
description:
Vacancy ID: HQ/BOM/HR/5540
Position Title: Vice President
Location: Worldwide
Category: FTA International
Level: VP
Duration: Four Years
Supervisor/Report to: IYF President
Department: Executive Office
Job type: Volunteer (Part-Time)

About the role

The Fédération Internationale de la Jeunesse, in English International Youth Federation (IYF), is an international non-profit youth organization network governed by the present Statutes and the Swiss Civil Code. It is politically neutral, and non-denominational, aiming to empower youth worldwide.

The IYF is a global youth network, an organization advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience and resources to empower young people across the world. IYF works in over 50 countries and territories, helping to achieve youth empowerment and improve the status of youth.

The IYF Executive Office (ExO) is a central office tasked with the development of corporate strategies, policies, tools, and systems in both key and cross-cutting management areas. The office provides the support needed to enable the IYF Senior Management Team (SMT) to effectively perform their leadership roles. The ExO oversees the work of the IYF Commissions, Regional Administrations, HQ Bureaux and their associates’ bodies.

The IYF Vice President is the second senior official after the President who works to assist the President and the Secretary-General in overall strategic and operational responsibility for all the IYF activity areas. The position is a part of the Senior Management Team (SMT) that drives the overall strategy for the IYF at global level.

Responsibilities

(A) Leadership & People Management:

  • Preside over meetings in the absence of the President/SG and watch over the IYF Commissions and assist committee’s heads;
  • Leading, guiding, directing, and evaluating the work of other the IYF officials including Executive branches staff and Regional Directors;
  • Support the implementation of the IYF Global Strategy that guides the direction of the IYF’s programmes, projects and initiatives;
  • Advising the President/Secretary-General on substantive matters and in the organisation’s strategic planning and the development of management tools and instruments to enhance the performance of IYF in its overall mission;
  • Overseeing the implementation and operationalization of the work of the Honorary Board, Board of Advisers and IYF Goodwill Ambassadors Progarmme; and
  • Representing the organisation where required and assisting in the establishment and development of key partnerships.

(B) Partnerships & External Relations:

  • Identifies opportunities for new alliances and develops strategies for achieving the IYF objectives raising revenue;
  • Expand revenue generating and fundraising activities to support existing programmes and the growth of the IYF;
  • Cultivate existing relationships and develop new funder relationships;
  • Represents the IYF at international conferences, events and meetings;
  • Develop partner networks and strategic partnerships, using method driven approaches and processed to drive results through partnerships;
  • Coordinate the management of ongoing relationships with existing partners and where relevant, leverage those relationships to greater collective impact;
  • Focuses on strengthening existing collaborations and ensure that partnerships are profitable and beneficial to all parties;
  • Conceptualize new strategic initiatives that could be built around or benefit from corporate, foundation, government, bilateral organizations or other partnerships; and
  • Assisting the President/Secretary-General in developing and facilitating consultations with Governments.

Competencies

Lead (Level-4) Leadership is the art of motivating a group of people to act as a team towards achieving a common goal.

Design (Level-4) Ability to recognize what changes are required and create a path for improvement using existing knowledge, problem-solving skills, creativity, and original ways of working.

Empower (Level-4) Empowerment is a practice of giving team members skills, authority, opportunity, and motivation so that they can take initiative and make decisions to solve problems and improve performance.

Mobilize (Level-4) Ability to identify resources and activities that individuals and organizations will undertake to support the IYF’s strategic goals and objectives. Engage and influence appropriate donors by building win-win relationships.

Inspire (Level-4) Inspiration and lead by example is about energizing and creating a sense of direction and purpose in others, unlocking motivation and momentum for positive change.

Functional Competencies

  • Ability to lead strategic planning, results-based management, and reporting.
  • Ability to lead and manage corporate strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent computer, internet, social media, and information system skills.

Eligibility

  • Only (18-38) age is accepted for this position.
  • Highly interested in youth empowerment, youth issues.

Skills Required for Position

  • Ability to interact cordially and communicate with a diverse community.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to assess and evaluate situations quickly, accurately, and effectively.

Experience

Experience and results preferred at national or international level in youth empowerment role, management, coordination, development, communications, international relations, youth studies, sport, women empowerment, youth-led organizations, or another relevant field.

Language

Fluency in English with superior drafting skills is essential.

Assessment
Evaluation of qualified candidates may include an assessment exercise which may be followed by a competency-based interview.

Working Modality
This vacancy is a voluntary-based position with (3-7 Hours/Week) flexible part-time commitment.

title: Medior Backend Developer [C#]
description:
Locatie: Eindhoven, op de campus van de Technische Universiteit Eindhoven

Aantal uur per week: Fulltime (40u)

Denk- en werkniveau: HBO of universitair | Computer Science

Bij Wolfpack zijn we trots op de software die we maken voor onze klanten. Dit komt terug in onze cultuur en verpakt in een onze nieuwe slogan: “Pack of Hungry Creators”. Deze 3 pijlers staan voor onze kernwaarden: Teamwork & Trust, Learning & Dedication, Pride & Creation. Herken jij je in deze kernwaarden? Lees dan vooral verder!

Als Medior Backend Developer (C#) werk je samen met andere developers en product owners bij onze klanten om tijdig kwalitatief goede technische oplossingen en implementaties te verzorgen waar je trots op kan zijn.

Wat jij je vrienden vertelt dat je doet:
"Als medior developer ondersteun je de andere junior developers. Je geeft advies en opbouwende kritiek op de voorgestelde oplossingen - maar er is natuurlijk veel meer. Het delen van kennis en ervaring zorgt er voor dat iedereen zich kan ontwikkelen. 's Morgens begin ik met even bij te praten met de rest van de pack, en daarna volgt de dagelijkse stand-up. Als er iemand ergens vast zit kijk ik graag of ik even kan helpen! Ik ontwerp en programmeer in C# een schaalbare event-driven micro-service, en lees over de laatste ontwikkelingen - het is natuurlijk wel belangrijk om te blijven leren! Tegelijkertijd ben ik bezig met cloud oplossingen in Azure. Data was al belangrijk voor onze klanten, maar anno 2025 steeds meer. Hierin ga ik samen met mijn collega's brainstormen over mogelijke oplossingen die toegevoegde waarde kunnen geven voor onze klanten.Aan het einde van de dag praten we onder het genot van een biertje even over hoe we onze uitdagingen hebben opgelost."

Maar wacht… wat betekent dat, dag-tot-dag?

  • Je bent een vaste waarde in het team en weet collega's te enthousiasmeren over nieuwe technologien.

  • In C# implementeer je meer complexe elementen van een project;

  • Je onderzoekt nieuwe mogelijkheden met cloud oplossingen en kan teamleden overtuigen van nieuwe features die op basis van data meerwaarde gaan opleveren voor onze huidige en toekomstige klanten;

  • Je zorgt voor kwaliteitsbewaking in het team en bepaalt de standaard;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de andere developers en projectmanagers, en blijft jezelf ontwikkelen;

  • Develop, develop, develop, natuurlijk!


Wat de pack van jou nodig heeft:

  • 3+ jaar software development ervaring met een gedegen achtergrond in backend development, specifiek C# .Net;

  • Je hebt ervaring met cloud oplossingen (het liefst in Azure) en hebt een interesse in data science;

  • Je (doet je best) om op de hoogte te blijven van Azure services zoals Cosmos D.B., Application Insights, Data factories, Event Hub etc.;

  • Je deelt graag je inzichten en wetenswaardigheden met je collega's op een hands-on manier;

  • Je stelt de juiste vragen en balanceert verwachtingen met wat er mogelijk is, zodat de kwaliteit nooit een compromis is om maar requirements af te vinken;

  • Je grijpt alles aan wat er voor zorgt dat jij en je team meer leren en op de hoogte blijven;

  • Je hebt ervaring met agile werken (scrum);

  • Je weet alles van hoe je in Git moet branchen, je kunt een deployment pipeline opzetten, en je past best practices voor code schrijven toe op pull requests. Je ondersteunt je team en de manier van werken.

Deel worden van de pack:

Werken bij Wolfpack betekent werken met meer dan dertig andere getalenteerde, hongerige wolven. Je zal nauw samenwerken met je collega’s van team Solid! Wij recruiten IT talent in het begin van hun carrière en geven hen de mogelijkheid om te ontwikkelen, niet alleen op het gebied van software, maar ook in hun soft skills; zowel op professioneel, als persoonlijk niveau.

Wat wij jou bieden:

  • Een competitief salaris (wij geloven niet in een vaste range in een vacature, maar bespreken je salariswens en kijken samen naar de mogelijkheden binnen onze kaders op basis van je werkervaring, opleiding en de rol die je zoekt).

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals: een (groen) pensioen, veel vrijheid in je uren, goed materiaal & cursussen en aandacht voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Slimme collega’s met een soortgelijke technische achtergrond.

  • Wij werken samen in projectteams, bij ons op onze eigen locatie in Eindhoven, op de TU/e Campus. We detacheren dus niet.

  • Flexibel hybride werken (+/- 40% thuis, 60% kantoor). Iedereen is iedere dag welkom op kantoor. Hierbij vinden we het belangrijk dat het kantoor een plek is om te ontmoeten, samen te werken en elkaar te vinden.

title: Full-Stack Developer — AI-Powered QA Automation
description:
# Full-Stack Developer — AI-Powered QA Automation Platform

**Location:** Remote / Hybrid / office


**Type:** Full-Time | Contract


**Experience:** 3–6 Years

---

## About the Role

We are building an AI-powered test automation platform that enables engineering and QA teams to generate, execute, and self-heal end-to-end browser test suites — without writing a single line of test code manually. The platform uses large language models to analyse web applications, understand their structure and user flows, and produce high-quality automated tests that run in the cloud.

We are looking for a **Full-Stack Developer** with a genuine interest in QA automation, developer tooling, and applied AI. You will contribute across the full product — backend APIs, AI integration, browser automation, and the frontend dashboard.

---

## What You‘ll Work On

### Backend Engineering


- Design and maintain REST APIs that orchestrate long-running AI and browser automation jobs.


- Build async job pipelines for test generation, execution, and self-healing workflows.


- Integrate with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude / OpenAI) to drive test generation and error analysis.


- Manage source ingestion from GitHub repositories and ZIP archives for code analysis.


- Work with async Python, relational databases, and background task workers.

### QA Automation & Browser Testing


- Develop and improve the Playwright-based test execution engine (headless and headed modes).


- Build the self-healing system that analyses test failures and automatically patches broken tests.


- Work with test result reporting, video capture, screenshots, and trace artifacts.


- Handle complex browser scenarios: SPA routing, authentication flows, dynamic content, file uploads, and autocomplete widgets.

### AI / Prompt Engineering


- Design and iterate on LLM prompts that produce reliable, production-quality Playwright TypeScript test code.


- Build context assembly pipelines that feed source code analysis and live DOM scan evidence to the model.


- Evaluate and improve output quality — reducing selector hallucinations, improving test coverage breadth, and handling edge cases in generated code.

### Frontend Development


- Build and maintain a React/TypeScript dashboard for managing projects, reviewing AI-generated tests, and viewing execution reports.


- Create rich reporting UIs: test result breakdowns, embedded video playback, diff views, and real-time job status feeds.


- Implement a spec review and approval workflow before tests are committed and executed.

### DevOps & Infrastructure


- Deploy and maintain the application on cloud infrastructure (Azure / AWS / GCP).


- Manage web server configuration, process management, and environment setup.


- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and GitHub integrations for committing generated test suites.

---

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |


|---|---|


| **Backend** | Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (async), Pydantic, Uvicorn |


| **AI** | Anthropic Claude API / OpenAI — prompt engineering, structured output |


| **Test Automation** | Playwright, TypeScript, `@playwright/test` |


| **Frontend** | React 18, TypeScript, Vite |


| **Database** | PostgreSQL / SQLite |


| **Infrastructure** | Azure / Linux, Nginx, systemd, GitHub Actions |

---

## Required Skills

- **Python** — 3+ years of professional backend development; async Python and REST API design.


- **TypeScript / JavaScript** — comfortable reading and writing Playwright test code and modern React components.


- **Browser Automation** — hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium; knows how to debug flaky tests, handle dynamic content, and manage authentication states.


- **React** — experience building production SPAs with hooks, state management, and async data fetching.


- **AI / LLM APIs** — experience integrating with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar; understands token limits, prompt structure, and parsing model output.


- **REST API Design** — clean, well-structured endpoints; understands async job patterns and polling.


- **Git & GitHub** — branching workflows, GitHub API usage, and CI/CD integration.


- **Linux Fundamentals** — comfortable on the command line; able to configure services, read logs, and debug server issues.

---

## Nice to Have

- Prior experience building **developer tools, test infrastructure, or observability platforms**.


- Understanding of how **modern React/Vue/Angular SPAs** behave at runtime — hydration, client-side routing, lazy loading.


- Experience with **static analysis or AST parsing** of frontend source code.


- Familiarity with **GitHub Actions** workflows.


- Cloud deployment experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP).


- Background in **QA engineering** — test planning, coverage strategy, or SDET experience.

---

## Responsibilities

- Take ownership of features from design through to deployment.


- Iterate on AI prompt quality and benchmark generated test output.


- Triage test execution failures and improve the automated healing system.


- Collaborate in a small, fast-moving team with direct access to product decisions.


- Write maintainable, well-documented code with appropriate test coverage.


- Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering standards.

---

## How We Work

- Small team, high ownership — you shape what gets built, not just what gets assigned.


- Ship fast and iterate — we value working software over lengthy planning cycles.


- AI-first engineering culture — we use AI tooling throughout our own development workflow.


- Async-friendly and remote — no unnecessary meetings or rigid hours.

---

## What We Offer

- Competitive salary or contract rate based on experience and location.


- Fully remote with flexible working hours.


- Direct involvement in product and technical direction.


- A technically interesting problem space at the intersection of AI, testing, and developer tooling.


- Clear path to a senior or lead engineering role as the team grows.

---

## How to Apply

Please send the following to **(saranya@radixlink.com)**:

1. A link to your GitHub profile or relevant portfolio.


2. A brief description (3–5 sentences) of a browser automation or testing project you have built or significantly contributed to.


3. Your availability and expected rate or salary.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 45-minute technical conversation — no take-home assignments.

---

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experience levels.*

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About RunLoyal

RunLoyal is a fast-growing vertical SaaS and payments company headquartered in Atlanta, GA, building the operating system for the pet care industry boarding, daycare, grooming, training, and dog parks. Our platform runs the daily operations of hundreds of real businesses, and our 2026 focus is scaling the product engine behind an expanding enterprise segment.


We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer (4 to 8 years of experience) to lead our most strategic builds.

The Role

This is not a sprint-pool position. You'll operate the way forward-deployed engineers do — dropped into a problem space and trusted to drive it from ambiguity to shipped. You'll be handed a strategic initiative (a new AI product build, a greenfield module, a flagship platform project), gather context directly from stakeholders and customers, set the technical direction, structure the work, and deliver with teammates — leading from the front.


You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work embedded with the Head of Product on new initiatives, in an independent lane with direct access to leadership. We operate AI-native: our newest product surfaces are being designed and built with agentic AI workflows at the core, and you'll help define how AI-native engineering works here — not just follow a playbook.


Honest framing: we're a fast-moving, founder-driven team in transition toward modern SaaS delivery practice. You'll have real autonomy and real accountability in equal measure. If you need a fully paved road, this isn't your role. If you've shipped meaningful things through ambiguity before — and enjoyed it — read on.


What You'll Own

1. Strategic build projects — end-to-end

Own flagship initiatives from first principles to production: architecture, delivery plan, execution with teammates, release, and post-release iteration. You're accountable for the outcome, not just the code — which means demoing early, cutting scope intelligently, and shipping working software on a rhythm.


2. Technical leadership from the front

Set the technical direction on your projects and bring teammates along through visible working practice — pairing, reviewing, and raising the bar rather than issuing instructions. Mentor by doing. Contribute to system design and architecture decisions across the platform, and push our engineering practices forward.


3. AI-augmented delivery — our default operating mode

Independently architect and deliver full projects using AI-augmented workflows: agentic coding (Claude Code or equivalent), spec-driven development, AI-led test generation, and structured context management. This is how the role works day-to-day, not an accelerator bolted on. You'll co-author our internal AI engineering playbooks and raise the bar for how the whole team builds.


4. Core engineering

Design and ship scalable Spring Boot microservices, RESTful APIs, and responsive frontends in Angular or React. Write efficient SQL, optimize JVM performance, own production issues on your surfaces end-to-end, and leave the codebase better documented than you found it.


Leadership & Agency — what we'll evaluate hardest

  • You lead from the front. You've set direction on projects and carried teammates with you — through working code and clear communication, not title or authority
  • High agency. You identify what's blocking the outcome and remove it yourself — whether it's code, process, or a conversation someone needs to have
  • Strong stakeholder muscle. You communicate clearly upward and outward — written updates, proactive demos, and comfort presenting to leadership and customers directly
  • Async-native. You work effectively across time zones with documentation and over-communication as defaults, not afterthoughts
  • Calm ownership under ambiguity. Handed a loosely defined problem, you structure it, sequence it, and start shipping


What You Bring

Must have


  • Significant professional software development experience with real ownership scar tissue — you've led projects, not just tickets. We care about evidence, not years
  • Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot; solid microservices architecture and REST API design
  • Frontend experience with Angular or React
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and SQL optimization; JVM fundamentals and backend performance
  • AI-native engineering (hard requirement). You already deliver work through AI-augmented workflows — agentic coding tools, prompt/context engineering, AI-driven testing — and can demonstrate the most complex thing you've shipped this way
  • Product-company experience: you've built for end users with daily stakes, and you think in outcomes
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills; unit testing and code coverage discipline
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to have


  • Forward-deployed, consulting, or founding-engineer experience — dropped into a customer or problem space and shipped
  • AWS (EC2, ECS), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Redis or similar caching
  • SaaS or multi-tenant systems; Golang exposure
  • DevOps and security best practices awareness


What You'll Gain

  • Ownership of flagship builds on a live, growing SaaS platform — your projects, your outcomes, visible to the whole company
  • Direct working partnership with the Head of Product and Head of Engineering
  • A defining role in how AI-native engineering is practiced at a product company that takes it seriously
  • Fast growth in a high-velocity startup with a clear product vision


Our Values

Kindness — We assume positive intent, celebrate each other, and call out bad acting when we see it.

Trust — We are authentic, humble, and empathetic. In a world full of change, trust is non-negotiable.

Fearlessness — We are bold, honest, and direct. Mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures.

Discourse, Not Dissonance — The best ideas win. Data drives decisions, and constructive challenges are always welcome.

Understanding, Not Consensus — We stand firm in informed convictions. We disagree healthily but commit once a decision is made.

Ownership — We take initiative, solve problems, and hold ourselves accountable for our impact.

Curiosity — We love learning and grow continuously with the industry.


One more thing: a genuine love for pets goes a long way here.


How to Apply

Send the following — applications without all three will not be reviewed (Mail to: pavithraa@runloyal.com):


  1. Your project story. One page or less: a project you led end-to-end through significant ambiguity — what you shipped, how you led the team, and what measurably changed. Specifics over adjectives.
  2. Your AI workflow. A short description of how AI is embedded in your actual engineering workflow today — tools, techniques, and the most complex thing you've shipped with it.
  3. Your resume.
