title: VP of Operations
description:
Who is Spring Fertility?

We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world’s top research hospitals and fertility centers. Together, we are building the fastest-growing fertility group in the country, grounded in clinical excellence and innovation. We deliver deeply patient-centric, individualized, and compassionate care, recognizing that every journey is unique. Our mission is to partner with patients to help them achieve their goals, whatever those may be. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to build a family if they choose, and our team is committed to guiding and supporting patients every step of the way.

Why should you join our team?

We are a mission-driven organization seeking motivated, high-performing professionals who are eager to innovate and make an impact. As we build a first-class fertility practice, we balance excellence with a culture that values collaboration, positivity, and enjoyment in the work we do. We are growing rapidly and are deeply committed to the professional and personal development of our team. Guided by optimism, compassion, and teamwork, we are united by a shared dedication to putting patients first.

Role Summary

The Vice President (VP) of Operations at Spring Fertility provides leadership and strategic direction for all clinic locations within an assigned territory, operating in line with company policies, in partnership with the COO, CMO, medical directors, and local leadership. This is a dynamic role and one that is critical to the success of the day-to-day operations, clinical oversight and future of our organization.

This role is responsible for leading the delivery of consistent and disciplined operations to support superior patient experience at Spring Fertility clinics, including training and coaching, rolling out business and clinical operations, integration, and transformation initiatives, and driving both revenue growth and cost discipline while ensuring high-quality patient care and compliance.

The VP of Operations will involve themselves in granular protocols and processes of all clinics within the assigned territory, while focusing on long-term business needs of a fast-paced, premier fertility business, and having an overall mandate to strengthen culture, performance, and operational effectiveness.

Essential Functions

Clinical & Business Operations

  • Provides direct oversight of multi-clinic operations, partnering with the COO, CMO, Medical Directors, Physicians, Practice Managers, and local and shared service leaders to drive consistent, high-performing operations and day-to-day coordination across all offices in the assigned territory.
  • Sets and upholds high standards for patient and customer service to deliver a best-in-class care experience, champions initiatives that strengthen patient satisfaction and clinical outcomes, and manages interventions related to patient concerns with timely, thoughtful resolutions.
  • Conducts in-depth regional analysis to identify near- and long-term priorities, and leads strategic planning for practice growth across Spring’s platform in partnership with Senior Leadership and CMO.

Team Leadership + Development

  • Leads and directly manages a team of direct reports – including Practice Managers, Clinical/Technical Managers, and Leads – providing oversight, coaching and performance management across clinical, business and administrative roles within the territory.
  • Builds proactive, collaborative relationships with Medical Directors, CMO, COO, and providers to develop and monitor corrective action strategies; coaches and develops team members, ensuring each understands their role and expected results, and stays motivated to meet practice goals and KPIs.
  • Partners with the People Team on recruitment and talent management strategy, including hiring, training, mentoring, and performance reviews to build internal talent across clinical, business, and administrative roles; leads onboarding for new providers alongside Medical Directors and Practice Managers, and serves as a resource to finance and laboratory managers on hiring and talent management within the territory.
  • Cultivates a culture of engagement and accountability so every employee can thrive.

Financial Performance + Growth

  • Owns regional P&L performance and budget, closely monitoring KPIs and clinic-level performance to identify issues early, build and execute action plans, and drive growth, profitability, and lasting improvement while maintaining high team morale, patient satisfaction, and quality of care.
  • Drives both revenue growth and cost discipline across the territory without compromising quality of care or compliance.
  • Leads strategic planning for practice growth across the platform in partnership with Senior Leadership and the CMO, using regional analysis to prioritize investment and expansion decisions.

Regulatory & Compliance Oversight

  • Stays current on practice administration and healthcare regulatory trends; Monitors and keeps leadership abreast of regulatory issues, deficiencies, or potential problems that may have impacts or involve regulatory intervention activities in collaboration with Compliance Officer.
  • Investigates regulatory or compliance related complaints received. Reports findings and resolutions to leadership and Compliance Officer.
  • QC and oversight of provider(s) schedules and templates to ensure maximization of the patient experience, creation of a thoughtful and productive provider schedule, and compliance with billing and regulatory requirements for patient visits
  • Oversight, implementation, and training for adherence to all protocols and policies
  • Develops, implements and coordinates training programs in conjunction with applicable departments

Education, Licenses, Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public health, health administration, or related field required
  • Minimum five (5) years of business and clinical operations experience in a directly related field required
  • Demonstrated success managing P&L, team development and operational scale
  • Proven ability to lead multi-site teams and drive performance outcomes

Employment Type

This is a full-time exempt position that requires 50% travel to sites. Must reside in NYC Metro.

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $200,000-$250,000. Salary is based on several factors including job related knowledge and skill set, depth of experience, certifications and/or degrees.

Benefits

Investing in You Today and Tomorrow

Supporting your well-being

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans

  • Paid time off to recharge and enjoy personal time

  • Access to BetterHelp therapy sessions for mental and emotional wellness

  • Commuter benefits and discounted rates on home, auto, and pet insurance

Investing in your future

  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match

  • Comprehensive fertility and parental leave benefits

  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing organization

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

*Temporary and contract roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed above

Don’t have it all? We still welcome you to apply!

At Spring Fertility, we believe that everyone who wants a family deserves to have one, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, or religion. Just as we acknowledge and value the diversity of goals, life experiences, and unique paths to parenthood among our patients, we also actively celebrate diversity within our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment for all. We recognize that diversity among our team allows us to not only more effectively serve our patients, but also to advance innovation and opportunity within our field. We encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to apply to our employment opportunities.

We are scientists. We are humanists. We are passionate about fertility.

Spring Fertility will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please give us a call.

title: Specialist, RPT Production Planning and Scheduling
description:
Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


The Specialist, RPT (Radiopharmaceutical Therapies) Production Planning and Scheduling will be responsible for facilitating and managing patient dose scheduling, consistent with RayzeBio corporate goals and program Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable federal (FDA) and state regulations. The role will require significant collaboration across internal and external functions to ensure on-time delivery of patient clinical materials. This role will also ensure that such operations activities are timely, efficient, and of the highest quality.

Job Responsibilities

  • Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Create and maintain detailed study and site tracking for patient dosing schedules across all clinical programs

  • Manage and collaborate with internal and external functions for all aspects of the patient treatment schedule and dosing, including scheduling of study participant dosing, receipt and processing of drug product orders, liaison to the Clinical team on the status of drug product manufacturing, shipments and receipt

  • Provide support, address issues and facilitate operational continuity for the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials

  • Key liaison between the Clinical Site Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics, and Radiochemistry teams

  • Identify, mitigate, and manage closely potential risks associated with the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials and escalate accordingly to the Head of Clinical Site Operations and Head of Clinical Operations

  • Drive and implement continuous improvement in the planning and scheduling of patient clinical materials

  • Collaborate with IT Business Partners in support of modeling and scheduling simulation implementations

  • Maintain and update study-level clinical site procedures for RPT dose management

  • Performs other tasks as assigned

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance individual productivity and quality of work

  • Ability to travel approximately 10% of time

Education and Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience with clinical operations, materials management and/or supply chain

  • BA/BS degree

  • Independent professional who proactively communicates frequently and effectively.

  • Organized and able to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines.

  • High energy level; positive attitude; works well under stress.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for an excellent Senior DevOps Engineer to join one of Sweden‘s fastest growing start-ups which is backed by Nvidia, Microsoft and AWS. The company also operates under the Inspection for Strategic Products.


Location: Fully remote within India. From 2027 you join our Bangalore office as part of the founding local team

Employment: Full time, permanent

Start: As soon as you are available


About the job

Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent. The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, people queue, machines idle, space goes unused, and the decisions made about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Software solved this for the digital world twenty years ago. Everything online is measured, understood, and acted on in real time. The physical world is still dark.


We are building the execution layer that closes that gap. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, queryable, real time information rather than footage. Not a research project, not a custom integration, not a team of ML engineers. A platform, where you describe what matters to you and deploy it.


What people build on it is broader than what we designed for. Operators use it to understand processes, find where time and space are being wasted, measure flow and utilization, catch problems while they are still happening, and turn all of it into data good enough to act on.


Everything is built on Privacy by Design. Data protection and GDPR compliance are part of the architecture, not a layer added afterwards.


We recently closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and we are scaling to meet demand. Antrino Labs is also registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual use products.


The role

We are hiring an experienced DevOps Engineer to own the infrastructure this platform runs on.

We will be honest about where we are, because it defines the job. We got here fast by shipping. Our services run on virtual machines managed with a process manager, deploys go out through GitHub Actions, and it has worked well enough to sign customers and prove the product. It will not carry us to where we are going. Turning that into infrastructure that holds thousands of continuous workloads across many customer environments, with real isolation, real observability, and deploys nobody is afraid of, is the work. You would be the first person whose whole job is that.


The workloads are not typical web traffic. Continuous inference pipelines run for weeks at a time, each consuming compute every second it is deployed. Media moves constantly through ingestion, conversion, and storage. Some of our compute sits inside customer facilities on hardware we reach over a private network, which means fleet management, remote updates, and diagnosing failures on machines you cannot walk up to. Alongside that, our customers are enterprises with security questionnaires, audit expectations, and requirements about where data lives, so evidence and controls are part of the job rather than an interruption to it.


You will have real authority over how this is built. We would rather hire one person with strong opinions formed by having operated production systems than three people waiting to be told what to do.


This is a remote first role today, working closely with the engineering team in Stockholm. From 2027 you will be part of the founding group in our Bangalore office. If you want to be an early face of a team as it forms rather than an employee number in one that already exists, that is the opportunity.


Your main areas of responsibility will include:

  • Owning our cloud infrastructure on Azure end to end, including compute, networking, storage, and identity, defined as code rather than configured by hand
  • Moving us from virtual machines and process managers to a container and orchestration setup that fits our workloads, and being accountable for that migration landing without breaking customers
  • Building deployment pipelines for both the TypeScript product and the Python services, with staged rollout, fast rollback, and environments that genuinely mirror each other
  • Owning observability across the stack: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting that tells someone what is actually broken instead of paging them at random
  • Running the reliability practice, including on call rotation, incident response, runbooks, and postmortems that produce changes rather than documents
  • Managing our media and streaming infrastructure: ingestion, conversion, delivery, storage lifecycle, retention policy, and the bandwidth and storage costs that come with all of it
  • Building and operating the fleet of compute that runs inside customer facilities, including provisioning, secure connectivity, remote update, and health monitoring
  • Owning cloud spend, including capacity planning, right sizing, storage tiering, and giving the team visibility into what each workload actually costs
  • Owning platform security: secrets management, network boundaries, access control, patching, backups, and tested restores
  • Supporting our work toward formal security certification and answering the infrastructure sections of enterprise security assessments with evidence
  • Building the internal tooling and documentation that let engineers deploy, debug, and operate their own services without routing everything through you


Our stack

You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it.

  • Cloud: Azure, with object storage and GPU backed compute
  • Runtime today: virtual machines with a process manager, deployed through GitHub Actions
  • Runtime we are heading toward: containers with orchestration, defined through infrastructure as code
  • Services: Next.js and TypeScript on the product side, Python and FastAPI for inference and media processing
  • Data: PostgreSQL through Supabase, with row level security
  • Media: RTSP ingestion, RTSP to HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines
  • Edge: compute inside customer facilities, reached over Tailscale


Who we are looking for

  • Substantial experience operating production infrastructure that people depended on, including the parts that woke you up at night
  • Strong Azure, AWS, or GCP experience, with real depth in at least one and the ability to reason about the others
  • Fluent with containers and orchestration, and with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi
  • You have built CI/CD that engineers trusted, and you understand why they stop trusting it
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to debug across process, container, host, and network boundaries
  • Practical observability experience, and clear opinions about what deserves an alert
  • Comfortable writing code, not only configuration. Python, Go, or TypeScript is fine
  • Security minded in a practical way: secrets, least privilege, patching, backups you have actually restored from
  • Experience with media, streaming, or high throughput data infrastructure is a strong advantage, as is managing distributed or remote hardware
  • You prioritize well under real constraints. Early stage platform work is choosing the three things that matter and refusing the other twenty
  • You work well asynchronously across time zones, write clearly, and raise problems early
  • Excellent written and spoken English


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the top of the Indian market for this level and discussed openly early in the process
  • Fully remote within India, with genuine ownership rather than delegated tickets, and a seat in the founding group of our Bangalore office from 2027
  • Hardware of your choice and a budget for whatever else you need to work well
  • Direct access to founders, to the Stockholm engineering team, and to customers
  • Travel to Stockholm to work with the team in person


Process

We review applications continuously and contact candidates we think are a good match.

  1. An introductory conversation about your background and the role
  2. A technical conversation where we discuss systems you have operated, what broke, and what you did about it. No whiteboard algorithm puzzles
  3. A working session with the engineering team on a real problem from our stack
  4. A conversation with the founders to discuss terms and your long-term future at the company


References may be requested in the final stage. We aim to keep the process short and to respect your time.

Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to something you have built or written. A repository, a post about a system you operated, or a short note on an incident you learned from tells us more than a cover letter.

title: Backend Engineer, Video Analytics and Predictive
description:
We build sealed AI appliances for factories. AJetson-class box on the plant network watches the cameras. A DGX Spark classbox with 128 GB of unified memory holds the record of what happened and readsthe tool sensors. Only text crosses between the two, and video is fetched ondemand with an audit record of every viewing.

You will build the pipeline that turns camera streamsinto typed events and tool sensor streams into early alerts that name theaffected sensors. The first release is classical computer vision and timeseries. The language model layer comes after that works.

WHAT YOU WILL BUILD

Edge detection and tracking. RTSP from the DVRs into GStreamer or DeepStream, inference through ONNX Runtime or TensorRT,and a frame budget per camera that holds when all thirty cameras are busy.

Typed events. One event per track with a stable identifier, a confidence, a one-sentence caption and a pointer to the clip, published over MQTT with a local spool that drains after a network cut.

Central ingest. PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB. Deduplicate, place the event on the site plan through the camera calibration, correlate into incidents, aggregate so every dashboard panel answers under a second.

Equipment Watch. Multivariate sensor streams through RFOD and CAD, so an alert carries the affected sensors and a feature attribution rather than a bare score, measured against labelled failure windows.

Replay. Role check, audit record, signed ticket, WebRTC relay from the edge box to the browser, held in memory only.

The design is written. The code is missing. You will be given the specification and expected to argue with it where it is wrong.

We need one to three years of Python in production, video work in one of OpenCV, GStreamer or DeepStream, model inference through ONNXRuntime, TensorRT or PyTorch, SQL beyond the basics, Docker and Linux. Jetson deployment, MQTT, TimescaleDB, time series anomaly detection and time spent in a fab or plant all help.

Before we talk, four hours at home: run any detector and tracker over a short video, emit one typed event per track over MQTT, write the events to PostgreSQL, and count them by class and by minute. Send the code with a note on where it breaks at thirty cameras.

title: AI & Data Intelligence Engineer
description:
Job Role: AI & Data Intelligence Engineer

Job Type: Contract

Duration: 12 months

Work mode: Hybrid

Location: Mumbai


About the Opportunity

The client is building an enterprise platform designed to bring greater rigor, transparency, and consistency to job architecture, compensation, and pay equity.


The platform combines frontier AI, statistical modeling, and domain expertise to help organizations make better, more consistent, and defensible workforce decisions. It is being designed with a strong emphasis on accuracy, explainability, auditability, and responsible AI.


This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of generative AI, statistical engineering, and enterprise technology, building AI workflows where reliability and precision are critical to the product.


The Role

The client is looking for a specialized AI & Data Intelligence Engineer to lead the accuracy, prompt architecture, evaluation, and statistical methodology engine powering the platform.

You will work closely with the data architect, development team, and domain experts to build and maintain the AI and statistical systems behind the platform. Your primary focus will be ensuring that the platform's AI workflows and statistical models are reliable, deterministic, resistant to drift, and capable of meeting rigorous enterprise and regulatory standards.


Key ResponsibilitiesLLM Engineering & AI Guardrails
  • Author, maintain, enhance, and version-control prompt templates.
  • Design and implement robust guardrails for structured LLM outputs using JSON Schema and Pydantic.
  • Build mechanisms to minimize hallucinations and ensure reliable, traceable outputs.
  • Design automated retry and human-in-the-loop workflows for low-confidence or failed outputs.
  • Manage the AI Gateway to capture token usage, model parameters, confidence scores, and evidence citations.
  • Work with frontier LLMs, including Anthropic Claude, deployed through Microsoft Foundry.


Statistical Analytics & Verification
  • Co-own and maintain the pure-Python statistical analytics engine with the data architect.
  • Implement and maintain statistical methodologies supporting the platform's core analytics.
  • Work with Python, pandas, statsmodels, scipy, and NumPy for OLS regression, log transformations, Gelbach decomposition, robust covariance estimation, and related statistical analysis.
  • Build statistical validation and testing frameworks to compare production outputs against reference datasets and industry/market data.
  • Develop backtesting and automated statistical-difference testing to ensure consistency and accuracy.


AI Evaluation, Reliability & Governance
  • Build automated evaluation harnesses to measure model performance, drift, citation accuracy, and hallucination resistance.
  • Use tools such as pytest, DeepEval, Promptfoo, and custom evaluation frameworks.
  • Maintain version-controlled prompt templates, methodologies, and model parameters.
  • Ensure a clear architectural boundary where AI handles natural-language parsing and drafting, while deterministic code performs arithmetic, scoring, and legal threshold calculations.
  • Support auditability and responsible AI requirements, including relevant EU AI Act and pay-transparency considerations.


Technology Stack


AI & Inference
  • Anthropic Claude
  • Microsoft Foundry / Azure


Prompting & Structured Outputs
  • JSON Schema
  • Pydantic
  • Jinja2


Statistical & Scientific Python
  • Python 3.11+
  • pandas
  • NumPy
  • SciPy
  • statsmodels


Testing & Evaluation
  • pytest
  • DeepEval
  • Promptfoo
  • Automated statistical evaluation and diff harnesses


Version Control
  • Git / GitHub


Shared Application Touchpoints
  • Celery
  • Redis
  • PostgreSQL
  • Python ORM


Out of Scope / Owned by the Development Team
  • Django / Django REST Framework
  • Vue 3 / Vite
  • nginx and web infrastructure
  • Azure networking and storage provisioning
  • Docker orchestration
  • GitHub Actions deployment pipelines


What the Client Is Looking ForRequired
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Quantitative Economics, or a related quantitative/technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience building and orchestrating frontier LLM applications.
  • Strong experience with structured LLM outputs, JSON Schema, and Pydantic.
  • Strong Python programming and statistical modeling experience.
  • Hands-on experience with pandas, statsmodels, scipy, and NumPy.
  • Experience building automated testing and evaluation frameworks for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of model reliability, drift, hallucination mitigation, and output validation.
  • Strong ability to work across AI engineering, statistical modeling, and product requirements.


Preferred
  • Experience with Anthropic Claude and/or Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI.
  • Experience in compensation analytics, job evaluation, pay equity modeling, or workforce analytics.
  • Familiarity with the EU AI Act, EU Pay Transparency Directive, or similar regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience building enterprise-grade AI systems where accuracy, traceability, and explainability are critical.

﻿

Why This Opportunity
  • Work directly with frontier AI models in a production enterprise application.
  • Build AI systems where accuracy, reliability, explainability, and responsible AI are core to the product.
  • Combine LLM engineering with real-world statistical modeling rather than working solely on generic AI applications.
  • Work closely with data, engineering, and domain experts to shape an emerging AI-powered product.
  • Have a direct impact on how organizations approach job architecture, compensation, and pay equity.
  • Opportunity for full-time conversion following the initial 12-month engagement.

title: Python Developer
description:
Python Developer – Data Platform & Middleware


MSH Business Consulting Pvt. Ltd. | Bangalore / Kolkata


Build the data backbone of MSH’s next-generation talent platform.


MSH is building an AI-first talent technology platform designed to make sourcing, matching and hiring smarter, faster and more data-driven.


We already have platforms powering different parts of the talent ecosystem. Now, we’re building the data and middleware layer that connects them — creating a reliable shared foundation that multiple systems can work from.


We’re looking for a Python Developer who enjoys solving complex data problems, building production-grade services and working at the intersection of Python, data engineering, APIs and AI.


This is a role where you will help shape the architecture — not simply maintain an existing application.


What You’ll Work On


As part of the engineering team, you will:


  • Build a shared middleware data layer connecting multiple MSH platforms
  • Develop a persistent, system-agnostic Candidate ID to solve identity and deduplication challenges across systems
  • Design Candidate–Job data models that track candidate stages, contact attempts and match scores for individual jobs
  • Build reliable data pipelines from Snowflake and other source systems
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues before they reach downstream systems
  • Design data and access boundaries for client-owned and shared data
  • Build APIs and services that multiple downstream systems can depend on
  • Contribute to the architecture and implementation of a 16-service middleware roadmap
  • Help establish the foundation for future AI/LLM-powered candidate-job intelligence


Technology You'll Work With

Core: Python, SQL, REST APIs / Services

Data: Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses

Orchestration: Airflow, dbt, Prefect

Cloud: AWS, GCP, Azure

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

Architecture: Data Modelling, Entity Resolution, Multi-Tenant Design


What We're Looking For


You should have:

  • 4–7 years of professional Python development experience
  • Strong experience building production-grade data pipelines
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
  • Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Experience with Airflow, dbt, Prefect or equivalent orchestration tools
  • Experience designing data models for real-world problems such as deduplication, identity resolution and unreliable source data
  • Experience building REST APIs/services or backend components consumed by multiple systems
  • Understanding of data privacy, access control and multi-tenant architecture
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform — AWS, GCP or Azure
  • Strong engineering judgment and the ability to participate in architecture and design decisions


AI-First Engineering Environment


AI is an integral part of how we expect our engineering teams to work.


Every engineer receives a monthly AI tooling budget for tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot or equivalent.


We expect you to use AI actively in your development workflow and demonstrate how it helps you:

  • Deliver faster
  • Improve code quality
  • Reduce bugs
  • Make better technical decisions
  • Explore and solve problems more effectively


You don't need to be an AI/ML specialist. We are looking for engineers who are curious about AI and know how to use it effectively in their work.


Good to Have

Experience with:

  • LLM-based candidate or job scoring
  • OpenAI API or similar LLM APIs
  • AI-enabled data products
  • Entity resolution or identity management
  • Talent/recruitment technology


Why Join This Team?

Build the foundation, not just features

You'll be working on the core data architecture that future MSH talent intelligence capabilities will depend on.

Solve real engineering problems

Messy identities, inconsistent data, multiple systems and complex client boundaries — this is production engineering, not a tutorial project.

Influence architecture

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to technical decisions and challenge existing approaches when you see a better way.

Work AI-first

You'll have access to the tools and budget to make AI a meaningful part of your engineering workflow.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the company:

Our client is a technology company transforming traditional consumer research through AI and data-driven insights. Its platform helps businesses quickly understand consumer behavior, market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities using billions of real-world consumer signals.

By delivering data-backed research and strategic recommendations within minutes, the company enables organizations to make faster, smarter, and more informed decisions. Its solutions combine AI, consumer intelligence, and data analytics to provide actionable insights while reducing the time and effort involved in traditional market research.


About the role:

We‘re hiring a Software Engineer who can pick up a ticket and close it. Not someone who needs hand-holding through scope or technology choices– someone who reads the requirement, figures out the right approach, and ships something they‘re proud of.


What you‘ll actually do:

  • Own tickets end-to-end: understand the problem, make the call, ship the feature, handle the edge cases
  • Build across the stack– frontend, backend, or both depending on where you‘re strongest
  • Work with TypeScript, ReactJS/NextJS on the frontend and Python/Go on the backend
  • Design and work with SQL and NoSQL databases as part of feature development
  • Collaborate with product and design to implement experiences that actually feel good to use
  • Debug, optimize, and improve systems that are already in production - Learn fast– the stack will evolve and you‘re expected to evolve with it


Who we think this is for:

3 to 6 years of engineering experience. Startup experience is preferred– not because corporates are bad, but because you already know what it means to ship without a safety net.


You probably:

  • Have closed real features in production, not just academic or tutorial projects
  • Specialize in either frontend or backend but can move across the stack when needed
  • Are comfortable in Python or Go on the backend, and TypeScript with ReactJS/NextJS on the frontend
  • Know your way around cloud environments– AWS or GCP
  • Understand databases well enough to make sensible design decisions, SQL and NoSQL
  • Have at least two projects you‘d genuinely put in front of someone and say: I built this, here‘s why it‘s good
  • Learn new tools by using them, not by waiting until you feel ready


This role is probably not for you if:

  • You need a detailed spec before you can start
  • Your best work lives in a private repo no one has seen
  • You‘re looking for a large team with defined lanes– here, you own what you pick up

title: Software Engineer
description:

Payfinia is a SaaS payment hub powering community banks and credit unions across the United States. Our flagship product, IPX (Instant Payment Exchange), enables real-time payment processing across major payment rails including FedNow and RTP. We build secure, scalable, cloud-native financial infrastructure that empowers smaller financial institutions to compete at the highest level.

In addition to our core offering, we partner with third-party digital providers to integrate instant payments with traditional payment and money movement solutions. This not only extends the technology provider’s capabilities but also strengthens the payments ecosystem for our member financial institutions.


To learn more about Payfinia, visit www.payfinia.com.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Java Developer with 2–3 years of experience to join our product engineering team at the India Development Center in Bengaluru. You will work on Payfinia’s core payment platform — IPX (Instant Payment Exchange) — which powers FedNow, RTP, ACH, and Wire payment rails for financial institutions across the United States. This role offers direct exposure to production-grade, real-time payment systems in an agile, fast-paced environment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (included but not limited to):

  • Design, develop, and maintain Java-based microservices for the IPX payment platform
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs; integrate with payment rails and financial institution core systems
  • Work with MySQL, Redis, and IBM MQ as part of the payment processing pipeline
  • Write clean, testable code with strong unit test coverage; participate in peer code reviews
  • Collaborate with senior developers, architects, and QA on sprint deliverables
  • Debug and resolve production issues; support incident triage and root cause analysis
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to improve productivity and code quality
  • Follow secure coding practices aligned with PCI-DSS and SOC2 requirements


SKILLS REQUIRED:

  • 2–3 years of Java development experience with strong OOP fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience with Spring Boot and RESTful API development
  • Working knowledge of SQL databases (MySQL)
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control and CI/CD workflows
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and service-to-service communication
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile sprint environment
  • B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science or related field
  • Good communication and collaboration abilities


GOOD TO HAVE:

  • Experience with message queues (IBM MQ, Kafka, or RabbitMQ)
  • Exposure to Docker / Kubernetes or cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Familiarity with the payments domain — ACH, Wire, or real-time payment rails
  • Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, JWT, or mTLS security patterns


WHY JOIN Payfinia?

  • Work on real-time payment systems used by financial institutions across the U.S.
  • Learn from experienced engineers in an agile, collaborative environment
  • Gain hands-on experience with modern fintech product development
  • Grow your career in the payments and digital banking industry
  • Be part of an award-winning team recognized for innovation in real-time payments

title: Philanthropic Advisor
description:
A humble college founded before Texas was a state, Baylor now stands as one of the premier institutions of higher education in the world. Baylor has continued to invest in research and doctoral education, both solidifying and elevating its unique status as a preeminent Christian research university. This recognition is based on faculty and staff responses to a related annual survey. This continued recognition further affirms Baylor as a rewarding place to build a career.

This position will support the mission of the University by serving on the principal gifts team and qualifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding donors and prospects for principal gifts in support of Baylor University, Baylor Athletics and all colleges and units. The principal gifts team is focused on seven and eight figure philanthropic commitments to Baylor University.

A bachelor's degree and eight years of relevant experience are required. A master's degree and ten or more years of experience is preferred.

A combination of education and experience will be considered in lieu of one another.

A valid US Driver License with a clear driving record of at least two years is required.

This role will be based in Waco, Texas.

Applicants must be authorized to work full-time in the United States.

What You Will Do

  • Cultivate, solicit and steward a highly targeted portfolio of principal gift capacity donors and prospects for principal gifts to Baylor in all academic areas, Bold Pursuits, and Baylor Athletics with the expectation to be an annual leader for dollars raised among all fundraisers
  • Lead fundraising efforts that impact Baylor capital, endowment and current use success
  • Collaborate with the Associate Vice President for Principal Gifts, Baylor University’s leadership, vice presidents/deans, lead development officers of 14 colleges/schools/units, and Advancement's leadership team to develop strategic philanthropic agendas, consistent with Baylor's strategic plans for principal level donors to the university, academic units, Bold Pursuits, and Baylor Athletics

  • Perform all other duties as assigned to support Baylor’s mission
  • Ability to comply with University policies
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance

What You Can Expect

As part of the Baylor family, eligible employees receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, generous time off, tuition remission, and outstanding automatic retirement contributions. Baylor has a comprehensive benefits plan that supports you and your family’s wellbeing and allows you to be a part of the life of a vibrant and active college campus. To learn more, go to Baylor Benefits & Advantages.

Explore & Engage

Learn more about Baylor and our strategic vision, Baylor in Deeds. Also, explore our great hometown of Waco and the many opportunities to engage locally. If you are new to Central Texas, This is Waco!

title: Journey/Ketenmanager SME
description:
Je zorgt voor een gemakkelijke, proactieve en AI-first klantbeleving en hebt end-to-end regie op systemen, processen, contactkanalen en klantreizen. Je monitort prestaties, vertaalt inzichten naar verbeteringen en zorgt dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd.

Daarmee draag je direct bij aan:

  • een hogere klanttevredenheid (NPS, CES en CSAT);
  • een efficiëntere keten (cost-to-deliver en cost-to-serve);
  • een betere medewerkerervaring door slimmere processen en meer automatisering.

Je werkt aan verbeteringen binnen:

  • Klantreizen: van bestellen en gebruiken tot wijzigen, betalen en opzeggen.
  • Klantcommunicatie: duidelijke en proactieve informatie voor klanten.
  • Ketenwerking: optimale samenwerking tussen systemen, processen en teams.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Monitoren, analyseren en verbeteren van ketenperformance.
  • Identificeren en oplossen van fricties in klantreizen en processen.
  • Vertalen van klantinzichten, data en marktontwikkelingen naar verbeterinitiatieven.
  • Opstellen van requirements, beoordelen van designs en begeleiden van implementaties.
  • Leiden van verbeter- en verandertrajecten waar nodig.
  • Verbinden van stakeholders en creëren van draagvlak binnen de keten.

Zo zorg je voor een stabiele operatie vandaag en voor de dienstverlening van morgen.

Wat breng je mee?

  • WO werk- en denkniveau, of HBO met ruime relevante werkervaring.
  • Ervaring met journey management, procesmanagement en/of ketenmanagement.
  • Ervaring met project- en implementatiemanagement.
  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement binnen complexe organisaties.
  • Ervaring met datagedreven verbeteren.
  • Affiniteit met klantcontact-, service- of operationele omgevingen.

Wie ben jij?

Je combineert klantgerichtheid, analytisch vermogen en resultaatgerichtheid met verbindend leiderschap. Je overziet complexe vraagstukken, vertaalt inzichten naar concrete acties en krijgt mensen in beweging.

Daarnaast ben je:

  • een sterke verbinder en communicatief vaardig;
  • proactief en ondernemend;
  • resultaatgericht en eigenaarschap gedreven;
  • tactisch én strategisch sterk;
  • gericht op samenwerking en gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid.

Natuurlijk hebben we als werkgever jou ook veel te bieden. Dit krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal €5216,- en maximaal €7843,- afhankelijk van je werkervaring, op basis van 40 uur exclusief 8% vakantiegeld
  • Vaste 13e maand, een deel krijg je maandelijks uitbetaald en een deel in januari van het volgende jaar. Óf je zet het in voor een FLEX & BOOST doel naar keuze! Klik hier om er meer over te lezen
  • Jaarlijks een individuele en collectieve verhoging conform onze CAO
  • € 1500 per jaar aan inzetbaarheidsbudget dat je naar eigen inzicht mag gebruiken voor bijvoorbeeld trainingen, coaching en cursussen
  • Flexibele vrije dagen: onze collega’s mogen zelf (in samenspraak met de manager) bepalen hoe zij met verlof omgaan
  • Een goede werk-privé balans
  • Thuiswerkshop om je werkplek thuis optimaal in te kunnen richten, uiteraard met een mobiele telefoon & laptop
  • 50% korting op onze producten en diensten, zodat je voordelig kunt internetten, bellen én streamen
  • Goede reiskostenvergoeding: je krijgt je OV kosten volledig vergoed of € 0,23 per kilometer als je met de auto reist. Kom je liever op de fiets? Dan kun je aanspraak maken op onze fietsvergoeding € 0,40 per kilometer
  • Mogelijkheid tot het aanschaffen van een leasefiets waar KPN maandelijks aan meebetaalt (bij onbepaalde tijd contract): Van stadsfiets tot e-bike en van racefiets tot speed-pedelec; jij kiest waar je op fietst
  • Uitstekende pensioenvoorwaarden: een totale inleg van 23% van je pensioengevende salaris waarvan KPN 16% inlegt en jij 7%

Ons geloof in technologie is groot. Dit wordt nóg krachtiger samen met menselijk contact, daarom ontmoeten we je graag!

Wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter Quinten Wilbrink via Quinten.wilbrink@kpn.com

title: Engineering Lead - Full Stack, Data & AI
description:
About Bloom AI


Bloom AI builds AI-native intelligence systems and workflows for enterprise teams across research, marketing, sales and other knowledge-intensive functions.


We combine enterprise data, external intelligence, AI and software engineering to help organizations build systems that continuously understand context, generate intelligence and support action.


Our model sits between traditional product companies and services firms. We build reusable technology and engineering patterns, while deploying them against real enterprise problems and adapting them to different client environments.


Bloom AI in based in U.S. and India (Delhi/NCR). This will be a hybrid work set-up.


The Role


We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Lead who can lead the design and delivery of modern AI and data applications, while managing a small team of engineers. The role reports to the Founder/CEO.


This is a broad engineering role and we are looking for someone with strong engineering fundamentals, good architectural judgment and enough range across software, data, cloud and AI to lead end-to-end solutions.


You will remain hands-on, lead a team of approximately 3–5 engineers, work directly with clients and help shape how Bloom builds and scales its technical capabilities.


This is not a pure product role. You will work across client solutions, reusable Bloom capabilities and internal technology. The challenge is to solve specific enterprise problems while continuously identifying what can be standardized, reused and improved across engagements.


What You'll Do


Own the technical delivery of AI and data applications from:


problem definition → architecture → build → deployment


You will work across systems that may include:

  • Modern web applications
  • Backend services and APIs
  • Structured and unstructured data
  • Data pipelines and processing
  • LLM-powered applications
  • Retrieval and search
  • Agentic workflows
  • Enterprise integrations
  • Cloud infrastructure


You do not need to build every layer yourself, but you should understand how the pieces fit together and be able to make sound technical decisions across the system.


Stay Hands On


This is not a pure management role.


You will be expected to:

  • Write and review production code
  • Build critical components yourself
  • Debug complex technical issues
  • Review system design and architecture
  • Prototype new approaches quickly
  • Help the team solve technically difficult problems


We expect you to be strongest in a few areas while being comfortable working across the broader stack.


Lead Small Engineering Team


Lead approximately 3–5 engineers across client engagements and internal development.


You will:

  • Set technical direction
  • Break complex problems into executable work
  • Review code and architecture
  • Mentor engineers
  • Maintain engineering quality
  • Manage technical priorities across multiple workstreams
  • Ensure solutions are reliable, maintainable and scalable


We are looking for someone who can raise the engineering bar while still helping the team move quickly.


Work Across Clients


Engineering at Bloom is client-facing.


You will work with both business and technical stakeholders to:

  • Understand business workflows
  • Translate problems into technical solutions
  • Assess feasibility
  • Define architecture
  • Explain technical trade-offs
  • Present prototypes and solutions
  • Work through enterprise technology constraints
  • Support deployment and adoption


You should be comfortable explaining technical decisions clearly without relying on unnecessary jargon.


What We're Looking For


  • 5–7 years of software engineering experience
  • Strong hands-on software development experience
  • Experience owning applications or systems end-to-end
  • Strong Python / backend development skills
  • Strong AI Experience and update knowledge of developments
  • Team leadership skills
  • Good understanding of modern frontend development
  • Experience designing and building APIs
  • Strong SQL and database fundamentals
  • Experience working with data-intensive applications
  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform
  • Good understanding of software architecture, testing and deployment


Why Bloom AI


We have an exciting roadmap and client problems that we are working on. You will join a team building the future model of AI in enterprise. You will be a part of core leadership team reporting to the CEO.

description:
About Beeline Medicines:

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. This individual partners closely with the Senior Director, Scientific Communications and cross-functional stakeholders in Clinical Development, Regulatory, Medical Affairs, and Commercial to translate clinical and translational data into clear, compliant, and scientifically rigorous materials for internal and external audiences.   • Support development and lead execution of the scientific communications plan in alignment with asset strategy and medical affairs objectives

title: Security Operations Manager
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Security Operations Manager to lead detection, response, and security monitoring for a self-clearing broker-dealer. You’ll build and lead the team and the 24x7 program that keeps our platform — and our advisors’ clients — safe.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the security operations / detection & response team, setting priorities and career paths.
  • Own our 24x7 security monitoring strategy across our managed detection & response provider
  • Run the incident response program end to end — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Define and report on SecOps metrics and SLAs (MTTD/MTTR, alert quality, coverage) to security and executive leadership.
  • Mature our detection engineering, threat-intelligence ingestion, and response automation (SOAR) capabilities.
  • Drive regular tabletop and purple-team exercises and partner with Cloud, IT, and Engineering to close gaps surfaced by monitoring.
  • Own the day-to-day operation and roadmap of the security operations tooling stack.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience - 6+ years in security operations, including 2+ years leading or managing a SOC or detection & response team:
  • Hands-on incident response and investigations in a cloud-first environment
  • Depth with SIEM (Datadog/Splunk), EDR/MDR (CrowdStrike/SentinelOne), and cloud telemetry (AWS)
  • Experience managing an MDR/MSSP and/or IR retainer relationship
  • Strong ability to lead through influence and operate with urgency
  • Education - A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
  • Technical aptitude - You’re technologically savvy and comfortable across modern cloud and detection stacks (i.e., AWS, Kubernetes, SIEM query languages, detection-as-code, Terraform, etc.)
  • Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
  • Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
  • Resilience - We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
  • Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
  • Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

  • Experience working in regulated environments (SEC/FINRA, fintech, or financial services)
  • Experience building or standing up a 24x7 SOC or transitioning to managed detection & response
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA)
San Francisco, CA salary range
$203,000—$275,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

  • Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
  • 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
  • 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
  • Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
  • Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
  • One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Professional Competencies

Contractors manage their assigned projects independently and are responsible for determining the manner, method, sequence and tools used to perform the work, subject to the applicable Work Order, required deliverables, agreed timelines, confidentiality obligations, security requirements and client-specific requirements.

Work Environment

  • hybrid;
  • client-site based;

The nature, location, scope and duration of each assignment will depend on the applicable client Work Order.

Our Approach

We seek advisors who can look beyond individual technologies and understand how people, processes, technology, risk, governance and organizational objectives must work together to create sustainable results.

description:
About this opportunity

The Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Advisor provides subject matter expertise and practical support to Site Leadership across one or more assigned manufacturing sites. The role supports the implementation of Group HSE policies, procedures and initiatives to foster safe, healthy and environmentally sustainable workplaces.

The position provides a connection between site, divisional and Group HSE activities and supports the consistent implementation of Group HSE systems across the assigned sites. It also supports compliance with relevant Australian health, safety, environmental and sustainability legislation, regulations and industry standards.

The role is primarily site based and requires a regular, visible presence across the assigned manufacturing sites. The allocation of sites may change in response to business priorities, risk profile and operational needs. Travel between sites will be required.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Partner with Site Leaders across multiple manufacturing sites to implement and maintain HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Conduct site audits, inspections, risk assessments, and support the completion of corrective actions.
  • Provide expert HSE advice, coaching, and training to leaders and employees to strengthen safety culture and compliance.
  • Lead and support incident investigations, ensuring effective reporting, corrective actions, and sharing of lessons learned.
  • Monitor, analyse, and report on HSE performance, identifying risks, trends, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain a regular site presence and apply a risk-based approach to managing priorities across multiple locations.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to integrate health, safety, environmental, and sustainability considerations into business operations.
  • Ensure compliance with Australian legislation, industry standards, and Group HSE requirements across all assigned sites.
  • Build relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including operational teams, regulatory bodies, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Support the delivery of key business outcomes through effective site audits, training programs, incident management, and HSE performance reporting.

Your skills and experience

To be successful in this role, you’ll have:

  • Experience in HSE within a manufacturing environment
  • Strong knowledge of Australian HSE legislation and compliance requirements
  • Experience in risk assessments and incident investigations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Ability to influence change across cross-functional teams
  • Experience supporting multiple sites and managing competing priorities
  • Current driver's licence and willingness to travel between sites
  • Relevant HSE qualifications (preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, occupational health and safety, sustainability, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Certificate IV in Workplace Health and Safety or Diploma of Work Health and Safety are advantageous.
  • Training and certifications in specific Australian regulations and standards relevant to manufacturing operations (e.g., WHS Act, AS/NZS ISO 45001:2018) are preferred.

About us

Our vision is to lead the circular economy through packaging, reuse and recycling solutions. It’s a future-driven group commitment, designed to create lasting value.

We’re the largest plastics recycler in Australia and New Zealand and one of the region’s biggest user of recycled materials. We have 6,000+ team members, operate 110 manufacturing facilities across 15 countries, and our customers include some of the world’s largest brands that consumers know and trust.

As a global leader in circular and sustainable packaging solutions, we’ve committed to lead the circular economy through a $500 million investment plan.

For us, it’s about finding new and better ways of doing things. Ways to grow business, to give back to the environment and to enrich people’s lives every day.

Our promise is to create a better and more prosperous world all round.

That’s our future Pact. Let’s lead the way together.

title: Chief Digital Officer
location: Body Art Alliance Support Center - HANOVER, MD 21076
description:
Why we're hiring this role

This Chief Digital Officer (CDO) seat at Body Art Alliance is open, and it's a big one. Here's the honest version: you'd be stepping into a capable team and real infrastructure across a multi-brand global platform, with real scale across the US and international markets, but growth has stalled and the operating model needs a reset. We want one leader who can see all of it clearly, diagnose what's actually not working, and fix it, including building the direct-to-consumer channel we don't have yet.

You're inheriting real infrastructure and people who know this business well. Your job is to figure out why growth has stalled, rebuild the operating model, and unify the strategy across our brands and markets.

About Body Art Alliance

Body Art Alliance is a global house of brands powering the world of tattooing, piercing, and body jewelry, including Painful Pleasures, Killer Ink, Anatometal, and NeoMetal. Our products fuel creativity, craftsmanship, and self-expression. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about our people and our customers. Operational excellence matters here, and so do culture, collaboration, and having fun while building something great.

The role, in plain terms

We're building one commercial operating model at BAA, where Product, Marketing, Sales, Digital, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance actually work together instead of around each other. As CDO, digital commercial capability is yours: ecommerce, digital marketing technology, CRM, customer analytics, loyalty, personalization, merchandising, marketplaces, and a new direct to consumer channel. You'll lead a team that knows this business well, across a house of brands with real scale in the US and internationally, with the VP of Digital Operations, VP of Ecommerce, and the Product team, as a whole, reporting directly to you. There's no single head of product today, so how you structure that is part of what you'd build. You'll also partner closely with our COO, CFO, SVP of Marketing, VP of Supply Chain, and Head of Sales. None of this works if you try to do it alone in a silo, and we're not looking for someone who wants to.

What you'd actually be doing

Set the digital strategy, then run it

  • Set BAA's global digital and ecommerce strategy and make sure it actually maps to where the business is trying to go
  • Push for real, profitable growth across ecommerce, marketplace, and DTC, not just top line revenue

Ecommerce and marketplace

  • Get more out of our existing ecommerce platforms across our house of brands
  • Sharpen how we show up on Amazon and other marketplaces
  • Take charge of CRM, personalization, customer analytics, subscriptions, and loyalty, the things that actually keep customers coming back
  • Decide where digital dollars and people go so the money lands on the highest return work first

Build the direct-to-consumer business

  • Build a DTC business for body jewelry and aftercare from scratch. This is the headline project, and it hasn't existed here before
  • Set DTC pricing and positioning carefully, so we're growing it without undercutting our wholesale distributors
  • Work hand in hand with our distribution sales team on one shared playbook: they build the relationship, you help scale it through CRM, education, personalization, loyalty, and digital engagement

Own the digital experience, everywhere

  • Take ownership of the digital experience across every BAA channel, even the ones where the revenue technically sits somewhere else, working closely with our COO, CFO, SVP of Marketing, VP of Supply Chain, and Head of Sales
  • Own the customer facing side: UX, conversion, site search, SEO, taxonomy, product pages, content, and the unglamorous but necessary QA work
  • Handle merchandising, storytelling, and cross selling across our house of brands, and whatever DTC brands come next

Get serious about data and the tech stack

  • Get us to a place where decisions are actually backed by data: forecasting, channel visibility, real metrics, real accountability
  • Work with the COO and Head of Sales on the channel conflict that's bound to come up between ecommerce, marketplaces, and distribution
  • Own the digital tech roadmap: our ecommerce platform, martech stack, and analytics infrastructure
  • Make sure digital operations work as well for the new DTC build as they do for our existing B2B and distribution business

Look ahead

  • Look for new digital revenue in the markets we're already in, and help us think through adjacent and international expansion
  • Support new product launches and innovation work as it goes to market

Lead the team

  • Lead and develop a team that knows this business, and bring the operating rigor and clear expectations it needs to start performing at a higher level
  • Hold people accountable and keep pushing for improvement across channels, functions, and geographies

What we'd expect from you in year one

Realistically, within your first year, we'd want to see you:

  • Get every digital revenue channel you own back to sustainable, organic growth
  • Build a clear prioritization framework for BAA's digital assets, and actually move team time to match it
  • Raise the digital experience across our priority channels, and get the DTC channel for body jewelry and aftercare launched and scaling
  • Stand up a digital operating model that works across our global footprint, and get our international brands' digital assets fully integrated across the US, EU, and UK

What you'd bring

You probably won't check every box here, and that's fine. But most of this should sound like you:

  • 12 or more years in senior digital, ecommerce, or CRM leadership, including real ownership of a P&L or a channel level revenue number, not just an advisory seat
  • You've built or scaled a direct-to-consumer business before, ideally one that had to coexist with an existing wholesale or distribution business
  • You're genuinely hands on with ecommerce platforms, martech, CRM, personalization, and analytics, and you know the difference between what's worth building and what you should just buy
  • You've led digital across more than one brand or business unit at once, ideally across multiple countries too, in consumer products, beauty, lifestyle, or something in that same family
  • You've worked somewhere private equity backed or otherwise fast moving, where you had to make real calls with limited resources
  • You actually like leading a team and working across a leadership table. This role falls apart if you'd rather build in isolation than lead the VP of Digital Operations, VP of Ecommerce, and the Product team while partnering with the COO, CFO, SVP of Marketing, VP of Supply Chain, and Head of Sales
  • You can read the data yourself, and you can also explain what it means to people who don't live in it all day

How we think about this role

Whoever takes this on is responsible for scaling BAA's customer relationships through digital, and for making sure every digital touchpoint reinforces our brands rather than working against them. We won't judge this role only on digital channel numbers. We'll judge it on how much stronger the whole company gets when digital strategy and execution move as one system across our global portfolio.

Why now

This is a big job, and we're not going to pretend otherwise. But it's also the kind of role that doesn't come open often: a real business to build, brands people already trust, and a CEO who wants a partner in this, not a hire to manage from a distance. This role reports directly to the CEO, with no other executive in between, so the strategy you set is the strategy that gets acted on.

Interested?

If this sounds like you, or you know someone who'd be great at it, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today. We can't wait to meet you!

Equal Opportunity

Body Art Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Vacature in Utrecht: Test Engineer / Data & AI / Cypress / veel remote
description:
De Organisatie:

Ben jij als Test Engineer op zoek naar een complexe omgeving waar data & AI centraal staan, waar je veel met test automation mag doen en waar je slechts 1 keer per week naar kantoor hoeft? Dan ben je hier aan het juiste adres!

Mijn klant is een data-driven organisatie wat grote hoeveelheden klantdata (business-to-business) beheert en vertaalt naar relevante analyses voor tal van grote organisaties in Nederland. Denk hierbij aan goede doelen, retailers etc. waarvoor zij analyses maken op het gebied van sales, marketing, management en meer. Ze zijn hierin groeiende en zoeken momenteel voor een nieuw Data / AI-team een dedicated test engineer die zaken onder meer gaat automatiseren.

De organisatie is heel modern en flexibel. Zo werkt het developmentteam op donderdag op kantoor en dat is dan ook een belangrijke dag voor jouw aanwezigheid. De overige dagen van de week ben je flexibel om te gaan of staan waar je wilt; of je nou naar kantoor komt of lekker vanuit huis werkt. Het is volledig jouw keuze! Om de samenwerking en binding met de organisatie desondanks goed te houden, organiseren ze meerdere keren per jaar leuke activiteiten zoals bierproeverijen, spelletjesavonden of een ander event.

De Functie:

Als Test Engineer kom je te werken binnen het development team dat werkt aan het CDP; het zogenaamde Customer Data Platform. Momenteel bestaat dit team uit 5 developers maar nog geen test engineer. Er zijn intern wel andere teams met test engineers dus er is wat dat betreft voldoende ruimte om met hen te sparren en kennis te delen. Maar ook binnen het team sta je er niet alleen voor. Het testen wordt nu namelijk gedaan door de developers en zij hebben dus ook zeker voldoende inhoudelijke kennis van (het automatiseren van) testen. Ze willen echter nu een volwaardig testprofessional aannemen die het testen naar een hoger niveau gaat tillen.

Dat betekent dat je betrokken bent bij de gehele testcyclus; van het opstellen van het testplan, het bepalen van de teststrategie tot het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren van testen. De nadruk ligt hier wel echt op het uitvoerende aspect en ze zoeken wat dat betreft iemand die lekker hands-on bezig wil zijn. Er is het afgelopen jaar een groot begin gemaakt (door 1 van de developers dus) met Cypress om het testen van workflows binnen de datasets te automatiseren en men wil dit verder uitbreiden. Ervaring met Cypress is dan ook echt een vereiste. Verder kent het data platform ontzettend veel koppelingen met grote externe partijen als Facebook, Amazon, Azure etc. en dus is het ook erg fijn wanneer je ervaring hebt met API Testing.

Als laatste is de organisatie momenteel druk bezig met het implementeren van Agentic AI. Het is dan ook een groot pluspunt wanneer je reeds wat ervaring hebt met het toepassen van AI binnen je testwerk maar dat is geen must. Er moet wel affiniteit zijn om hiermee aan de slag te gaan want de toekomst = AI!

De datasets zijn enorm en de technische uitdaging is complex dus naast de technische specificaties zoeken ze eveneens mensen met een goed analytisch vermogen en cijfermatig inzicht.

Gevraagd Profiel:

  • Je hebt minimaal Hbo werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als test engineer.
  • Je hebt minimaal 1 maar het liefst meerdere jaren ervaring met test automation middels Cypress.
  • Je hebt kennis van 1 of meerdere programmeertalen (.NET / Java / Python / JavaScript).
  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met API Testing (Postman).
  • Je hebt affiniteit met (Agentic) AI.
  • Je bent cijfermatig sterk, analytisch erg vaardig en houdt van een complexe uitdaging.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Naast een technisch uitdagende rol met de nieuwste technieken, kom je te werken in een prettige organisatie waar een zeer goede privé-/werkbalans heerst.

  • Het salaris reikt tot 5500 euro bruto per maand. Verdien je iets meer en sluit je érg goed aan op de rol, dan is er eventueel wat rek mogelijk!
  • 1 dag per week op kantoor (donderdag), de rest vanuit huis mogelijk!
  • Een goed pensioen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding.
  • Prima opleidingsbudget om trainingen, opleidingen en cursussen te volgen.
  • Regelmatig leuke acitiviteiten zoals bierproeverijen, spelletjesavonden of andere events.

Salaris:

4000 – 6000 euro

Uren per week

Fulltime (32-40 uur)

Functie met:

Vaste werklocatie, werken in een vast team, niet te ver reizen, vaste werkplek, vaste standplaats

Specialisatie:

Quality assurance Engineer

Gerelateerd:

Vacancy Quality assurance Engineer, Vacature technisch tester, Software testing

Plaatsen in de omgeving:

Houten, Nieuwegein, Woerden, De Meern, Vianen, IJsselstein

Gerelateerde vacatures:

Utrecht: Testmanager (5500 euro bpm + bonus + leaseauto + hybride)!
IJsselstein: Software Tester binnen prettig testteam
Utrecht: Test Engineer (€75.000 per jaar obv 36 uur!)

title: Senior React Native developer(Android)

Why Join Us?

Odyssey Cloud is a boutique digital consulting firm that designs and delivers customized cloud and digital solutions for clients across Australia. We're technology-agnostic and outcome-focused, choosing the right tools for the job rather than a one-size-fits-all approach. Our engineers work across a range of industries and platforms, which means genuinely varied, interesting work and the chance to build expertise that goes beyond any single stack.

About the Role and Team

You'll join a small, high-performing engineering team delivering mobile solutions for our clients, currently focused on building world-class audio and media experiences used by millions of Australians. This is a hands-on senior role with real ownership: you'll shape architecture decisions, set the bar for code quality, and work directly with product managers, designers, QA, and client stakeholders to take features from concept to release.

This is a fully remote role based in India. You'll work closely with our Australian-based client teams, so some overlap with AEST business hours is expected.

A Day in the Life

As a Senior React Native Engineer (Android), you'll lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance mobile solutions, mentoring engineers and driving best practices across the team. You'll own complex features end-to-end, optimize for performance and reliability, and keep a close eye on emerging technologies to help guide strategic decisions for the platforms you work on. You'll also play a key role in bridging technical and client-facing conversations, translating complexity into clarity.

  • Extensive commercial experience building iOS and Android apps with React Native
  • Strong hands-on experience in native Android development (Kotlin/Java)
  • Advanced understanding of mobile app architectures, performance optimization, and usability principles
  • Proven experience with native modules and complex third-party integrations

  • Experience with Expo framework and modern React Native development tooling
  • Knowledge of HLS streaming, Chromecast, or CarPlay/Android Auto integration is a strong plus
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders
  • What We OfferFully remote work from anywhere in India
  • Varied client work across industries with no two engagements the same
  • A small team where your decisions actually matter
  • Exposure to Australian-scale products with millions of end users
