title: Lead React Native Developer
description:
ABOUT OOLIO:

Oolio is a leading B2B SaaS platform transforming how hospitality venues operate and grow. Trusted by more than 22,000 venues, we power mission-critical POS, payments, online ordering, kiosks, loyalty, kitchen management, and real-time insights — all within one connected ecosystem.


We are building the operating system for modern hospitality — simplifying complex operations, accelerating service, and unlocking smarter, data-driven decisions. Built by hospitality professionals with decades of industry experience, we understand the realities of every shift, every service rush, and every guest interaction. From cafés and quick-service restaurants to pubs, multi-site groups, and stadiums, Oolio enables venues to operate seamlessly at scale. With next-business-day settlements, powerful third-party integrations, and 24/7 real human support, we go beyond software — we become long-term partners in growth.


As a rapidly scaling product-led organisation, we’re shaping the future of hospitality technology.

We build the technology backbone that powers modern hospitality businesses to perform, compete, and thrive at scale.


JOB DESCRIPTION:

At Oolio, Lead React Native Engineers are builders first and mobile performance champions always. You will own mobile engineering excellence, application performance, developer velocity, and architectural standards across our core B2B SaaS platforms in a high-growth scale-up environment.


You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Backend, and Platform teams to build high-performance React Native applications, accelerate AI-driven development workflows, and establish scalable mobile architecture foundations that deliver exceptional cross-platform user experiences.


This role sits at the intersection of mobile architecture, AI tooling, developer productivity, observability, and performance engineering — driving both product impact and engineering effectiveness across iOS and Android ecosystems.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own delivery of complex, high-scale React Native features — from architecture and design to deployment, performance optimization, release management, and customer impact.
  • Lead mobile architecture discussions, defining scalable patterns for state management, modular design, reusable component systems, responsive UI development, and platform-specific optimizations.
  • Develop highly performant, responsive, and reliable cross-platform mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript.
  • Drive AI-enabled development workflows (Cursor, Devin, Windsurf, etc.) to significantly improve developer productivity and engineering velocity.
  • Deeply understand and optimize React Native internals — reconciliation process, rendering lifecycle, bridge communication, memory management, and runtime performance.
  • Continuously optimize application responsiveness, startup time, rendering performance, bundle size, and mobile runtime efficiency.
  • Implement efficient background task handling, deferred/non-critical task execution, lazy loading strategies, and low-level performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with backend teams to design and integrate scalable GraphQL APIs using Apollo GraphQL and clean contract-driven development practices.
  • Own debugging and root cause analysis across mobile platforms — identifying performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, crashes, rendering inefficiencies, and production issues.
  • Work extensively with Xcode, Android Studio, Instruments, profiling tools, and native debugging ecosystems to diagnose and resolve complex mobile issues.
  • Define and enforce high engineering quality standards through unit testing, integration testing, and end-to-end testing practices.
  • Drive developer experience improvements — CI/CD optimization, mobile release automation, reproducible development environments, build acceleration, and deployment reliability.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, crash reporting, and performance tracking solutions to ensure production stability and visibility.
  • Collaborate closely with DevOps, Product, QA, Security, and Backend teams to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable mobile systems.
  • Make pragmatic, cost-conscious engineering decisions balancing velocity, scalability, security, quality, maintainability, and mobile platform constraints.


REQUIREMENTS:

Role: Lead React Native Engineer – final role will depend on candidate experience and credentials

Experience: 8 – 15 Years experience (Primarily in product-based B2B SaaS organisations)

Education: Pref – MCA / B.Tech / B.E / M.Tech / M.E / M.S

Technology Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Apollo GraphQL, Mobile Performance Optimization, CI/CD, Mobile Build Systems, Xcode, Android Studio, Debugging & Profiling Tools, Responsive UI Development, Testing Frameworks, Monitoring & Observability


OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Strong hands-on expertise in building scalable React Native applications from scratch.
  • Deep understanding of TypeScript and modern JavaScript ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of how React Native works internally — reconciliation process, rendering lifecycle, bridge architecture, and performance optimization techniques.
  • Hands-on expertise in responsive UI development and adaptive layouts across multiple devices and screen sizes.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile build systems, CI/CD pipelines, release pipelines, signing processes, and deployment workflows for iOS and Android.
  • Experience with Apollo GraphQL and contract-driven API integration.
  • Strong understanding of low-level memory management, background tasks, deferred/non-critical task execution, and runtime optimization.
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills across JavaScript, native mobile layers, and production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Xcode, Android Studio, Instruments, profiling tools, and crash/performance debugging.
  • Strong understanding of rendering optimization, lazy loading, bundle optimization, runtime efficiency, and mobile responsiveness.
  • Experience implementing end-to-end testing, automated testing strategies, and quality engineering practices.
  • Understanding of mobile application security principles, secure coding practices, and production-grade application hardening.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry, Datadog, New Relic, or similar tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Devin, Windsurf, etc.) to accelerate engineering workflows.
  • Exposure to native mobile modules (Swift, Kotlin, Objective-C, Java) is an added advantage.
  • Systems thinker who writes clearly — comfortable drafting RFCs, documenting decisions, and leading technical discussions.

title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to join our growing Security team. You’ll build the detections and response capability that find and stop threats across our cloud, endpoints, and identity providers.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

Your impact

  • Build, tune, and maintain high-fidelity detections as code across SIEM, cloud, endpoint , and identity telemetry.
  • Triage and investigate alerts, lead response on security incidents, and proactively threat-hunt for “low and slow” and insider activity.
  • Operationalize threat intelligence and IOC ingestion into detections and edge/WAF rules.
  • Develop response playbooks and automation (SOAR) to reduce toil and speed containment.
  • Partner with our MDR and IR partners and run purple-team exercises with our red team security engineers.
  • Continuously improve logging coverage and detection efficacy, measured against MITRE ATT&CK.

title: Data Engineer (Hybrid)
description:
We are currently seeking a Data Engineer to join our team.

The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and managing assets and pipelines for data collection, storage, and analysis within Microsoft and Oracle environments. This role involves integrating large datasets from multiple sources to ensure that data is accessible, consistent, and of high quality for reporting/dashboards, insights, and analytics. Experience is required with Microsoft Azure cloud services, SQL Server, Oracle Database, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure to develop scalable data solutions. Additionally, responsibilities include ensuring our data pipelines are robust and secure, supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Here’s what would be included as a part of your typical day

  1. Design and Develop Data Pipelines: Creates scalable data pipelines and ETL processes to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from Microsoft and Oracle systems into centralized repositories. Use Fabric, Azure Data Factory and Oracle Data Integrator for efficient data extraction and transformation.
  2. Data Storage & Management: Create and manage databases, data warehouses, and data lakes on Microsoft SQL Server/Azure and Oracle. Ensure high performance and reliability by designing, indexing, and partitioning relational databases. Monitor and tune database health to meet business needs.
  3. Ensure Data Quality, Security, and Governance: Implement data quality controls, validation rules, and cleansing processes to maintain the integrity and accuracy of data within pipelines. Adhere to data governance standards and security protocols across both platforms, incorporating data masking or encryption where necessary, to ensure compliance with industry regulations and corporate policies.
  4. Develop and Optimize Data Models: Design efficient data models and schemas for analytics and reporting on Azure and Oracle. Structure databases and data warehouses to support querying and BI reporting, and update architecture as needed.
  5. Data Insights Support: Work with analytics teams to ensure that data is available and appropriately structured for BI tools. Provide curated datasets or views for reporting and assist in the creation of dashboards and reports, particularly with Microsoft Power BI, to convert raw data into actionable insights.
  6. Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Monitor data pipeline and database performance and quickly resolve any issues. Use monitoring tools and logs to identify anomalies or bottlenecks. Optimize SQL queries, ETL jobs, and storage designs to improve throughput and reduce latency or cost.
  7. Reporting and Dashboarding: Design and develop efficient reports and dashboards in Power Bi-Microsoft Fabric and Oracle Analytics Cloud Platforms

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field required.
  • 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform management or related roles, or a combination of education and experience
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and devise efficient solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical information into business terms for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects and deadlines efficiently.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • A growth mindset and eagerness to stay updated with new technologies and industry best practices.
  • Expertise in data engineering, data management and data integration tools and technology stack
  • Expertise in data modeling, database design, and data integration.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, and other relevant programming languages.
  • Displays an understanding of risk and risk ownership by being able to demonstrate adherence to policies and procedures.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize and remain effective during incidents or high-pressure situations.
  • Mentoring mindset with a focus on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

  • Real impact on global fintech transformation projects.
  • Growth and learning opportunities within an innovative group.

  • Technical Evaluation: Show us your expertise.
  • Team Fit Discussion: Ensure mutual alignment with our culture.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: Discuss your experience and vision.


Every selection process is an opportunity for mutual discovery and shared growth.


Our Culture

At BKN301, we believe innovation thrives when different perspectives meet.

Working across multiple countries and markets, we value collaboration, mutual respect, and the unique contributions that help us build stronger teams and better products.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a fair and inclusive environment for all.

title: Backend Developer (Kotlin/Java, Microservices, Kafka) – Gambit – Albert Heijn Nederland – Zaandam
description:
Maak impact als Backend Developer (Kotlin/Java, Microservices, Kafka, DevOps) binnen het Ad-Tech Cluster van Albert Heijn!
Retail media is booming, en wij bouwen aan een geavanceerd platform om alle Ahold-merken in Europa & USA te ondersteunen met een complete suite aan retail mediaoplossingen. Je werkt in een high-traffic omgeving aan een SaaS-oplossing die gebruikt zal worden door ongeveer 15 verschillende merken, verspreid over Europa en de USA.
Albert Heijn vult met 125.000 collega’s, verdeeld over ruim 1.250 winkels in Nederland en Vlaanderen, negen home shop centers, zeven distributiecentra en ons hoofdkantoor elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden.

Jouw nieuwe baan en werkplek.
Binnen het Ad-Tech Cluster ontwikkelen en implementeren we een retail media SaaS-oplossing voor alle Ahold Delhaize-merken in Europa & USA. Retail media draait om het verkopen van advertentieruimte op onze digitale kanalen en in de fysieke winkel. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Het promoten van merken zoals Tony’s Chocolonely.als een klant zoekt op "chocolade" in onze app en webshop.
  • Advertenties op digitale schermen binnen of buiten de winkel.
  • Banners met leveranciersbranding op de homepage of categoriepagina’s.
  • Het verkennen van nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen dit snelgroeiende domein.

Ons cluster, onderdeel van het Customer Tech Platform, is verantwoordelijk voor een flexibele, kostenefficiënte en hoogwaardige retail media suite met uitgebreide functionaliteiten. Kwaliteit, vernieuwing en ondernemerschapo gaan hier hand in hand.
We hebben hier een scale-up sfeer, verdeeld over 16 teams, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om initiatief te nemen. Dankzij onze agile werkwijze krijg je de kans om echt impact te maken en je vaardigheden te laten zien.
In deze functie werk je 32-40 uren per week, deels vanuit ons hoofdkantoor Zaandam en deels vanuit huis.

Dit ga je als Backend Developer bij ons doen.

  • Je sluit je aan bij een agile team en neemt eigenaarschap over specifieke productgebieden binnen onze suite.
  • Je verbetert bestaande functionaliteiten en ontwikkelt nieuwe features, altijd met het brede scala aan merken in gedachten.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met de product owner en je teamleden om innovatieve ideeën voor nieuwe functionaliteiten te verkennen en te realiseren.
  • Je gaat de uitdaging aan om een schaalbare SaaS-oplossing te ontwikkelen voor meerdere retailers.
  • Je geeft prioriteit aan geautomatiseerde end-to-end tests en bewaakt de kwaliteit van de code.
  • Je houdt rekening met de gehele product suite, niet alleen met jouw eigen aandachtsgebied.
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces: “build, ship and run”. Dit betekent dat je ook support levert en stand‑by diensten draait.
  • Je werkt dagelijks aan verbeteringen en draagt actief nieuwe ideeën aan om onze producten en processen te optimaliseren.

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij bij Albert Heijn jezelf kunt zijn in een omgeving die openstaat voor verschillende perspectieven, een omgeving waarin we nieuwsgierig zijn en elkaar waarderen. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die de diversiteit in ons team, in de breedste zin van het woord, versterkt. Iemand die vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen een ander geluid brengt en daarmee een goede aanvulling is op ons team.

Dit bieden we jou.

  • Een jaarsalaris tot €100K, inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibele bonus. Afhankelijk van je ervaring.
  • 20 vakantiedagen
  • Een keuzebudget, dat ingezet kan worden voor 12,5 extra vrije dagen. Anders kan je dit budget ruilen voor kortingen of laten uitbetalen. Jij beslist.
  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling bij het Ahold Delhaize Pensioenfonds.
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding of NS-trajectkaart om van en naar Zaandam te reizen.
  • 10% korting op je boodschappen bij Albert Heijn, tot maximaal €300 per jaar.
  • Een Mijn Albert Heijn Premium abonnement met vele voordelen.
  • Via onze Albert Heijn Deals ontvang je exclusieve kortingen op leuke uitjes en producten van grote merken.
  • Een inclusieve omgeving waarin je op persoonlijk en vakinhoudelijk vlak continu kan blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit breng je mee.
Met onze 125.000 collega’s vullen we elke avond ruim zeven miljoen borden. En als het aan ons ligt, doen we dat binnenkort ook samen met jou als onze nieuwe backend developer. Zeker als je Java/Kotlin, Kafka en ‘honger naar succes met je team’ naar Albert Heijn meebrengt. Ook heb je:

  • 6+ jaar ervaring als java of kotlin developer
  • Hands-on ervaring met Kotlin/Java (11+), Microservices Architectuur. Een dike plus als je ook ervaring hebt met zaken als Kafka, MongoDB, Postgres, and APIs.
  • Je bent thuis in CI/CD practices en een (MS Azure/AKS) clound omgving.
  • Scherp op testen, test automatisering en observability
  • Je hebt AI inmiddels ‘embedded’ in je development proces en staat open voor meer.
  • Ervaring met retail media en/of ontwikkelen voor een SaaS-product is een flink pluspunt.
  • Een passie om het beste product van de wereld te maken

Daarnaast ben je:

  • Iemand die teamwork eet en drinkt, en de status quo op een positieve manier ter discussie stelt
  • Een tech-savvy persoon, pro-actief, die pragmatisch maar robuust op zoek gaat naar een oplossing om een klantprobleem op te lossen
  • Iemand die houdt van teamwork, greenfield, experimenten, maar ook recht op het doel af gaat.
  • Breder georiënteerd dan alleen software ontwikkelen. Bouwen is 1 ding, maar samen met je team weten wat het probleem is, en daaarvoor de juiste vragen weet te stellen is een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk.

Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.
Bij Albert Heijn geloven we dat eten en drinken een essentiële rol speelt bij de grote uitdagingen in de maatschappij. Het levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan een gezonde levensstijl, het verbindt mensen en draagt bij aan een beter klimaat en daarmee een duurzame samenleving. Onze missie is dan ook: Samen beter eten bereikbaar maken. Voor iedereen.
Albert Heijn Nederland is B Corp gecertificeerd. Deze certificering onderstreept onze missie waarmee het een bijdrage levert aan een gezonde, sociale en duurzame samenleving. De B Corp certificering wordt toegekend aan bedrijven die voldoen aan hoge normen voor sociale- en milieuprestaties, transparantie en wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat we vragen?

  • Een aanpakkersmentaliteit
  • Een verbindend karakter
  • Sterke tech skills

title: Information Technology (IT) Consultant - Legal & Public Sector
description:

Client assignments may involve law firms, government ministries, courts and tribunals, professional organizations, regulated environments, corporations or other complex institutions.

Assignments may be performed remotely or may require attendance at a client site for project meetings, technology assessments, workshops, implementation activities, stakeholder engagement or other project requirements.

Depending on the assignment, contractors may work independently or collaborate with Matrix advisors, technical specialists and other professionals.

Assignment & Project Management

Client-Site & Stakeholder Engagement

Relevant Technology Experience

Our Approach

Our consultants are expected to bring independent professional judgment while collaborating appropriately with Matrix and authorized client stakeholders throughout an engagement.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role Overview


We are looking for a Senior Full-stack Back-office Tools Engineer to own and build the B2B back-office platform that powers our partner operations. This is a high-ownership role where you will shape the product from the ground up and influence how the team scales around it.


You will be the go-to engineer for everything back-office: from game performance reporting and audit trails to fraud analysis tooling and partner-facing game configuration interfaces.


Key Responsibilities



  • Back-office Platform Ownership: Design, build, and maintain the full-stack B2B back-office platform, including partner dashboards, admin panels, and internal tools.

  • Game Performance Reporting: Build reporting systems that give partners and internal teams clear visibility into game metrics, player activity, and revenue performance.

  • Audit & Compliance Tooling: Develop audit reporting tools that support regulatory requirements and external compliance reviews.

  • Fraud Analysis: Build and maintain fraud analysis and monitoring tools to detect and surface anomalous activity across partner environments.

  • Game Configuration & Customization: Create interfaces that allow partners to configure game parameters, promotions, and live-ops settings without engineering involvement.

  • API Design & Integration: Design and implement APIs that connect the back-office platform to backend services, data stores, and partner-facing systems.

  • AI-Augmented Workflow: Leverage and advocate for modern LLM-augmented development practices to accelerate delivery and improve quality.

  • Code Quality: Maintain a high bar for quality through PR reviews, automated testing, and technical documentation.


Leadership & Collaboration



  • Team Growth: As the team grows, participate in hiring and mentor junior engineers, helping to establish engineering standards and shared ownership of quality.

  • Product Mindset: Think from the end-user perspective — both partners managing their game portfolio and internal teams needing operational insight.

  • Work closely with cross-functional team members including game engineers, DevOps, and product leadership.

  • Strategic Thinking: Collaborate with leadership on prioritization and roadmap for the back-office platform.

  • Autonomy: Comfortable operating in a \"dynamic startup\" environment where you are expected to define your own roadmap and communicate / present to other team members / departments.


Skills and Qualifications



  • 5+ Years of Experience: Proven track record building full-stack web applications, with experience in data-heavy dashboards, admin tools, or reporting platforms.

  • Front-end Proficiency: Strong experience with modern front-end frameworks (Vue, React) and TypeScript.

  • Back-end Proficiency: Solid experience building APIs and services in TypeScript/Node.js. Experience with C# or Python is a plus.

  • Experience with modern LLM-augmented workflows.

  • Degree in sciences/CS/engineering preferred but not required. We look for experience and passion.


Bonus Points



  • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms or B2B tooling.

  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js, ECharts).

  • Experience in regulated industries (banking, gaming, iGaming, fintech).

  • Familiarity with fraud detection patterns or audit/compliance tooling.

  • Experience with message brokers (NATS, Kafka) or event-driven architectures.


Our Tech Stack



  • Front-end: TypeScript, Vue, React.

  • Back-end: TypeScript (Node.js), with some tooling in C# and Python.

  • Cloud/Infra: AWS (ECS, Lambda, Pulumi), GitHub Actions.

  • Data/Messaging: PostgreSQL, Redis, NATS.

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch.


You Are…



  • Action-Oriented: Delivers results through effective cross-functional collaboration. Get stuff done.

  • Takes Ownership: Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex systems with minimal oversight while engaging the team proactively.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Proactive in cross-team communications. Communicates clearly. Communicates changes and impacts proactively. Document changes and technical impacts.

  • Decisive: Exercising high judgment on when to refactor vs. when to ship.

title: Principal Asset Lifecycle Analyst-Nashville
description:
The Principal Business Process Analyst - Asset Lifecycle Optimization will lead complex business process improvement initiatives across OCI’s data center asset lifecycle.

OCI’s infrastructure lifecycle spans purchasing, receiving, deployment, inventory management, repair, reuse, redeployment, recovery, decommissioning, disposition, and financial reconciliation. As OCI continues to scale, fragmented processes, disconnected systems, inconsistent data, and manual reconciliation create operational effort, financial exposure, and missed opportunities to recover asset value.

This role will identify and quantify lifecycle inefficiencies, determine root causes, define future-state business processes and controls, translate business needs into process and system requirements, and drive improvements through implementation and sustainment.

The position partners across Data Center Operations, Asset Management, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and other technical and business teams. The successful candidate will combine strong business process analysis, data-driven problem solving, continuous improvement, stakeholder influence, and operational judgment.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience independently leading complex business process improvement initiatives, using operational data to identify root causes and measure outcomes, translating business objectives into process and system requirements, and influencing technical and business stakeholders across organizational boundaries. The role requires strong structured problem solving, operational judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments with limited direction.

This is an individual contributor role focused on creating durable mechanisms and measurable business outcomes rather than coordinating activity or maintaining manual processes.

**NOTE: this role is based in Nashville, TN and is in the office 5 days a week. Relocation assistance is available for those that qualify.

  • Lead complex asset lifecycle business process improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and sustainment, operating independently across non-routine and ambiguous problem areas.
  • Identify and quantify lifecycle waste, recurring manual work, reconciliation effort, stranded or excess inventory, process exceptions, control gaps, and opportunities to improve asset utilization or recovery.
  • Analyze operational and system data to establish baselines, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and measure business outcomes.
  • Define scalable future-state business processes, controls, ownership models, exception paths, and measurable success criteria.
  • Translate business objectives into clear process, data, control, reporting, and system requirements.
  • Improve trust in asset lifecycle data by defining critical data requirements, ownership expectations, source-of-truth principles, and reconciliation mechanisms.
  • Drive process improvements across asset movement, inventory integrity, reuse, redeployment, recovery, disposition, and related lifecycle workflows, partnering with accountable program and domain owners.
  • Apply lean and continuous improvement principles to eliminate unnecessary process steps, duplicate handling, recurring exceptions, and manual reconciliation.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations using measurable operational and financial outcomes such as cycle time, reconciliation effort, exception rates, asset utilization, recovery value, and avoided spend.
  • Partner with engineering, product, automation, and business teams to replace recurring manual work with scalable workflows and controls.
  • Drive alignment and accountable execution across matrixed technical and business organizations without direct authority, presenting recommendations and obtaining stakeholder agreement on process, control, and system changes.
  • Support operational implementation and adoption to ensure redesigned processes remain effective after transition.
  • Provide leadership-ready analysis, recommendations, decision support, risk summaries, and clear articulation of trade-offs and dependencies.
  • Provide functional guidance and mentoring in business process analysis, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

*** NOTE: this role is based in Nashville, TN and is in the office 5 days a week. Relocation assistance is available for those that qualify.

Als Senior Developer denk ik mee vanaf het begin: ik overleg met de Product Owner, Tech Lead en UX Designer en help de richting van het project bepalen. Meestal ben ik bezig met coderen, maar ik haal ook veel voldoening uit Pair Programming en het begeleiden van mijn teamgenoten. Als iemand vastloopt, kloppen ze vaak bij mij aan voor advies – ik vind het mooi om samen verder te komen en kwaliteit te blijven leveren.”

“Wat ons werk zo bijzonder maakt, is de échte impact. Sommige van onze producten worden gebruikt in apotheken om patiënten sneller en nauwkeuriger te helpen. Andere helpen scholieren op een leukere manier grammatica te leren. Die maatschappelijke waarde motiveert me enorm. Wat voor mij echt telt, is teamgeest en de Pack-mentaliteit. We hebben veel leuke events en een sterke bedrijfscultuur. Voor ons eindigt de vrijdag met een leuke borrel, met natuurlijk onze eigen Wolfpack-bier.”

Wat we zoeken

Je bent een teamplayer met een passie voor goed geschreven code. Je neemt graag eigenaarschap, deelt actief je kennis en draagt bij aan een positieve teamsfeer. Jij bent niet alleen developer, maar ook mentor, probleemoplosser en kartrekker.


Wat de pack van jou nodig heeft:

  • Minimaal 6 jaar hands-on ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar met C#/.NET, met focus op back-end;

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden en coachen van teamleden;

  • Goede kennis van softwarearchitectuur, Clean Code-principes en geautomatiseerd testen;

  • Een Agile mindset en ervaring in Scrumteams;

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, met gevoel voor zowel technische als zakelijke belangen;

  • Up-to-date kennis van Azure-diensten zoals: Cosmos DB, Application Insights, Data Factory, enz.;

  • Grondige kennis van Git, CI/CD pipelines, en het handhaven van codekwaliteit via pull requests;

  • Een proactieve instelling en de wil om jezelf en het team continu te verbeteren.

Deel worden van de pack:

Bij Wolfpack word je onderdeel van een groeiend team van meer dan dertig slimme, gedreven developers. We zijn gepassioneerd over het bouwen van kwalitatieve software én data. We investeren graag in talent.

Onze kernwaarden? Pack of Hungry Creators. Die staan voor: Teamwork & Trust, Learning & Dedication, Pride & Creation.

Je werkt vanuit een van onze multidisciplinaire teams op ons kantoor in Eindhoven, gelegen op de campus van de TU/e. We bieden flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken. Ons kantoor is een plek voor samenwerking, innovatie en onderlinge support.

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een competitief salaris, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en vaardigheden;

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een duurzame groene pensioenregeling en ondersteuning bij persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Slimme collega’s die graag kennis delen en met elkaar groeien;

  • Een gezonde, gebalanceerde werkomgeving. Agile teams met duidelijke focus en minimale context switching;

  • Een informele sfeer met professionele mensen;

  • Hybride werken – kom naar kantoor om te verbinden, samenwerken en leren;

  • Een sterke teamcultuur met sociale events, workshops, teamactiviteiten en onvergetelijke Workations.

Ready to run with the Pack? Solliciteer nu en laten we samen geweldige software bouwen.

title: Medior Backend Developer (Kotlin)
description:
Are you ready to be a part of something transformative? Join the AH Stores as a Medior Kotlin Developer and embark on a journey to reshape our traditional tech infrastructure into a modern, cutting-edge technology landscape that touches the lives of millions of customers daily!

As a Medior Kotlin Developer, you'll play a leading role in our ongoing transformation and micro service adventure. If you have a fervor for working with leading tech stacks like Kotlin, Java, Kafka, helping make amazing applications for the Stores landscape, and much more, then this is the ideal place for you!

This is how you will reinvent food retail.

  • Build a greenfield microservices architecture on Kotlin for the Stores Cluster
  • Develop technical solutions in line with our systems and business process architecture;
  • Develop proofs of concept, build code, implement and execute automated testing, ensure security and code quality, develop best practices and execute automated testing;
  • Further enhance our technical standards and guidelines;
  • Work closely within a product team, participating in agile ceremonies, story refinement, code changes, deployments, and production support activities.
  • Share your expertise and contribute to initiatives and your product cluster and the broader AH Technology Platform;
  • Develop the team’s skills and processes to deliver value as quickly as possible.

As Medior Engineer, you are an essential part of your product team. Your team develops and supports multiple applications delivering one or more capabilities for our brands in The Netherlands. You will work closely with ourProduct Ownerand Product Architect, to develop our technology landscape. Business technology and Solution consultants will support you and the rest of the team to identify requirements and find the best possible solutions.

Your office.

Together with your team you will work on inspiring projects to accelerate our transition into a hybrid Food & Tech company. We want to leverage data and technology to future-proof food shopping and give our customers accessibility to healthy food more easily available for everyone. At Albert Heijn, you team up with inspiring peers in the data, digital and tech domains. A community of diverse individuals who share a common goal; to create digital solutions that make (online) shopping simpler and more inspiring. Are you ready to reinvent the way millions of people buy and enjoy their food? We invest heavily in data, digital and tech. And that includes investing in your career! Our teams work in a hybrid way: both from home as well as in the office. We are located right next to the train station Zaandam.

We think it’s important to be part of an high-belonging team; a team where you can be yourself and feel safe, accepted and appreciated. For this job we are preferably looking for someone who brings diversity in our team, in the widest possible sense. Someone who is a great addition to our team by bringing other ideas to the table. So don’t check all the boxes? Don’t worry, we probably don’t either.

What we offer.

At Albert Heijn we aim to grow, and this is only possible if you grow along with us. As we work together to build our brand and your career, you can count on (based on 40 hours per week):

  • An annual salary up to 78k including holiday allowance and a flexible bonus. Depending on your experience;
  • 45 days of paid leave to enjoy your well-deserved holidays: 25,5 regular vacation days and 19,5 ADV days. Enjoy!
  • Flexible working hours;
  • Access to a challenging training curriculum – AH Tech Academy;
  • An excellent pension plan where we as an employer contribute 4,5 more than you as an employee;
  • A travel allowance or a NS-business card for traveling to and from Zaandam by train;
  • Attractive discounts on various insurance policies;
  • 10% staff discount on groceries in all Albert Heijn stores, to a maximum of €300 per year;
  • A free Mijn Albert Heijn Premium membership with many benefits;
  • A company laptop and telephone.

The recipe for maximum impact.

  • A Technology/IT Engineering Master or Bachelor degree;
  • 3+ years experience working as Medior Engineer working in a complex (corporate) Technology environment;
  • Broad technical knowledge including Kotlin/Java, Microservices, Cloud (preferably Azure and OCI), API and non-functional requirements such as scalability and technical security;
  • Knowledge on event streaming and messaging platform (Kafka) is a big plus;
  • Knowledge and experience on Agile;
  • An outstanding command of English;
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work within a team;
  • Already located in The Netherlands.

We’re Albert Heijn, food retail reinventors.

The NetDevOps Consultant will drive network integration, automation, and orchestration across cloud, edge, and enterprise environments aligned to a Modern Ops and AI-first operating model. Drive AI/ML use cases such as WAN capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and self-healing networks.

Integrate and manage observability platforms (SolarWinds Orion, Elastic, Grafana, ZDX) for proactive monitoring and insights.

Mentor engineers and contribute to best practices in NetDevOps, automation, and reliability engineering.

Support global 24x7 operations aligned to SRE principles (SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets) and drive reduction in incidents via AIOps.

Technical Skills & Experience

Strong experience in network engineering / NOC / NRE / NetDevOps roles.

Deep expertise in core networking: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, VRFs, HSRP/VRRP.

Hands-on experience across network domains: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Data Center (ACI/Nexus), WLAN, Firewalls, Load Balancers.

Strong network automation expertise using Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Python libraries such as Netmiko, NAPALM, pyATS (preferred).

Experience with orchestration tools such as Itential.

Knowledge of Source of Truth tools like NetBox/Nautobot and ITSM integration (ServiceNow).

Experience with observability tools such as SolarWinds, Grafana, Elastic, ThousandEyes, DNAC.

Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, QoS, and troubleshooting complex network issues.

Experience with cloud networking in Azure and GCP environments.

Exposure to AIOps, AI-driven operations, and observability platforms.

Scope & Delivery Expectations

• Deliver ~30–40 automation workflows/stories per quarter across LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, Firewall, DDI, and Cloud domains.

• Own build, test, operations support, and continuous development.

• Operate within a global 24x7x365 environment.

Additional Requirements

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (Blue Team)
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Senior Application Security Engineer to join our growing Security team. Your expertise will ensure our products are secure — from design and code through the CI/CD pipeline.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

Your impact

  • Educate and train development teams on secure coding practices and emerging security threats.
  • Perform technical security assessments and code reviews across our Java/Spring services
  • Engage in threat modeling to anticipate potential security threats and develop strategies to mitigate them.
  • Assist teams in building libraries, repeatable patterns, and paved-road components that ensure security is a part of every new feature.
  • Own and tune SAST, DAST, software composition analysis (SCA), and security tooling in CI/CD pipelines; triage findings and drive them to remediation with clear prioritization.
  • Partner with engineering to close service-to-service authentication/authorization gaps and other systemic issues.
  • Work with Detection & Response and our offensive security engineers to turn findings into durable detections and prevention.
  • Contribute to our secure SDLC standards and developer security guardrails.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience - 4+ years of experience working as an Application/Product Security Engineer:
    • Extensive experience with security assessments, security design reviews, or threat modeling
    • Hands-on secure code review (Java/Spring or similar)
    • Experience operating SAST/DAST/SCA and secrets-scanning tooling in a CI/CD pipeline
    • Strong ability to work independently
  • Education - A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
  • Technical aptitude - You’re technologically savvy and can easily get up to speed on modern tech stacks (i.e., Java, Spring, Terraform, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
  • Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
  • Resilience - We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
  • Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
  • Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

  • Experience working in regulated environments (fintech / financial services)
  • Experience building AppSec automation or a “paved road” for developers
  • Cloud (AWS) and API security experience
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CSSLP, GWAPT, OSCP)
San Francisco, CA salary range
$200,000—$240,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

  • Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
  • 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
  • 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
  • Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
  • Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. title: Vice President & Head of Neuroscience Portfolio Strategy & Alliances
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position: Vice President & Head of Neuroscience Portfolio Strategy & Alliances

Location: Princeton Pike, NJ

Reporting to: Senior Vice President, Head of Global Medical Neuroscience


Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams rich in diversity. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more:


Position Summary

Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking an enterprise-minded leader to serve as Vice President & Head of Neuroscience Portfolio Strategy & Alliances.

This leader will be responsible for shaping and integrating the overarching Neuroscience portfolio strategy across neuropsychiatry and neurology, including dementia and other neurodegenerative diseases. The role will translate individual disease-area and asset strategies into clear portfolio-level choices regarding asset and indication prioritization, investment, resource allocation, sequencing, external partnerships, and enterprise positioning.

The leader will also lead the strategic orchestration of BMS's overarching Neuroscience and Brain Health external narrative, enterprise neuroscience congress strategy, strategic alliances, SPARC, and relevant public-private partnerships. Working across Medical, Research and Development, Commercial, Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, Business Development, Alliance Management, and other enterprise functions, this leader will ensure that BMS presents a coherent neuroscience ambition and focuses its resources and external engagement on the opportunities with the greatest potential impact for patients.

This is a highly visible, matrixed leadership role requiring scientific credibility, portfolio judgment, business acumen, and the ability to align senior leaders around consequential choices.

Key Responsibilities

Integrated Neuroscience Portfolio Strategy and Prioritization

  • Lead the development and ongoing evolution of the integrated Neuroscience portfolio strategy across neuropsychiatry, dementia, and other neurodegenerative diseases, grounded in scientific opportunity, unmet patient need, clinical practice, and the external treatment landscape.
  • Integrate disease-area and asset strategies into a cohesive Neuroscience portfolio ambition, identifying strategic priorities, interdependencies, portfolio gaps, evidence needs, and opportunities for differentiation.
  • Bring a distinct Medical and scientific perspective to cross-portfolio assessments, including the patient journey, evolving standards of care, clinical meaningfulness, evidence requirements, external stakeholder needs, and the feasibility of changing medical practice.
  • Lead cross-portfolio assessments and scenario planning to inform choices among assets, indications, evidence-generation opportunities, external collaborations, and investments.
  • Develop transparent prioritization frameworks that incorporate unmet patient need, strength of scientific rationale, clinical potential, probability of success, competitive differentiation, evidence requirements, feasibility, strategic fit, and enterprise value.
  • Partner with Disease Area Heads, Research, Development, Commercial, Finance, and enterprise portfolio teams to formulate recommendations regarding asset and indication prioritization, resource allocation, portfolio sequencing, acceleration, expansion, partnering, or deprioritization.
  • Ensure that portfolio recommendations reflect both internal asset potential and the external realities of clinical practice, patient needs, scientific advancement, and the evolving competitive environment.
  • Reassess portfolio priorities as scientific evidence, development milestones, clinical practice, competitive conditions, external opportunities, and enterprise priorities evolve.
  • Provide the Neuroscience Leadership Team and relevant governance bodies with clear, decision-ready recommendations, including the scientific and medical rationale, patient implications, strategic trade-offs, risks, and resource requirements.


Neuroscience and Brain Health Scientific Narrative and External Medical Strategy

  • Lead the development of the overarching Neuroscience and Brain Health scientific narrative, connecting BMS's disease areas, assets, scientific platforms, evidence, partnerships, and patient priorities into a coherent expression of the company's scientific ambition.
  • Ensure that the narrative is scientifically rigorous, clinically relevant, patient-centered, and appropriately grounded in the maturity and evidence supporting the portfolio.
  • Define the core scientific and medical themes that should guide BMS Neuroscience engagement with healthcare professionals, researchers, scientific societies, patient and advocacy communities, academic institutions, consortia, and other health-system stakeholders.
  • Partner with Disease Area Heads and asset teams to ensure that individual disease and asset narratives contribute to—and remain consistent with—the broader Neuroscience and Brain Health scientific strategy.
  • Identify scientific, evidence, and external-understanding gaps that could limit differentiation of the Neuroscience portfolio and work with the appropriate teams to address them.
  • Translate the scientific narrative into clear strategic guidance for scientific exchange, evidence generation, publications, medical education, congress engagement, partnerships, and other external Medical activities.
  • Partner with Corporate Affairs to ensure that the scientific and medical foundations of the portfolio are accurately reflected in the broader enterprise Neuroscience narrative and external communications.
  • Provide scientific and medical context to Investor Relations, Commercial, Government Affairs, and other functions while respecting their ownership of investor communications, brand positioning, policy engagement, communications channels, and functional execution.
  • Ensure that insights generated through external scientific and patient engagement inform the ongoing evolution of the Neuroscience portfolio strategy and scientific narrative.


Enterprise Neuroscience Congress Strategy and Oversight

  • Own the overarching enterprise congress strategy for Neuroscience across priority global, US, and regional scientific meetings.
  • Establish the Neuroscience congress portfolio, including congress tiering, investment priorities, enterprise objectives, target audiences, expected outcomes, and leadership engagement.
  • Convene and align Medical, Development, Commercial, Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, Congress Excellence, and other relevant teams around an integrated strategy for major neuroscience congresses.
  • Ensure that scientific disclosures, medical education, external engagement, executive participation, media activity, investor communications, competitive intelligence, and partnership discussions collectively advance the portfolio strategy and Neuroscience narrative.
  • Provide strategic oversight across congresses to prevent fragmented asset-level execution and ensure appropriate balance across current brands, pipeline assets, disease areas, and longer-term scientific ambition.
  • Establish clear pre-congress objectives and post-congress reviews, ensuring that scientific, competitive, stakeholder, and partnering insights are translated into portfolio actions.
  • Represent BMS Neuroscience in select high-level scientific forums, leadership meetings, and external engagements, as appropriate.


Strategic Alliances and External Engagement

  • Define the Neuroscience alliance and external-engagement strategy based on portfolio priorities, capability gaps, scientific opportunities, and patient needs.
  • Identify where alliances with academia, biotechnology companies, industry partners, foundations, advocacy organizations, consortia, and other external stakeholders could accelerate or strengthen the portfolio.
  • Serve as the Neuroscience strategic sponsor or senior representative for selected high-priority alliances and collaborations.
  • Partner with Business Development, Alliance Management, Research and Development, Legal, Finance, and other functions to evaluate opportunities and establish appropriate strategic objectives, governance, performance measures, and decision pathways.
  • Ensure that alliance activity is connected to defined portfolio needs rather than pursued as a collection of independent external relationships.
  • Conduct regular strategic reviews of priority alliances to assess scientific progress, portfolio relevance, value realization, risks, and the need to expand, modify, or conclude the collaboration.
  • Ensure that knowledge and capabilities generated through alliances are integrated into Neuroscience strategy and internal decision-making.


SPARC Leadership and Strategic Oversight

  • Provide strategic oversight of SPARC within Neuroscience, ensuring that its priorities and activities are aligned with the broader Neuroscience portfolio and Brain Health ambition.
  • Define the role SPARC should play in advancing scientific collaboration, stakeholder engagement, patient impact, and solutions to system-level barriers in neuroscience.
  • Establish clear objectives, governance, measures of impact, and connections between SPARC activities and BMS's disease-area and portfolio strategies.
  • Ensure that SPARC generates actionable insights, relationships, and initiatives that can inform portfolio strategy, evidence generation, external engagement, and public-private collaboration.
  • Represent SPARC internally and externally and ensure appropriate engagement from senior BMS leaders and external partners.


Public-Private and Precompetitive Partnerships

  • Identify and shape public-private and precompetitive partnerships capable of advancing the broader neuroscience ecosystem in areas such as biomarkers, diagnosis, clinical-trial infrastructure, data standards, disease understanding, patient identification, and research methods.
  • Evaluate potential partnerships based on their alignment with portfolio priorities, scientific value, patient impact, feasibility, and the distinctive contribution BMS can make.
  • Serve as a senior BMS representative in selected national and international partnerships, consortia, and multilateral initiatives.
  • Partner with relevant enterprise functions to establish fit-for-purpose governance, funding principles, performance measures, and decision pathways.
  • Ensure that participation in public-private partnerships produces clear scientific, strategic, ecosystem, or patient value and that resulting insights are incorporated into internal strategy.


Strategic Intelligence and Portfolio Insights

  • Integrate scientific, clinical, competitive, market, stakeholder, policy, and partnership intelligence into Neuroscience portfolio decision-making.
  • Identify emerging scientific advances, external assets, technologies, policy developments, and changes in standards of care that could create opportunities or risks for the portfolio.
  • Develop concise executive perspectives on the implications of external developments for BMS's portfolio, investment priorities, partnerships, and external positioning.
  • Ensure that insights from congresses, alliances, SPARC, scientific leaders, patient organizations, and other external stakeholders are systematically captured and translated into action.


Enterprise Leadership and Organizational Impact

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to the SVP, Head of Global Medical Neuroscience, the Neuroscience Leadership Team, and enterprise leaders involved in Neuroscience.
  • Chair or lead appropriate cross-functional portfolio, alliance, external-strategy, and congress governance forums.
  • Create clarity regarding decisions, recommendations, ownership, execution responsibilities, and escalation pathways across the matrix.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team with capabilities spanning portfolio strategy, strategic alliances, external engagement, and enterprise integration.
  • Foster a culture of scientific rigor, transparency, constructive challenge, disciplined prioritization, and accountability for outcomes.
  • Represent the broader interests of the Neuroscience portfolio, balancing individual asset and functional priorities with what will generate the greatest impact for patients and BMS.

Decision Scope

The Leader is accountable for:

  • Developing the integrated Neuroscience portfolio strategy.
  • Leading portfolio-level prioritization and resource-allocation recommendations.
  • Establishing the strategic architecture of the Neuroscience and Brain Health narrative.
  • Defining the enterprise Neuroscience congress strategy.
  • Establishing the Neuroscience alliance and external-engagement strategy.
  • Providing strategic oversight of SPARC and neuroscience public-private partnerships.
  • Convening the appropriate functions and ensuring that portfolio decisions translate into coordinated execution.

Formal investment, development, business-development, disclosure, communication, and resource decisions will continue to follow established BMS governance and functional decision rights.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced clinical, scientific, or relevant technical degree required; MD, PhD, PharmD, or equivalent strongly preferred. MBA or demonstrated equivalent business and portfolio experience is desirable.
  • Typically 15 or more years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with substantial leadership experience in one or more of the following: portfolio strategy, neuroscience research and development, Medical Affairs, commercial strategy, business development, strategic alliances, or enterprise strategy.
  • Strong understanding of neuroscience drug development and the scientific, clinical, regulatory, access, and adoption challenges affecting neuropsychiatric and neurological diseases.
  • Demonstrated experience making or shaping portfolio choices across multiple assets, indications, development stages, or disease areas.
  • Proven ability to evaluate strategic trade-offs and translate scientific and clinical complexity into clear investment and resource-allocation recommendations.
  • Experience leading enterprise-level strategy across multiple functions in a global, highly matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated success developing or governing strategic alliances, external collaborations, consortia, or public-private partnerships.
  • Experience shaping an external scientific or portfolio narrative and aligning diverse internal stakeholders around consistent enterprise positioning.
  • Experience leading integrated strategy for major scientific congresses or similarly complex, high-visibility external platforms is strongly preferred.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, including experience evaluating investment options, opportunity costs, resource requirements, risks, and expected value.
  • Exceptional executive communication, judgment, and influencing skills, including the ability to challenge constructively and create alignment among senior leaders with different functional priorities.
  • Established scientific credibility and the ability to build trusted relationships with researchers, clinicians, patient leaders, policymakers, external partners, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated commitment to patient-centered innovation, scientific integrity, inclusive leadership, and the development of high-performing teams.

Measures of Success

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

• REST API integration

Backend

Strong practical experience with one or more of:

• Node.js

• Python

• REST APIs and backend application development

• MySQL / PostgreSQL or similar relational databases

AI-Assisted Development

This is an important part of the role.

You should have practical experience using one or more AI development tools such as:

• OpenAI Codex

• Claude Code

• Cursor

• Generate and refactor code

• Debug complex problems

• Write and improve tests

• Review AI-generated code critically

• Work with Git branches and repositories

• Investigate bugs across frontend, backend and database layers

• Improve development speed without compromising code quality

Engineering Skills We Value

• Git / GitHub

• Linux development environments

• API design

• Database design

• Debugging and troubleshooting

• Automated testing

• Clean, maintainable and well-structured code

• Ability to understand and modify an existing codebase

Who Would Be a Strong Fit?

Why This Role Is Interesting

Software development is changing rapidly.

We believe the next generation of strong developers will combine solid engineering fundamentals with AI-assisted development workflows.

You will have the opportunity to work on real products, modern PWAs and AI-driven applications while working closely with our technology leadership team.

If you are already experimenting with AI coding agents and believe they have fundamentally changed the way software can be built, we would like to hear from you.

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated résumé.

If possible, include links to your GitHub profile, portfolio or applications/products you have personally worked on.

title: 2026 Junior Analyst, Threat Intelligence
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Threat Intelligence team is dedicated to safeguarding our company's personnel, assets, and operations by proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating external physical safety threats. We operate a comprehensive intelligence program focused on real-time global monitoring, threat qualification, and escalation to ensure rapid response and protection. Our work spans from immediate risks like individual threats or natural disasters to near- and medium-term geopolitical events, utilizing advanced third-party SaaS tools such as Dataminr, Factal, and AlertMedia, alongside internal systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Utilize third-party tools like Dataminr and AlertMedia and internal platforms to detect and triage potential threats, such as natural disasters, civil unrest, geopolitical escalation, and direct threats to company assets.
  • Conduct in-depth research from publicly available sources to help qualify a broad range of emerging threats and provide context for escalation.
  • Draft and contribute to written intelligence products, including spot reports, alerts, and daily updates for review by team leadership.
  • Support the Lead Analyst by gathering information for more in-depth threat assessments on topics like activist targeting or regional instability.
  • Follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and escalation protocols to ensure threats are communicated to the appropriate stakeholders in a timely and effective manner.
  • Actively participate in team training and development activities to continuously improve analytical skills, tool proficiency, and knowledge of the global threat landscape.
  • Support cross-functional security partners by providing timely information and intelligence inputs as directed by the Lead Analyst.
  • Maintain situational awareness of global events and trends that could impact the company's personnel, facilities, or operations.
  • Conduct regular administrative tasks, including data input and analysis, database management, and recordkeeping.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be pursuing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master's in Intelligence Studies, International Relations, Defense Studies, Security Studies, Journalism, or a related research-heavy field.
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities; U.S. clearance eligibility may be required depending on program.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years of job or internship experience in a threat intelligence, corporate security, think tank, GSOC, military, or related analytical role.
  • Exceptional research and writing skills with the ability to draft clear and concise reports. Knowledge of credible sourcing, analytical writing standards, and proofreading.
  • Familiarity with the intelligence cycle and fundamental analytical techniques.
  • Strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced setting.
  • Regional or language expertise, or experience living, studying, or working abroad.
  • Military experience, or an in-depth knowledge of the military/defense sector.
  • Understanding of corporate/physical security, duty-of-care standards, or physical risk management.
  • Experience working in a 24/7 operational environment like a GSOC, security command center, or newsroom.
  • A keen interest in geopolitics, defense, international security, or corporate security.
  • Experience with data visualization or advanced analytical tools.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., GOSI, CTIA).
US Salary Range
$68,000—$90,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER — INFRASTRUCTURE & KUBERNETES OPERATIONS


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Infrastructure team, focused on Kubernetes operations and automation at scale. You will drive the strategy and own the health, scalability, and reliability of our Kubernetes clusters, while architecting and leading the development of tooling that platform and service teams rely on to manage infrastructure safely and efficiently. You will work closely with service owners, platform engineers, and tooling teams — and mentor junior engineers — to keep clusters running smoothly and to automate away manual, error-prone operational work.


WHAT YOU‘LL DO

  • Own and drive the roadmap for Kubernetes cluster operations — lead cluster upgrades, manage node groups (scaling, draining, replacement), and maintain overall cluster health across environments at scale.
  • Lead troubleshooting of complex production and non-production issues — use kubectl, logs, metrics, and other diagnostics to identify root cause and resolve workload, node, and networking failures, often across multiple interdependent systems.
  • Architect and lead development of internal tooling — design, implement, and maintain automation (scripts, CLIs, controllers, operators) that helps teams manage infrastructure more reliably and with less manual effort.
  • Drive automation strategy for operational workflows — replace manual runbooks with scripts and tools that handle upgrades, remediation, scaling, and routine maintenance.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure blockers — debug deployment failures, node/pod scheduling issues, resource constraints, and misconfigurations across clusters.
  • Define and improve observability strategy — instrument logging, metrics, and alerting to increase visibility into cluster health and reduce time-to-detect/resolve.
  • Set standards for issue tracking and triage — author detailed bug reports capturing root cause, repro steps, and impact; drive issues to resolution and improve team-wide reporting practices.
  • Partner cross-functionally with service owners, platform teams, and leadership — align on operational requirements, capacity planning, and upgrade/maintenance schedules.
  • Lead on-call rotations and incident response, own post-incident reviews, and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the infrastructure org.
  • Mentor and upskill junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical guidance and code/design reviews.


WHAT WE‘RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 7-9 years of DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering experience.
  • Deep, hands-on Kubernetes operations expertise — cluster upgrades, node group management, and complex troubleshooting across large-scale, multi-cluster environments.
  • Strong programming/scripting skills (Python, Go, Bash, or similar) — proven track record building, scaling, and maintaining automation and internal tooling used by multiple teams.
  • Advanced skills in reading and interpreting logs, metrics, and system state to diagnose complex, cross-system infrastructure issues.
  • Extensive experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including architecture decisions and cost/performance tradeoffs.
  • Expert-level debugging skills across distributed systems — able to trace failures from symptom through to root cause in highly complex environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — able to produce clear status updates, bug reports, technical documentation, and influence technical direction across teams.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives.

title: DevOps Engineer - Remote
description:
Xuman.AI is hiring a DevOps Engineer. Remote. Immediate joiners only.


Xuman.AI is an operating system that turns content into instant booking, designed for human-led services.

This engine matches the right person with the right fit at the right time, based on who they are, what they want, and how they connect.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to secure our multi-account AWS and Kubernetes environment. You’ll build the guardrails and controls that keep our cloud platform hardened as we grow.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.
