Compensation: ₹6 LPA - ₹12 LPA (based on experience and technical capability)

Shift Timing: 6:00 PM - 3:00 AM IST (Focusing on U.S. business hours)


About the Role

Kavya Travel Company is an Online Travel Agency (OTA) building a technology-driven travel booking platform for customers in international markets. Kavya Travel Company, in partnership with Stellar Serve Business Solutions, is looking for a hands-on Full Stack Developer who can help build, integrate, improve, and support the platform across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, CRM, payments, and production systems.

This is a product-development role, not a narrow frontend or backend position. The developer will work on the actual customer booking journey as well as the internal systems used by sales, reservations, customer service, and operations teams. The platform will connect multiple travel suppliers and business systems, so strong API integration and troubleshooting ability is important.

We are primarily looking for a mid-experience developer with approximately 2-6 years of real full stack development experience. The person should be capable of owning meaningful features, understanding how different parts of the application connect, and helping us build a stable and scalable OTA platform.


Key Responsibilities

Full Stack OTA Product Development

• Develop complete product features across database, backend services, APIs, and Angular frontend screens

• Build and improve customer-facing travel search, selection, booking, checkout, payment, confirmation, and post-booking workflows

• Develop internal tools used by sales, reservations, customer service, operations, and management teams

• Convert business requirements and UI designs into stable production features

• Maintain existing functionality while adding new modules as the OTA platform expands

• Troubleshoot issues that may involve frontend code, backend services, databases, supplier APIs, payment systems, or CRM workflows


Backend Development - C# / .NET Core / ASP.NET Core

• Develop REST APIs and backend services using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core

• Build business logic for travel search, pricing, booking, customer, payment, confirmation, and post-booking functions

• Use organized MVC / service-layer architecture and Entity Framework Core where appropriate

• Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access, and secure API access including JWT-based authentication

• Build proper validation, error handling, logging, and audit trails so production booking and payment issues can be traced

• Optimize backend services and investigate performance or reliability problems


Frontend Development - Angular / TypeScript

• Develop Angular applications using TypeScript, reusable components, services, forms, routing, and responsive layouts

• Build flight or travel search screens, filters, product selection, traveler-detail forms, checkout, and confirmation pages

• Consume backend APIs and correctly handle loading states, validation, errors, and changing API responses

• Work with the designer to convert approved UI concepts into functional customer-facing screens

• Build CRM and internal operational screens for employees managing customers, bookings, payments, and service requests

• Troubleshoot frontend production issues and improve performance across desktop and mobile devices


Travel APIs, GDS & Third-Party Integrations

• Integrate flight, airline, GDS, consolidator, aggregator, or other travel supplier APIs

• Work with REST APIs and, where required, SOAP/XML services and large JSON/XML responses

• Normalize supplier data into a consistent internal structure that can be used by the website and CRM

• Handle availability, schedules, fares, fare rules, pricing changes, booking responses, confirmation data, and supplier errors

• Build safeguards for API timeouts, failed responses, duplicate requests, missing data, and other integration problems

• Maintain supplier request/response logs so live booking issues can be investigated efficiently


OTA Booking Flow & Transaction Logic

• Develop the end-to-end journey from search and availability through traveler details, payment, booking creation, and confirmation

• Ensure booking and payment status remains accurate when a transaction passes through multiple internal and external systems

• Support customer account, booking history, confirmation, change, cancellation, refund, or service-request workflows where applicable

• Prevent duplicate booking or duplicate payment actions caused by repeated requests, retries, or failed responses

• Design workflows that clearly distinguish successful, failed, pending, incomplete, and cancelled transactions


Database Development - SQL Server & MongoDB

• Design and maintain SQL Server tables and relationships for customers, bookings, payments, application settings, and operational records

• Write and optimize queries, stored procedures, indexes, and database objects as required

• Use Entity Framework Core for application data access where appropriate

• Use MongoDB for API responses, logs, search data, or other document-oriented data where useful

• Protect data integrity when multiple systems update the same booking or transaction and investigate database-related performance issues


CRM & Internal Operations Systems

title: Regional Director, Americas & Caribbean
description:
Position Title: Regional Director, Americas & Caribbean
Location: Regional
Category: FTA International
Level: D
Duration: Two Years (Renewable)
Department: Bureau of Representational Affairs
Supervisor/Report to: Secretary-General
Job type: Voluntary Service (VS) Part-Time
Deadline: 30 April 2022

About the role

The IYF Regional Director (RD) is a senior member of the International Youth Federation will serve as a senior official for IYF in one of the five regions. The Regional Director provides leadership to IYF Representatives in the region.

The primary responsibility of the Regional Director is to ensure successful engagement of the Country Teams in the region with the IYF global strategies, missions, and vision. She/he is a member of IYF’s Executive Board and contributes to shaping and monitoring overall corporate strategic directions of the IYF interventions in the region.

Responsibilities

(A) Managing the IYF Regional Administration in the assigned region IYF:

  • Providing overall leadership and shaping strategic thinking for IYF’s engagement in the region;
  • Identifying existing and emerging youth empowerment challenges and priorities in the region, and defining the strategic programming priorities at the regional and country and implementing measures to improve the quality and effectiveness of programmes;
  • Assist the IYF Headquarters in the implementation of corporate strategies and support resource mobilization and delivery efforts;
  • Provide guidance to the IYF Representatives, including playing a facilitating role with host governments, donors and counterparts as needed; and
  • Building and maintaining strategic partnerships for IYF in the region, with a focus on knowledge sharing, joint activities and resource mobilization and representing IYF, as required, in high-level events and fora relating to the region.

(B) Advocacy, Leadership and Representation:

  • Lead and direct the Regional Administration (RA) staff members, and ensure the proper functioning of the RA in the region;
  • Lead RA’s effort in Representatives’ nomination, selections, and appointments;
  • Assist the Representatives in establishing IYF Country Teams (IYFCT) which comprises National Volunteer Officers (communications, youth, sport, and women) that are responsible for the facilitation of IYF activities at the national level;
  • Communicate and advocate on behalf of the IYF at the regional level and create new opportunities to improve the situation of young people and women through relationships and networks with regional partners;
  • Represent the IYF in the region and establish and maintain highest level of contacts and effective relationships with regional partners, including national partners, intergovernmental organizations, international financial institutions, NGOs and civil society;
  • Providing intellectual guidance for region-specific knowledge products; and
  • As Director of the Regional Administration, exercise leadership to manage the decision-making process for the region on policies, strategies and human and financial resources allocations, monitoring implementation and evaluation of regional results and lessons learned.

(C) Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting:

  • Monitor progress, effectiveness and relevance of the IYF country programmes within the region with a view to improving country programme performance;
  • Keep the IYF Headquarters well informed of any significant organizational issues such as emergencies, conflicts, developments and/or resolutions in the region that affect IYF’s intervention/programmes of cooperation;
  • Regularly conduct performance evaluations of IYF Representatives in the region in order to ensure the achievement of performance objectives and provide feedback to performances or work plans; and
  • Oversee Representatives to ensure the protection of organization's assets, financial resources, and condition of services including staff security in the region, in accordance with the rules and regulations of the Organization.

(D) Regional Coordination Duties:

  • Develop and expand IYF Member Countries in the Region both qualitatively and quantitatively;
  • Assist IYF Representatives with engaging in fundraising activities, through strategic partnerships and public engagement activities and initiatives;
  • Liaison with donors – In close coordination with the Representatives to develop proposals and secure funding to ensure on-going IYF functions;
  • Generate sponsorship and other income to meet or exceed budget targets; and
  • Managing a programme of high-quality events for IYF members across the region on a break-even or better basis.

(E) Communications Duties:

  • Maintain active communication among IYF Representatives and other interested agencies at regional level;
  • Act as a regional focal point for Members by responding to inquiries, welcoming new Staff Members, general liaison, and personal contact;
  • Promote continuous improvements in quality of IYF activities and communications;
  • Report youth achievements, success stories, youth progressing and related news at the regional level to HQ press;
  • In collaboration with the Representatives in the region, create and manage a Regional PR strategy promoting the IYF, including media interviews, production of articles for press/media and oversee the regional thematic newsletter;
  • Provide annual report about IYF region activities, stats, member organizations.

Competencies

Lead (Level-3) Leadership is the art of motivating a group of people to act as a team towards achieving a common goal.

Design (Level-3) Ability to recognize what changes are required and create a path for improvement using existing knowledge, problem solving skills, creativity and original ways of working.

Empower (Level-3) Empowerment is a practice of giving team members skills, authority, opportunity and motivation so that they can take initiative and make decisions to solve problems and improve performance.

Mobilize (Level-3) Ability to identify resources and activities that individuals and organizations will undertake to support the IYF’s strategic goals and objectives. Engage and influence appropriate donors by building win-win relationships.

Inspire (Level-3) Inspiration and lead by example is about energizing and creating a sense of direction and purpose in others, unlocking motivation and momentum for positive change.

Functional Competencies

  • Ability to lead strategic planning, results-based management, and reporting.
  • Ability to lead and manage corporate strategic initiatives.
  • Excellent computer, internet, social media and information system skills.

Eligibility

  • Only (18-38) age is accepted for this position.
  • Be a citizen of one of the Americas & Caribbean States
  • Highly interested in youth empowerment, youth issues.

Skills Required for Position

  • Ability to interact cordially and communicate with a diverse community.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to assess and evaluate situations quickly, accurately and effectively.

Experience

Experience and results preferred at national or international level in youth empowerment role, management, coordination, development, communications, international relations, youth studies, sport, women empowerment, youth-led organizations, or another relevant field.

Language

Fluency in English with superior drafting skills is essential.

Assessment:
Evaluation of qualified candidates may include an assessment exercise which may be followed by a competency-based interview.

Working Modality:
This vacancy is a voluntary-based position with (8-10 Hours/Week) part-time commitment

title: Associate Director, Faculty Affairs
description:
The Department of Neurology and Neurological Sciences at Stanford University School of Medicine is seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to oversee the faculty affairs function. The successful candidate will possess superior critical thinking skills and will serve as an expert resource, providing guidance on all aspects of employment activities for faculty and academic staff while partnering with faculty leadership to enhance the faculty affairs landscape.

Duties include*:

  • Direct staff and provide leadership to achieve goals and vision of the organization and the day-to-day operations. Responsible for hiring and retaining staff, career coaching, personal development for direct reports and accountable for the performance of employees.
  • Conduct strategic analysis of data, policy, and other information relevant to critical functional area(s) of faculty affairs for the organization. Identify and resolve issues of substantial significance that affect the faculty affairs function beyond the immediate organization.
  • Consult and advise senior faculty and administrative leadership on program and policy development. May provide input to university leadership on institutional, academic, and administrative policies and guidelines.
  • Ensure compliance with school and university policies. Manage university faculty conflict of interest requirements for the organization as needed, utilizing institutional and departmental understanding of relationships in relevant fields.
  • Serve on school or Provost’s Office committees to provide input on faculty affairs issues. Represent the organization to other university departments including, but not limited to, the Provost’s Office; Office of General Counsel; Office of Faculty Development; Office of Technology Licensing; Dean of Research; Office of Development; and other academic units.
  • Manage the direction of internal academic and administrative policy development for programs and administrative operations. Interpret and explain policy and programmatic development and changes to department chairs and managers on programmatic and policy development.
  • Oversee the collection, management, analysis, and/or reporting of faculty data. Assist in ensuring compliance with related policies. May oversee allocation of the organization’s resources.
  • May independently or in collaboration with the Provost’s Office, direct faculty and/or academic staff supervisors and managers in the interpretation and implementation of faculty affairs policies, procedures, and programs.
  • May provide input to university leadership on institutional academic and administrative policies and guidelines for improvement.


* - Other duties may also be assigned

  • Master’s degree or higher in higher education administration, human resources, business administration, or a related field.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage and build relationships with diverse stakeholders, including faculty, staff, and administration.

Bachelor's degree and seven years of experience working with administrative processes, or combination of education and relevant experience, and three years of lead, supervisor or manager experience.

  • Excellent planning and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Working knowledge of accounting, budget planning and/or financial forecasting.
  • Working knowledge of grants and contract administration.
  • Strong negotiation skills and effective interpersonal skills.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong expertise in business and management computer applications and databases.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards and/or regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, projects, and deadlines.

Extended hours.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our IT Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, availability, performance, security, backup and recovery, patching, and operational support of enterprise databases across Oracle, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, reliability, and performance of business-critical database environments while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you will do:

  • Perform day-to-day administration and L2/L3 production support for enterprise databases.
  • Monitor database health, availability, performance, capacity, replication, and storage utilization.
  • Manage database configurations, users, roles, privileges, and access controls.
  • Perform backup, recovery, restore, replication, and disaster recovery (DR) activities, and participate in DR exercises.
  • Execute database patching, upgrades, maintenance, and vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues, including CPU, memory, I/O, locking, blocking, and query performance.
  • Manage incidents, problems, and changes in accordance with ITIL/ITSM processes.
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for major or recurring incidents and implement corrective actions.
  • Support high-availability (HA), clustering, and replication solutions.
  • Administer and support Oracle databases and database services hosted on OCI, including connectivity, monitoring, backup, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Develop scripts and automation solutions for health checks, monitoring, maintenance, and routine DBA activities.
  • Maintain database operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with Application, Infrastructure, Storage, Network, Security, and vendor teams.

What you will bring:

  • A minimum of 8 years of enterprise DBA experience, with strong hands-on production administration across Oracle and multiple database platforms.
  • Strong experience with Oracle Database and OCI, including RMAN, ASM, RAC, performance tuning, patching/upgrades, OCI database services, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on administration experience with PostgreSQL, Cassandra, MySQL, and Microsoft SQL Server, including replication, backup and recovery, HA/DR, and performance tuning.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
  • Good understanding of SAN/NAS storage, networking, and virtualization technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring tools and ServiceNow/ITSM platforms.
  • Scripting and automation skills using Shell, PowerShell, Python, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong production troubleshooting, ownership, and incident management skills.
  • Oracle certification (OCP) or equivalent is preferred.
  • PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Cassandra certifications are an advantage.
  • Experience working in large-scale enterprise or telecommunications environments.
  • Experience supporting highly available, business-critical production databases.
  • Experience with cloud database technologies is considered a plus.

title: People Systems Analyst
description:
If you live in Australia or New Zealand, you’ve likely heard of AMP. But at a time when society is changing, we are too. We’re now a nimbler business with new leadership and thinking.

For us, these are exciting times. There’s a real potential for big thinkers to help us redefine what financial services could be. And turn our legacy into something even more positive and powerful for the future.

Help people create their tomorrow, while you create yours

We help people with their banking, super, retirement and finances. Through upturns, downturns, recessions, and major life transitions. Every day, we help people see and make more of their financial potential, so that they can create their tomorrow. And we’ve been doing it for over 170 years.

If we do our job well, we genuinely add to the prosperity of our country and its people.

Reporting to Manager Reporting & Analytics, the P&C Analyst will provide high quality support in delivering key initiatives across the organisation, including the embedment of the AMP purpose & values. This role will also play a key role in conducting analysis, interpreting insights, reporting and delivering change support

This role is critical in delivering a seamless and engaging employee experience across AMP’s People Applications. With a strong focus on user-centred design and customer-centric thinking, the role supports the effective implementation, optimisation and ongoing improvement of people-related systems and processes.

It plays a key role in enabling strategic people initiatives by driving process efficiency, strengthening controls and delivering high-quality, accessible technology solutions. Through proactive stakeholder engagement and effective change management, the role supports smooth transitions, enhances service delivery, reduces operational complexity and ultimately improves employee outcomes.

How will you make an impact

  • Strategy & Customer Experience: Support delivery of people strategy goals by adopting a customer‑centric approach, improving user experience, and promoting consistent, reusable design across platforms.
  • Service & Operations Management: Manage Tier 2 requests, ensuring prioritisation, clear communication, and delivery against service levels, while maintaining system configuration in line with business needs.
  • System Optimisation: Test, troubleshoot, and implement system changes to ensure functionality, reliability, and alignment to user requirements and process improvements.
  • Process Improvement & Insights: Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to enhance service outcomes, controls, employee experience, and cost efficiency.
  • Design, Documentation & Knowledge Content: Design and document People Applications processes, ensuring clarity and consistency, and maintain up-to-date, user-relevant content across TheHUB and Help Desk guides.
  • Change & Delivery: Support change management activities and contribute to the delivery of small initiatives, ensuring smooth implementation of system and process updates.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with P&C, IT@AMP, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors to deliver outcomes.

What you will bring to the role

  • Experience using HCM systems, with a preference for Oracle HCM.
  • Proven experience in applying risk and controls management in a business environment.
  • Experience documenting and designing People Technology processes to support clarity and consistency.
  • Experience working collaboratively with a broad range of stakeholders to deliver outcomes.
  • Experience supporting change management and maintaining user-relevant help content.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering user-focused technology solutions, with a focus on usability, accessibility, findability and overall value.

Who you are

You bring strong technical expertise in People Technology, with in-depth knowledge of HCM systems, ideally Oracle HCM, and experience applying risk and controls in a business environment. You are confident designing and documenting processes that improve clarity and consistency, while supporting change management and maintaining user-relevant content. With a strong focus on user experience, you deliver accessible, usable and high-value technology solutions, and can clearly translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

You are naturally curious and solutions-focused, with a sharp ability to analyse issues, think critically and drive them through to resolution. You build trusted relationships through clear communication and a collaborative approach, engaging effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. Highly organised and outcome-driven, you balance competing priorities with ease, consistently delivering quality results within tight timeframes. You take pride in your attention to detail and bring a proactive, adaptable mindset, thriving in fast-paced environments while maintaining a strong focus on delivering meaningful outcomes.

Why we think you’ll love working at AMP

Doing what we’ve always done is not an option, so your clever ideas will get airtime here. You’ll be encouraged to speak up and try new things. If they don’t work, we move on – better for it.

We know there’s no one way of doing things. So, you won’t have to sacrifice who you are or how you work to fit in here. We’re inclusive and flexible in many of the ways you’d expect. And in some of the ways you wouldn’t. As long as your health and wellbeing come first - at home and at work.

In fact, most of what makes AMP such a welcoming, enjoyable place to work are our people. Wherever you go, you’ll find moments to connect, feel valued and do meaningful work.

Whether it’s through our first-class leaders who are invested in you and your success. Through year-round opportunities to volunteer, fundraise and give back to the community. Or in the everyday challenges you face as we work together to strengthen this great organisation. Challenges that will stretch you, amplify your potential and compound the impact you have.

We believe in the power of inclusion and diversity

We’re dedicated to fostering inclusion, diversity, and a warm feeling of belonging at AMP. It sparks creativity, ignites innovation, and turns up the dial on the quality of our decisions and performance. This not only makes our workplace more engaged, but also leads to better connections with our customers.

We're your allies in the search for the perfect fit - when you apply, let us know how we can support you to put your best self forward during our selection process.

We're also committed to enhancing employment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, so we enthusiastically encourage candidates from these backgrounds to apply and explore our Reconciliation Plan on our website.

Ready to create your tomorrow?

If you’re someone who sees opportunity where others see challenge, come and work with us in smart, progressive ways as we transform an iconic Australian brand for the future. And, through a series of career-defining moments, create your own tomorrow.

Don’t procrastinate! We review applications when we get them, and if we discover the ideal candidate, we may close the role earlier than the advertised close date.

Looking forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Director, Standards & Technical Engagement
company: ASSOCIATION FOR MATERIALS PROTECTION AND PERFORMANCE
description:
SUMMARY
The Senior Director, Standards & Technical Engagement is responsible for the strategic strength, technical quality, market relevance, global adoption, and long-term value of AMPP’s standards portfolio. The role also leads the effective management and continuous improvement of AMPP’s Technical Advancement functions, including Standards Operations and Technical Engagement. The Senior Director ensures these functions operate efficiently, align with organizational priorities, and deliver meaningful value to members, volunteers, industry stakeholders, and customers.

This role oversees one of the organization's most volunteer-intensive functions, engaging a body of members and non-members who participate in standards committees and working groups. The Senior Director will bring a global standards-development perspective to AMPP's programs and ensure AMPP's standards remain competitive with other standards-development organizations (e.g., API, ISO, ASTM, ANSI, SAE).

Working closely with the Chief Intelligence & Innovation Officer and cross-functional leaders, this position partners with the research, technology, and knowledge management functions within the same team to support the development, implementation, and advancement of technical programs, standards development activities, technical engagement efforts, and knowledge-driven initiatives that further AMPP's mission as a global leader in materials protection and performance.

The Senior Director leads the Standards and Technical Engagement teams and is responsible for building and sustaining the world's most authoritative, practical, modern, and widely adopted portfolio of materials protection and performance standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND REPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Portfolio Strategy & Standards Quality

  • Establish and enforce standards for quality across the portfolio, ensuring requirements are clear, necessary, verifiable, technically defensible, and globally applicable, with appropriate separation of mandatory requirements from advisory or commentary language.
  • Proactively identify gaps between AMPP's current standards portfolio and emerging industry and market needs and drive the development of new standards to address them ahead of competing organizations.
  • Reduce standards development and revision cycle times while maintaining technical rigor and consensus-based process integrity.
  • Drive measurable growth in the adoption and citation of AMPP standards in owner specifications, engineering requirements, procurement documents, regulations, and industry practices worldwide.
  • Strengthen the connection between standards, specifications, education, certification, and accreditation so these function as an integrated AMPP system rather than independent activities.
  • Drive international participation, relevance, recognition, harmonization, and global adoption of AMPP standards as a core performance outcome of this role.
  • Lead competitive intelligence and portfolio strategy to identify market opportunities, portfolio gaps, competitive threats, and partnership priorities, while driving standards-related revenue growth through effective positioning and distribution strategies.
  • Lead the evolution of AMPP's standards toward structured, machine-readable, searchable, and interconnected formats that can be consumed by digital and AI systems.

Volunteer & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Steward volunteer technical expertise as a strategic asset by maximizing its value and minimizing unnecessary demands on committee volunteers.
  • Build and sustain productive relationships with volunteers, committee leaders, industry representatives, academic institutions, government agencies, and other external stakeholders.
  • Represent AMPP on technical committees, industry forums, and external working groups as appropriate.

Organizational & Team Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Chief Intelligence & Innovation Officer to implement Technical Advancement strategies and operational plans.
  • Lead and support the team in accomplishing departmental goals, professional development objectives, and organizational priorities.
  • Serve as a member of the senior leadership team, contributing to organization-wide strategic planning, and represent the Chief Intelligence & Innovation Officer on relevant internal and external matters as needed.
  • Foster collaboration across departments to ensure alignment of technical programs with broader organizational goals.
  • Partner with internal departments to support product development, educational initiatives, publications, events, research activities, advocacy efforts, and member engagement activities.

Operations & Administration

  • Direct the day-to-day operations of Standards Operations and Technical Engagement functions.
  • Support the planning, execution, and evaluation of technical projects that align with AMPP's strategic objectives.
  • Monitor program performance and key performance indicators, recommending improvements to enhance efficiency, quality, and member value.
  • Manage operational budgets and resources within assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to apply data, artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies that enhance technical operations, organizational effectiveness, and member service.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, governance requirements, and industry best practices.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
Success in this role will be measured by portfolio quality, standards-development speed, adoption and citation growth, global reach and participation, volunteer engagement and effectiveness, standards-related revenue growth, competitive position relative to peer standards-development organizations, and innovation in standards delivery and format.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

description:
About the Company


Grand Motorcars is a six-store automotive dealership group headquartered in Atlanta, USA. We build all of our technology in-house — inventory systems, sales performance dashboards, payroll automation, data pipelines — and it is run by a lean, fast-moving tech team. You would be hire #2, working directly under the CTO.


About the Role


This is not a typical developer job. You will build features end-to-end using Claude Code — the company provides the subscription. If you don‘t already build with AI every day, this role is not for you.

You‘ll work from detailed specs and design mockups prepared by the CTO, and own the execution end-to-end — build it, test it, polish it, ship it. Your work reaches real users at real dealerships within days, not months.


You‘ll work from detailed specs and design mockups prepared by the CTO, and own the execution end-to-end — build it, test it, polish it, ship it. Your work reaches real users at real dealerships within days, not months.


What You‘ll Do


- Build full-stack features (React + TypeScript frontend, Node + TypeScript backend, PostgreSQL) from detailed specs and design samples

- Drive Claude Code daily as your primary development tool — prompting well, reading every diff, catching the AI when it‘s wrong

- Test and verify your own work before it reaches review — ‘it runs‘ is not ‘it works‘

- Polish UIs to a premium standard — spacing, hierarchy, motion — not just make them functional

- Open clean pull requests with clear descriptions, take review feedback, and iterate fast


What We‘re Looking For


- Fresh graduates welcome — we care about how you work, not years of experience

- You already use AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as your default way of building — and you can tell when they‘re wrong

- Solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript and React; comfort with REST APIs and SQL

- An eye for good UI — you notice when spacing is off and it bothers you

- You verify what you ship — you test what you build and can explain why something broke


What You Get


- A paid Claude Code subscription — work the way development actually works now

- Direct mentorship from the CTO — specs, reviews, and feedback on every piece of work

- Real production ownership from week one — your code runs a real business

- Full-time, remote (India)


How We Hire


1. One written question with your application: ‘Tell us about a time an AI tool gave you wrong code — how did you catch it, and what did you do?‘ Specific, real answers get calls. Generic answers do not.

2. A 30-minute video call about your past projects.

3. A one-day practical challenge: we give you access to a small real-world codebase with a task brief — you fix, build, and open a pull request, using any tools and libraries you like.

4. A short live session for finalists, then an offer.


Apply with your resume, your answer to the question above, and a link to anything you‘ve built (GitHub, deployed project, anything real).

Ferry Holdings Limited (FHL) was established in 2025 to deliver one of New Zealand's most significant transport infrastructure programmes: the replacement of the Cook Strait ferries and the development of the port infrastructure needed to support reliable inter-island connections for decades to come.

title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly capable and hands-on DevOps Engineer / DevOps Consultant to support critical cloud engineering, platform operations, and migration initiatives within a complex enterprise environment. This contract role requires a self-driven professional who can operate independently, take ownership of deliverables, and execute with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively across infrastructure, security, networking, and application teams.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and migrating secure, scalable, and highly available cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines, with deep expertise in AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, containerization, Linux administration, networking, security integration, and observability platforms.

A key focus of this role will be to lead and support enterprise migration activities, including:

  • AWS tenant migration from Org A to Org B
  • Observability migration from Splunk to Google Observability and Google SecOps
  • Complex network and security infrastructure changes, including Route 53, SSL/TLS certificate changes, Transit Gateway (TGW) updates, DNS server changes, Zscaler changes, and WAF changes
  • Governance and security policy updates, including SCP (Service Control Policy) changes
  • The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical depth, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to security by design, shift-left engineering, cost optimization, standardization, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure using AWS services.
  • Take a hands-on role in the implementation, troubleshooting, and optimization of infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, and production support activities.
  • Lead and support AWS tenant migration activities, including the movement of infrastructure, services, configurations, and dependencies from Org A to Org B.
  • Plan and execute migration tasks with strong attention to service continuity, dependency mapping, risk mitigation, rollback planning, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Support the migration of observability and security monitoring platforms from Splunk to Google Observability and Google SecOps, including log routing, monitoring integration, alerting considerations, and operational transition.
  • Design and execute complex network infrastructure changes, including:
  • Route 53 updates and DNS cutover activities
  • SSL/TLS and certificate changes
  • Transit Gateway (TGW) changes
  • DNS server changes
  • Zscaler-related updates
  • WAF configuration changes
  • Implement and manage SCP (Service Control Policy) changes in alignment with organizational governance, security, and access control requirements.
  • Architect and implement AWS networking solutions, including VPC, NAT Gateway, Transit Gateway, Route Tables, Route 53, Resolvers, and DNS configurations.
  • Manage and optimize AWS services such as ACM, CloudFront, API Gateway, Athena, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, and AWS Glue.
  • Manage storage and data platform components, including EBS, RDS, MongoDB, Snowflake, and S3 / S3 Tables.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, with emphasis on modularity, reusability, governance, and compliance with engineering standards.
  • Build, optimize, and troubleshoot GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment.
  • Containerize applications using Docker and support deployment in containerized environments.
  • Administer Linux-based systems, including system configuration, operational support, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Automate operational and deployment activities using shell scripting and related scripting techniques.
  • Collaborate with security teams to integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and policy enforcement into engineering workflows.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities without compromising security, performance, or reliability.
  • Standardize infrastructure modules, deployment patterns, and operating procedures to improve consistency and maintainability.
  • Produce clear and accurate documentation covering architecture, migration runbooks, implementation procedures, operational workflows, and support handover materials.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform maturity, reliability, migration readiness, and delivery efficiency.
  • Act as a dependable technical contributor who can independently drive workstreams, resolve issues proactively, and escalate risks appropriately.

Required Technical Skills:

AWS Cloud Services

  • Strong hands-on experience with VPC, NAT Gateway, Transit Gateway, Route Tables, Route 53, Route 53 Resolvers, ACM, CloudFront, API Gateway, Athena, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, and AWS Glue.

Migration Experience

  • Proven experience in planning and executing infrastructure and platform migrations, including:
  • AWS tenant migration from one AWS Organization to another
  • Observability migration from Splunk to Google Observability and Google SecOps
  • Network and security change execution involving Route 53, certificates, TGW, DNS, Zscaler, and WAF
  • SCP policy changes in controlled enterprise environments

Networking

  • Strong understanding of DNS, routing, load balancing, SSL/TLS, certificate lifecycle management, network troubleshooting, and hybrid and enterprise network change coordination.

Storage and Data Platforms

  • Experience with EBS, RDS, MongoDB, Snowflake, and S3.

Infrastructure as Code

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Terraform modules.
  • Ability to build reusable, compliant, and standardized infrastructure code.

CI/CD and Automation

  • Strong experience designing, implementing, and optimizing GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience integrating testing and deployment controls into automation workflows.

Containerization

  • Hands-on expertise in Docker container creation, management, and troubleshooting.

Linux Administration

  • Strong capability in Linux administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Scripting

  • Proficiency in shell scripting for automation, task orchestration, and operational efficiency.

Security and Compliance

  • Experience integrating security controls and vulnerability management into engineering processes.
  • Experience supporting Google SecOps workflows.
  • Understanding of governance controls and access policy management within AWS.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience working in large-scale enterprise AWS environments.
  • Experience leading or supporting AWS Organization / tenant migration programs.
  • Experience delivering observability transformation initiatives, especially migration from Splunk to Google-native observability and security platforms.
  • Experience coordinating DNS, certificate, TGW, Zscaler, WAF, and routing changes in production environments.
  • Experience implementing and validating SCP changes within controlled governance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting production cutovers, incident management, rollback planning, and post-migration stabilization.
  • Experience developing reusable Terraform modules and platform standards.
  • Exposure to Kubernetes, Jira, Packer, AWS Bedrock, AWS Agent Core, Core Principles.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  1. A hands-on approach with the ability to actively execute engineering and migration tasks, not just provide guidance.
  2. A self-driven and independent working style, with the ability to manage priorities, drive workstreams, and deliver results with minimal supervision.
  3. Proven experience supporting complex enterprise migrations involving infrastructure, observability, network, and governance changes.
  4. Strong troubleshooting capability across AWS, networking, Linux, CI/CD, and containerized environments.
  5. Strong ownership mindset, accountability, and attention to detail.
  6. Excellent communication and documentation skills, including the ability to work effectively with engineering, network, security, and governance stakeholders.
  7. A strong commitment to security, operational excellence, resilience, and cost efficiency.

Candidates are expected to uphold and promote the following principles:

  • Hands-On Ownership: Take direct responsibility for implementation, troubleshooting, migration execution, and operational outcomes.
  • Self-Driven Delivery: Operate independently, manage priorities effectively, and proactively drive tasks to completion.
  • Security by Design: Incorporate security controls from the earliest stages of infrastructure, migration, and application design.
  • Shift Left: Introduce validation, testing, and security scanning early in the delivery lifecycle.
  • Operational Excellence: Build reliable, supportable, and well-documented solutions that meet enterprise production standards.
  • Cost Optimization: Continuously evaluate and implement ways to reduce cloud and operational costs without compromising service quality.
  • Code Standardization: Maintain consistent standards across infrastructure code, automation scripts, and configuration management.
  • Reusable Design Patterns: Apply scalable, supportable, and repeatable design patterns across infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
  • DRY (Don’t Repeat Yourself): Promote modularity and reuse to reduce duplication across scripts, templates, and infrastructure components.

Risk Engineer, US Power

Are you ready to sit at the intersection of engineering, insurance, and the energy transition? Join our US Power team and help shape how we understand and underwrite risk across conventional power generation and the fast-growing renewable energy sector — from operating plants to major construction projects.

• Partner with Security, QA and CSV teams to maintain audit readiness and ensure technical controls and evidence support regulated customer expectations.

• Reduce recurring operational effort through automation, self-healing patterns, improved diagnostics and elimination of known failure modes.

• Review material AWS consumption trends and identify opportunities across architecture, purchasing models, storage lifecycle, autoscaling and environment scheduling.

• Support annual planning, resource and budget management for cloud platform engineering and related tooling.

• Manage technical relationships with AWS, implementation partners and critical platform vendors, including escalations and roadmap discussions.

• Provide technical leadership for new customer deployments, upgrades, platform migrations, connector rollouts and complex environment changes.

• Act as the senior technical escalation point for cloud, infrastructure, deployment and operational issues affecting customers or strategic programs.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, QA, CSV, Security, Support, PMO and Customer Success to align architecture and delivery decisions.

• Participate in customer workshops, solution reviews, audits, risk discussions and executive-level technical communications.

• Translate business and regulatory needs into clear technical requirements, delivery plans, risks, dependencies and acceptance criteria.

• Lead, coach and develop cloud, DevOps and platform engineers through clear goals, regular feedback, technical mentorship and structured development plans.

• Build capability in AWS architecture, Kubernetes, automation, security, SRE, documentation and customer-facing problem solving.

• Set expectations for ownership, engineering quality, operational discipline, collaboration and continuous learning.

Required Experience & Qualifications

• 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, SRE or infrastructure engineering.

• At least 6 years of substantial production experience on AWS, including architecture and operational ownership of business-critical environments.

• Proven ownership of complex AWS implementations, platform modernization, cloud migration or large-scale production operations.

• Strong hands-on experience with Amazon EKS / Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD automation, AWS networking, IAM, observability and production troubleshooting.

• Experience designing highly available and secure systems, disaster recovery approaches and operational controls for customer-facing platforms.

• Experience leading major incidents, root-cause analysis and cross-functional remediation programs.

title: Gulfstream G550 First Officer
description:
G550 Second-in-Command (SIC) | Van Nuys, CA

Silver Air Private Jets is looking for a G550 SIC to join one of our most established owner accounts in Van Nuys. This is a unique seat for a pilot who wants more than hours—it is an opportunity to develop under two veteran Silver Air pilots with deep international experience, strong owner relationships, and years of operational knowledge to pass along.

The aircraft supports a thoughtful mix of owner and charter flying, providing exposure to both highly personalized private operations and the pace and variety of charter. The owners are warm, personable, and deeply appreciative of great service. They enjoy food, hospitality, and the experience surrounding the trip, and they value a crew that understands their preferences.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an exceptional Gulfstream pilot. A G550 type rating is strongly preferred, but equally important are aircraft handling, disciplined approaches, consistently smooth landings, situational awareness, and the humility to keep learning. This is a crew that notices the details and an owner who appreciates them.

For an ambitious SIC earlier in their Gulfstream career, there is considerable upside here. You will have experienced pilots beside you, international flying in front of you, and an environment where you can build the judgment and proficiency required for greater responsibility over time.

This is not a rotational or commuter position. The right candidate should live in, or be prepared to relocate to, the Los Angeles/Van Nuys market and become part of the crew and account—not simply fly the schedule.
  • Reviewing the maintenance status of the aircraft to ensure airworthiness.
  • Conducting proper pre-flight inspection in accordance with the approved Aircraft Flight Manual.
  • Completing check of weather and facilities along the route to be flown and airports to be used, including alternate airports.
  • Ensuring the flight is conducted in accordance with the policies and procedures of Silver Air and applicable Federal Aviation Regulations.
  • Ensuring the safety of all passengers, aircraft, and crew.
  • Accurately completing all trip paperwork in accordance with Silver Air procedures.

  • Total time in all aircraft = 1500 hours.

  • Total Turbine time = 500 hours preferred.
  • Type Rating. Typed in the G450/550 or GV preferred.
  • Valid First Class Medical Certificate. This is required.

  • Strong customer service skills. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) will need to be demonstrated with all levels of employees and clients. Communication must always be delivered with a superior level of professionalism.
  • High level of detail. You'll need to be highly organized with the ability to thrive in changing environments and the flexibility for frequently changing priorities.
  • Excellent time management skills. You'll need to be able to work on an on-call basis, with the ability to work well under pressure and to multi-task. Silver Air is a 24/7 organization, so this role requires a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and Holidays.
  • Strong people skills. You'll need to be a team player who can provide valued contributions to our business and clients.
We care deeply about making Silver Air an incredible place to work and we invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits / perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • 5% company match on 401(k) from day one.

  • Competitive compensation with regular pay reviews.

title: Project Manager II
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager II to lead and manage complex educational facility construction projects ranging from $5 million to $100 million in value. This role is ideal for a proactive construction management professional with expertise across the full project lifecycle, from planning and design through construction, occupancy, and closeout. This on-site position will support client projects throughout the Los Angeles area.

The Project Manager II serves as a key liaison between stakeholders, design teams, contractors, regulatory agencies, and campus leadership to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with all applicable standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple capital construction projects simultaneously, overseeing all phases of project delivery.

  • Provide regular project status updates, recommendations, and strategic guidance to senior leadership and project stakeholders.

  • Identify project risks through field observations and project analysis.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and maintain project risk registers.
  • Monitor emerging risks and proactively implement corrective actions to minimize impacts on project objectives.
  • Collaborate with college representatives, design professionals, contractors, and project teams to develop and execute construction phasing and swing-space strategies.
  • Facilitate communication among stakeholders to ensure project alignment and successful implementation.
  • Present project updates and recommendations to campus leadership, district representatives, and program management offices.
  • Lead project closeout activities, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and organizational requirements.
  • Coordinate occupancy planning, FF&E installation, asset disposition, relocation efforts, and final documentation.
  • Verify completion of punch-list items, warranties, record documents, and regulatory approvals.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to project team members.
  • Support planning, programming, and design activities for future campus projects.
  • Assist with reporting, presentations, and strategic planning initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Urban Planning, or a closely related field.
  • 7 years of experience managing multiple construction projects.
  • At least two (2) years of experience in educational facility design and construction.
  • Four (4) additional years of qualifying construction project management experience may be substituted for the required degree.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within a large capital improvement program.
  • Knowledge of the California Public Contract Code and public-sector procurement processes.
  • Experience with formal construction partnering methodologies.
  • Experience with Division of the State Architect (DSA) design and construction processes or similar regulatory environments.
  • Thorough understanding of all project lifecycle phases, including planning, design, construction, and closeout.
  • Experience with alternative project delivery methods.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • Licensed Architect (California Architectural Board)
  • Professional Engineer (California Board for Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors)
  • Certified Construction Manager (CCM)
  • PMP or other recognized project management certification

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Arcadis offers benefits for full-time and part-time positions. These benefits include medical, dental, and vision, EAP, 401K, STD, LTD, AD&D, life insurance, paid parental leave, reward & recognition program and optional benefits including wellbeing benefits, adoption assistance and tuition reimbursement. We offer nine paid holidays and 15 days PTO that accrue per year. The salary range for this position is $130,000 - $165,000. Through collaboration, accountability and a focus on results, Algoworks operates at the intersection of technology and people, building not only advanced systems but strong global teams that elevate performance and create lasting impact.


Follow the video below to know about us! Clipchamp


Role overview


This engineer will build and extend the Python services behind AI features - endpoints, data access, ingestion and retrieval jobs, and the integration points to foundation model APIs - and will also implement the front-end surfaces for a new AI Playground that ACD engineering will develop for rapid prototyping and experimentation, before implementing it in customer-facing UI. The work is majority backend; the front-end capability matters because it means features get delivered whole rather than handed across a seam.

This is a delivery role on a small team, working to patterns set by the AI Engineering Lead and senior backend engineer rather than defining architecture. The expectation is steady, tested, production-ready output with growing independence over the engagement.


Key responsibilities:


  • Build and maintain Python API endpoints and service logic (FastAPI or equivalent) backing AI features, following established patterns for request validation, streaming responses, timeouts, retries, and structured error handling.
  • Implement the front-end features in Angular or React - streaming and incremental response rendering, loading and partial-failure states, and responsive layouts for the AI Playground and customer-facing UI.
  • Write and maintain SQL against relational stores, Python against other NoSQL or object data stores.
  • Write automated tests as a normal part of delivery: unit and API tests on the back end, fixture-based tests for model-dependent paths, and contributions to regression suites running in CI.
  • Add logging, metrics, and tracing to the services and jobs owned so failures and performance regressions are visible without a customer report.
  • Fix defects on owned features through to root cause, including issues surfaced in production.
  • Collaborate with the AI Engineering Lead, Senior Backend Engineer, Product, and UX in a distributed team, using written updates and asynchronous communication as the default.


Required skills and qualifications:


  • 5+ years of professional software development experience delivering production backend services and web application user interfaces.
  • Strong Python for production backend work: REST API development, async basics, testing, and debugging in a real codebase - not scripting or notebook-only experience.
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or an equivalent Python API framework.
  • Working proficiency in a modern front-end framework - Angular or React - sufficient to build and modify feature-level UI independently. Angular is preferred, as it is used in ACD’s existing platform.
  • Comfort with TypeScript/JavaScript and browser fundamentals including async behavior and debugging.
  • Solid SQL and relational data modeling: joins, indexing basics, schema changes, and migrations.
  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong written English and the ability to work effectively with a US-based team.


Must have skills:


  • Strong Python backend development with REST APIs and FastAPI/Flask/Django.
  • Hands-on Angular or React with JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Strong SQL, relational databases, data modeling, and API integration.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, debugging, and production support.


Desired attributes:


  • Exposure to AI/LLM features, model APIs, RAG/retrieval, or streaming interfaces.
  • Knowledge of Azure, Docker, and cloud deployment.
  • Experience with background jobs/queues such as Celery.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, ownership, and ability to work with distributed/US-based teams.


Good to have skills:

  • Vector databases or embedding-based retrieval.
  • Azure cloud services, Docker, or exposure to cloud deployment workflows.
  • Background job and queue processing (Celery, or equivalent).
  • C# and .NET familiarity, which are core to ACD’s existing product platform.
  • Accessibility (WCAG) and front-end performance work.

Xuman.AI is an operating system that turns content into instant booking, designed for human-led services.

On the surface, it collapses fragmented workflows into one system. Underneath, we are building something far deeper: The Human Experience Engine, our Persona Compatibility layer. This engine matches the right person with the right fit at the right time, based on who they are, what they want, and how they connect.


The founder‘s vision is to layer cognitive science into human persona compatibility, leading to hyper-personalized, real-time human connections.

Xuman.AI is the productization of the founder‘s previous bootstrapped venture: ideation, market research, pilots, MVP, and a technical foundation built to scale. The product is built and live on both app stores. We are past the building phase and into distribution: getting it in front of real users and turning it into a repeatable business.

This is the widest seat on the team. You are not scoped to one layer. In a given week, you might build the screen, the endpoint behind it, the model call inside it, and the migration underneath it.


What you‘ll own:

- Features end to end: the interface, the API, the data model, shipped as one piece

- AI inside the product: model calls in real features, the prompts around them, and what happens when the model is slow, wrong or down

- Whatever the week actually needs, across the app, the web surfaces and the services

- Your own unblocking: you do not wait for a specialist to finish your work


Must have:

- Production full-stack TypeScript: React on the front, Node or NestJS behind it

- You have shipped an AI feature real users touched: a model call, a tool-calling flow, or retrieval that survived contact with production

- PostgreSQL and clean API design: you model the data, you do not just consume it

- Fast ramp on unfamiliar codebases: you ship in week one

- 3 to 5 years of experience across startups and corporate, internships count

- You use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) daily to write, debug, and ship faster. Not optional; this is how we work.


Strong plus:

- Next.js, Tailwind, and design-system discipline

- Third-party integrations that are not allowed to break: payments, calendars, notifications

- React Native or any mobile exposure

- Prompt and eval discipline: you can show a model change made the feature better

- CI and deploy hygiene

- Product sense: you ask who the user is before you build the screen


Compensation is discussed directly in our conversation, not in a post.


If this seat reads like yours, apply with confidence. Every application is read personally.

title: Quality Specialist (QA/QC)
description:
Location: Singapore

The Quality Specialist supports the implementation and maintenance of GMP-compliant quality systems for Moleac’s outsourced manufacturing network. The role provides quality control and quality assurance oversight of contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs), testing laboratories, and suppliers, ensuring that raw materials, intermediates, and finished products meet established specifications and regulatory requirements.

The position supports batch release activities through review of manufacturing and analytical documentation, management of quality records, and coordination with external partners.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

1. GMP Quality Oversight

· Provide QA oversight of contract manufacturers, testing laboratories, and suppliers to ensure compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP).

· Maintain and organize GMP documentation including specifications, test methods, batch records, and quality reports.

· Support maintenance of the company’s Quality Management System (QMS), including SOPs and controlled documents.

· Ensure proper documentation practices and compliance with GMP and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements.

· Support internal preparation for regulatory inspections and GMP audits.

· Assist in compilation of Product Quality Reviews (PQR/APQR).

2. Batch Release Documentation & QC Review

· Review manufacturing batch records, packaging records, and Certificates of Analysis (CoA) from contract manufacturers and testing reports from testing laboratories.

· Verify that manufacturing and testing activities comply with approved specifications, validated/approved methods, and regulatory filings.

· Perform QC release for packaging materials and raw materials.

· Maintain batch release trackers and ensure completeness of required quality documentation.

· Review analytical test results and stability data for compliance with product specifications.

3. Analytical & Stability Program Oversight

· Track analytical testing activities performed by contract laboratories for raw materials, intermediates, and finished products.

· Maintain QC trackers and testing schedules to ensure timely completion of required analyses.

· Support management of stability programs, including monitoring of stability study schedules and review of stability data.

· Assist in trending analytical results and identifying potential quality trends or deviations.

4. Quality Event Management

· Track and support investigations related to deviations, Out-of-Specification (OOS) results, Out-of-Trend (OOT) results, and product complaints reported by contract manufacturers or laboratories.

· Support documentation and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

· Maintain logs and trackers for deviations, investigations, and quality events.

· Assist with evaluation of potential quality impacts to released or in-process batches.

· Support investigation for customer complaint.

5. Change Control & Supplier Quality

· Support assessment and tracking of manufacturing, analytical, or supplier changes through the company’s change control process.

· Assist in maintaining supplier and contract manufacturer qualification documentation.

· Support maintenance of quality agreements with external partners.

· Track implementation of changes affecting manufacturing processes, testing methods, or product specifications.

6. Production & Supply Coordination

· Coordinate with contract manufacturers on sample testing schedules and documentation requirements.

· Maintain internal trackers for production batches, testing status, and product release timelines.

· Support coordination with supply chain teams to ensure proper handling and documentation of incoming and outgoing materials.

Qualifications

· Diploma or Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related discipline.

· 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or GMP-regulated environments.

· Familiarity with cGMP, pharmaceutical quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

· Experience working with contract manufacturers in China and Singapore or testing laboratories is advantageous.

· Strong attention to detail and ability to manage technical documentation.

· Strong coordination and communication skills for working with external partners and internal stakeholders.

· Good written and verbal communication skills. (This role requires liaising with suppliers/manufacturers in China).


Key Competencies

· GMP documentation and compliance awareness

· Analytical data review and quality assessment

· Quality system coordination (deviations, CAPA, change control)

· Cross-functional coordination with CMOs and supply chain teams

· Strong organizational and documentation management skills

title: Lead Java Developer
description:
About Us

At Undocked, we help companies excel in e-commerce by delivering bespoke optimizations and cutting-edge analytics. Our experience in retail and supply chain product strategy, technology, and operations has helped organizations succeed in their e-commerce and digital transformation journeys.


Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Spring Boot Developer to design, develop, and support scalable backend services for retail and supply chain platforms.

This role is ideal for engineers with 8 - 10 years of hands-on Java development experience who have worked with Warehouse Management (WMS), Order Management (OMS), Supply Chain, Retail, or other high-volume transactional systems.


Candidates with direct OMS/WMS experience will be a strong fit. However, engineers with backend development experience in adjacent domains and a strong understanding of complex business workflows, integrations, APIs, and distributed systems are also encouraged to apply.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable taking ownership of technical solutions, contributing to architecture and design decisions, and working closely with product, business, QA, and DevOps teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business and functional requirements and translate them into technical designs, solutions, and effort estimates.
  • Design and develop scalable, high-performance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build, enhance, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices supporting retail and supply chain workflows.
  • Develop and support functionality across order management, inventory, fulfillment, warehouse, and logistics domains.
  • Design and implement integrations with upstream and downstream systems such as e-commerce platforms, WMS, ERP, payment systems, and logistics providers.
  • Participate in solution design and architecture discussions, evaluating technical approaches and trade-offs.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clean, scalable, maintainable, and reusable technical solutions.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and contribute to root cause analysis, performance optimization, and system reliability.
  • Ensure adherence to coding standards, security, performance, scalability, and reliability best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
  • Conduct and participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and provide technical guidance within the team.
  • Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering practices, development processes, system architecture, and technical standards.


Required Technical Skills

  • 8 - 10 years of hands-on software development experience with Java/J2EE.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot and Spring Framework.
  • Strong experience with Hibernate/JPA and ORM concepts.
  • Proven experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar; exposure to NoSQL databases is a plus.
  • Experience with Git or other version control systems.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automated deployment processes.
  • Exposure to at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, API integrations, and enterprise application development.


Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following domains is highly preferred:

  • Order Management Systems (OMS)
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Inventory Management
  • Retail / E-commerce
  • Fulfillment and Logistics
  • Other high-volume, transaction-intensive enterprise applications

title: AI Engineer
description:
TL;DR Kharon is seeking a full-time AI Engineer based in Denver. This role requires in-office attendance at least 3 days a week.
  • Design, develop, and ship proof-of-concept AI applications within days or weeks. Work in fast, agile cycles to test ideas, gather feedback, and refine models and interfaces.

  • Stay at the forefront of AI/ML advancements, evaluate open-source frameworks, and share best practices across the team.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
