  • Strong software development skills in Python and experience with libraries like Langchain/Langgraph, Agent SDKs, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, PySpark/Polars/Pandas.
  • Experience with tracing systems (MLFlow, Sentry), RAG Systems, Memory Systems, MCP Servers, Agent Skills, and knowledge of different models and tradeoffs.
  • Strong understanding of how to make use of AI tools for rapid development (Cursor, Claude Code, etc)
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker), cloud deployment (AWS preferred, Github Actions)
  • Demonstrated ability to ship high-quality, production-ready ML/AI systems under tight iteration cycles.
  • Passion for solving complex problems with real-world impact, especially in high-stakes or regulated domains.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in cross-functional, mission-driven environments.
Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.
What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a AI Engineer to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

To keep that momentum going, we do our very best to make sure that each and every team member is completely taken care of. We’re nothing without our people and we strive to offer a package that reflects that. As a Kharon team member, you can expect:
  • Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurances
  • FSA program for both medical and dependent care
  • Long term disability
  • 401k + Roth with matching and immediate vesting
  • Flexible paid time off + 11 paid holidays

The base salary range at Kharon is set between $130,000 to $170,000. Please note that this figure does not necessarily include potential bonuses, commissions, benefits, or equity that may be part of the overall compensation package.

If interested in pursuing this position, please visit to apply.

Kharon is an equal opportunity employer. Kharon is committed to cultivating and maintaining a workplace that is free from harassment and discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation or identity, neurodiversity, appearances, age, protected veteran status, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

title: Data Engineer, GTM
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

As a Data Engineer on the Data Science & Analytics team, you will build the data foundation for Anthropic’s quote-to-cash lifecycle: the path a deal takes from opportunity through revenue. You will design the canonical data models so that Sales, Deal Desk, Order Management, Revenue Operations and Finance work from one governed, auditable definition of what was sold, on what terms, and where each deal stands. You will partner closely with DS&A and with GTM and Finance systems teams who own Salesforce, CPQ and billing to make quote-to-cash data reliable, well-modeled and self-serve as our business scales.

Responsibilities

  • Understand the data needs of Deal Desk, Order Management, Revenue Operations, Finance and Sales systems teams, and translate them into technical requirements
  • Design, build and own data models that transform raw Salesforce, CPQ, and billing data into canonical datasets
  • Establish high data integrity standards and SLAs to ensure timely, accurate delivery of data
  • Partner with Salesforce, CPQ and billing engineers on upstream schema changes, new fields and ingestion so the warehouse faithfully mirrors the systems of record
  • Build foundational data products, dashboards and tools to enable self-serve analytics to scale across GTM teams
  • Influence stakeholder roadmaps from a data perspective, and become the expert on Anthropic’s GTM data models and architecture

You might be a good fit if you have

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer or in a similar Data Science & Analytics role, ideally partnering with GTM, Revenue Operations or Finance teams.
  • A passion for the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI.
  • Hands-on experience modeling Salesforce data and at least one adjacent quote-to-cash system: CPQ, contract lifecycle management, billing and invoicing, or ERP.
  • Expertise in building multi-step ETL jobs, building robust data models through tooling like dbt; proficiency with workflow management platforms like Airflow and version control management tools through GitHub.
  • Expertise in SQL and Python to transform data into accurate, clean data models.
  • Experience building data reporting and dashboarding in visualization tools like Hex to serve multiple cross-functional teams.
  • A bias for action and urgency, not letting perfect be the enemy of the effective.
  • A “full-stack mindset”, not hesitating to do what it takes to solve a problem end-to-end, even if it requires going outside the original job description.
  • Experience building an Analytics Data Engineering (or similar) function at start-ups.
  • A strong disposition to thrive in ambiguity, taking initiative to create clarity and forward progress.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer I AI-Native Development
description:
About Babaclick

Babaclick operates at the core of international e-commerce across major global markets, including the UK and US. Our Gurgaon team builds the commercial, operational, and systems infrastructure behind sourcing, pricing, supplier management, catalogue growth, workflow automation, and scalable operational decision-making.

As AI reshapes how modern businesses operate, we‘re embedding AI-assisted software development, workflow automation, structured data systems, and operational intelligence into every function of the business.

We‘re hiring software engineers with proven professional experience, solid engineering fundamentals, and real exposure to production environments — engineers who already build, debug, and ship using AI-assisted development as a core part of their workflow, not an experiment.


About the Role

This isn‘t a role for building technology in isolation. Our engineers work on systems that directly shape how the business operates, scales, and makes decisions. Most projects start with a real business problem, not a predefined technical spec — you‘ll work with engineering and business teams to understand a workflow, spot bottlenecks, design a solution, implement it, validate it, and keep it reliable in production.


You‘ll contribute across:

  • AI-assisted product development and internal platform engineering
  • Catalogue growth systems and workflow automation
  • API integrations and operational tooling
  • Data quality, structured data systems, and internal dashboards/reporting
  • Debugging production issues and business process optimisation
  • Scalable, AI-enabled operational infrastructure


Projects typically span databases, backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and automation tooling — so we‘re looking for engineers who understand not just how to build a solution, but why it should be built, what it‘s solving, and whether it‘s the right call for the business.


Who We‘re Looking For

Strong candidates typically bring:

  • Experience: 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally at a recognised technology, product, SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce company, contributing to real production systems and existing codebases.
  • Academic background: A strong foundation in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or a related discipline — preferably from a Tier 1 or strong Tier 2 institution.
  • Engineering fundamentals: Solid backend, full-stack, or general application development skills, plus a track record of shipping useful software, automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products.
  • Judgement and communication: Strong analytical thinking, high ownership and attention to detail, excellent written/verbal English, comfort in fast-moving environments, and the confidence to question assumptions rather than just execute instructions.


This role is not for candidates whose AI experience is limited to experimenting with ChatGPT. You should already be using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar in real engineering work, and be able to:

  • Structure prompts and context that reliably produce high-quality output
  • Read, validate, and improve AI-generated code — catching bad assumptions, edge cases, and weak implementations
  • Debug AI-generated code when it doesn‘t behave as expected
  • Work within existing codebases, not just isolated personal projects
  • Break down complex problems into structured implementation plans
  • Use AI to move faster without outsourcing technical judgement


You should also be comfortable with standard collaborative workflows — Git/GitHub, branching, pull requests, code review, and working across shared repositories.

Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs is a plus, but we don‘t expect mastery of every technology in our stack. What matters more is being AI-native: using AI coding assistants as a core part of how you design, build, debug, and ship — and being able to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies quickly.


Strengthen your application with: links to GitHub repos, deployed applications, a technical portfolio, open-source contributions, or other projects that demonstrate your engineering ability. For candidates with professional experience, we‘ll weigh most heavily what you personally built, owned, and delivered — and the decisions and trade-offs behind that work.


Business Understanding & Judgement

Babaclick is an international commerce business, and our engineering function exists to solve real commercial and operational problems. Interviews will assess business judgement alongside technical skill.


Before interviewing, come prepared to discuss:

  • What Babaclick does, and the markets we operate in
  • Why an international commerce business needs an internal engineering function
  • Where software, automation, data, and AI can create operational or commercial leverage
  • How your own experience could translate into value at Babaclick

We don‘t expect you to understand every part of our business going in — but we do expect you to have researched it, thought critically about how it operates, and arrived with informed questions and considered views. Technical ability is essential; commercial awareness and sound judgement matter just as much.


Recruitment Process

We assess: engineering fundamentals, professional experience, AI-assisted development capability, problem-solving, ability to navigate existing codebases, communication, business judgement, and ownership.

Come prepared to discuss past systems you‘ve worked on in depth — your individual contribution, technical decisions, trade-offs, challenges, and impact.


Final stage: a five-day paid work trial on real engineering tasks, with structured onboarding and support, assessing execution, judgement, and how you operate in a live working environment.

Successful candidates join Babaclick as a Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native).


How to Apply

Email your application to india@babaclick.com with the subject line:

Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native) – (Your Name)

Please include:

  • CV / Resume
  • GitHub and LinkedIn profiles
  • Portfolio or personal website (if applicable)
  • Links to deployed apps, open-source contributions, SaaS products, or other projects showing your engineering ability
  • An optional cover letter on your interest in the role and the work you‘re most proud of


We‘re looking for a strong overall profile — academic background, professional experience, demonstrated engineering ability, AI-native practices, and business judgement, all together. Show us not just which technologies you know, but what you‘ve built, owned, and shipped, and how that experience translates into value at Babaclick.

location: Guantang Qu, Hong Kong; Shanghai, Shanghai, China; Shenzhen Shi, Guangdong, China; Vietnam
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE
Director of Specialty Materials

This role ensures that every product made from leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens meets Quince's uncompromising standards for quality, sustainability, and affordability.

The Director blends deep technical expertise in material science with strategic supply chain leadership and cross-functional collaboration, serving as the central hub connecting sourcing, production, quality, and design teams across global markets.

Strategic Leadership & Innovation

  • Define the Material Vision: Set the global raw materials strategy for leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens, ensuring it aligns with Quince's design, quality, sustainability, and margin objectives. You will be a true creative partner to the design team, proactively bringing new material innovations, sustainable technologies, and emerging trends to the table.
  • Drive Innovation Across Material Categories: Lead the research and development of new materials, finishes, and technologies across a diverse portfolio including leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens. This includes pushing boundaries in sustainable sourcing, unique washes, dyes, finishes, and performance-enhancing treatments.
  • Manage a Comprehensive Material Portfolio: Build and maintain a holistic material library, overseeing everything from seasonal innovations to core, "platformed" materials that can be reused to improve efficiency, consistency, and speed-to-market.
  • Champion Cost Leadership: Continuously identify cost-optimization opportunities across the supply chain—from raw material to finished goods—without compromising ethical standards or product integrity, bringing Quince's "unreal prices" mission to life.
  • Lead Cross-Category Material Strategy: Provide strategic direction for all specialty materials, ensuring that innovations and best practices from leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens are shared and leveraged across the organization.

End-to-End Sourcing & Production

  • Sourcing & Supplier Development: Build and curate a best-in-class global supplier network spanning tanneries, mills, dye houses, and vertical partners across all material categories. This involves negotiating lead times, capacity, and pricing, while ensuring suppliers meet Quince's quality, sustainability, and labor standards.
  • Production Oversight: Own the material pipeline from raw materials through to finished goods, including leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens. Collaborate closely with production teams to proactively troubleshoot issues during sampling and mass-production, ensuring all materials are "market-ready" at scale.
  • Quality Assurance: Establish and oversee rigorous testing protocols for performance, regulatory, and chemical compliance across all specialty materials—including tensile strength, color fastness, pilling resistance, leather durability, abrasion resistance, and wash performance. You are accountable for ensuring all materials meet end-use requirements and luxury brand parity.
  • Production Cost Management: Ensure all material sourcing decisions align with established pricing architectures and margin targets, working with merchandising on cost engineering to optimize quality and profitability across every category.
  • Drive Traceability & Transparency: Partner with certification bodies (LWG, GOTS, OEKO-TEX, REACH) to ensure chain-of-custody integrity and full transparency from raw material origin to finished product.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Business Alignment

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a key connector between Design, Merchandising, Product Development, Production, and Supply Planning. Translate business needs into sourcing solutions and ensure the material strategy supports overall commercial goals across all product categories.
  • Translate Vision into Technical Briefs: Convert design and merchandising visions into clear, manufacturable technical specifications for suppliers—leather grades, denim weights, weave structures, silk types, synthetic formulations, and finishing treatments—that are achievable at scale and cost.
  • Lead and Mentor Material Experts: Manage, coach, and inspire a specialized global team of material experts across leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and novelty wovens. Set clear goals, manage performance, and develop talent within the team.
  • Business & Financial Accountability: Own the business alignment for all specialty material sourcing, making strategic decisions on material direction, quality escalations, and overrides to balance creative ambition with profitability.
  • Lead Cross-Category Evaluations: Facilitate blind panels with design, merchandising, and customer focus groups to validate luxury material perception, handfeel, and color accuracy across all categories before commercialization.
  • Foster Knowledge Sharing: Drive collaboration among material experts, ensuring innovations and learnings from each category (e.g., sustainable dyeing techniques from denim, finishing innovations from leather, synthetic advancements) are shared to elevate the entire material portfolio.




People Leadership & Business Alignment

  • Lead and Mentor the Team: Guide a diverse, specialized team of sourcing managers, quality engineers, and production experts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Set Clear Goals & Develop Talent: Establish performance objectives, manage team development, and build a pipeline of future leaders within the organization.
  • Own Business & Financial Accountability: Make strategic decisions on material direction, quality escalations, and material overrides to balance creative ambition with profitability and margin targets.

Qualifications

Required

  • Degree in Textile Science, Material Science, Supply Chain Management, Color Chemistry, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in material sourcing, production, quality management, or coloration for apparel, accessories, or home textiles, with expertise across leather, denim, silk, synthetics, and wovens.
  • Deep technical knowledge of leather tanning, denim weaving and washing, silk production, synthetic manufacturing, and woven construction techniques.
  • Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams and material experts in a fast-paced retail or manufacturing environment, with a track record of mentoring and developing talent.
  • Strong cost analysis skills: cost modeling, yield optimization, landed cost analysis, and budget management across multiple material categories.
  • Experience building and maintaining quality standards and supplier compliance programs, including SKU rationalization and shade consolidation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience with sustainable materials, circularity initiatives, and eco-friendly processing across multiple material types.
  • Knowledge of supply chain traceability, including blockchain or digital tracking systems.
  • Familiarity with PLM systems and quality database management.
  • Background in luxury goods (apparel, home, and accessories) with an eye for premium aesthetics, handfeel, and trend forecasting across diverse material categories.
  • Experience managing a multi-category material portfolio and cross-functional teams of specialized experts.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

$1—$2 USD

title: IT Security Officer

title: Senior Vice President, Cloud Platform Engineering – Cloud Nerve Center
description:

This leader will establish the production environment, engineering patterns, and operational capabilities needed to migrate WSP applications to the cloud securely, efficiently, and at scale, with accountability across security, resiliency, connectivity, modernization, automation, and FinOps.

The role will deliver cloud-first standards, reusable blueprints, and repeatable migration patterns while aligning application engineering, architecture, cyber, infrastructure, SRE, risk, finance, and external partners around secure, resilient, and cost-efficient outcomes. The role is located in Jersey City, NJ or New York City, NY.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and execution: Own the Cloud Nerve Center roadmap and translate modernization priorities into measurable engineering outcomes.

  • Cloud security and edge: Lead traffic management, web application protection, private connectivity, managed identity, and zero-trust controls for WSP cloud applications.

  • Resiliency and operations: Establish multi-region, active-active, recovery, observability, capacity, and incident-readiness standards for critical services.

  • Migration and modernization: Deliver reusable landing zones, infrastructure-as-code modules, migration playbooks, and operational-readiness standards that accelerate data center exits.

  • FinOps: Improve cost transparency and savings through autoscaling, rightsizing, allocation, forecasting, and cloud-efficiency standards.

  • Risk and governance: Ensure cloud capabilities meet BNY cybersecurity, regulatory, audit, data-protection, and operational-control requirements.

  • Leadership: Align senior stakeholders, mentor technical leaders, and foster accountability, automation, reuse, and continuous improvement.

Key Initiatives and Outcomes

  • Deliver secure cloud edge and traffic-management capabilities for WSP cloud applications.

  • Enable the four-nines resiliency target for TIAA-supported services through measurable architecture and operational controls.

  • Establish resilient private-line cloud connectivity for USAA.

  • Improve application security and resiliency through managed identity and service-to-service authentication patterns.

  • Reduce application cloud spend through autoscaling, rightsizing, demand management, and cloud-efficiency standards.

  • Strengthen trading platform resiliency through third-region, active-active, recovery, and failover capabilities.

  • Improve cloud edge continuity by implementing Akamai as an alternate content delivery network.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Extensive leadership experience in cloud, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or production engineering within a regulated enterprise.

  • Deep expertise in a major public cloud platform, cloud networking, identity, security, containers, infrastructure as code, observability, and automation.

  • Strong knowledge of multi-region resiliency, active-active architecture, disaster recovery, cloud edge technologies, private connectivity, and traffic management.

  • Demonstrated experience with managed identity, zero-trust controls, FinOps, large-scale migrations, and complex production change.

  • Executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate technical decisions into business, client, and risk outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud transformation experience in financial services or another highly regulated environment.

  • Experience with Akamai or comparable edge-security platforms, data center exits, hybrid-cloud modernization, and private connectivity.

  • Relevant cloud, security, Kubernetes, architecture, SRE, or FinOps certifications.

  • Experience leading senior engineers, vendors, budgets, and multi-year platform roadmaps.

Leadership and Impact

The successful candidate will combine enterprise leadership with strong technical credibility, making disciplined trade-offs across security, resiliency, delivery speed, and cost. Success will be measured through migration velocity, availability, recovery performance, risk reduction, adoption of reusable patterns, cost savings, and delivery against client commitments.

Deze organisatie in Zeist is namelijk op zoek naar meerdere Java ontwikkelaars ter uitbreiding van haar teams. Het bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in het verzamelen en verwerken van data naar rapportages en applicaties ten behoeve van het optimaliseren van de energietransitie. Dat betekent dat je met jouw input de wereld een stukje groener maakt en de maatschappij een stukje mooier.

Als Java developer kom je te werken in één van de bijna 25 Java teams die het bedrijf rijk is. Ze hebben meerdere Java posities openstaan en ze kijken dan ook graag met jou gericht naar jouw ervaring, wensen en ambities om zo de beste match te maken met het juiste IT-team. De cultuur is heel open en transparant, de ontwikkelaars zijn sociaal en houden er van om bij het koffieapparaat een praatje te maken. Niet alleen om te praten over het weekend, maar ook om kennis te delen en van elkaar te leren. Betrokken, sociale en bevlogen tech-savvy mensen is het beste hoe je dit bedrijf kunt omschrijven. Ze werken samen in een prachtig en modern pand waar je overigens maximaal 2 keer per week hoeft te zijn. Voor de overige dagen hebben ze het hybride werken omarmd en dat betekent dat het team ook van diverse delen van het land hierheen komen om samen te werken. Bijzonder is daarnaast dat ze ook een mobiliteitsbudget bieden aan alle collega's. Dat betekent dat je de mogelijkheid hebt om een mooie leaseauto te rijden. Is dat voor jou niet nodig? Geen probleem, dan laat je dat bedrag van bijna 1000 euro per maand gewoon maandelijks uitkeren bovenop je salaris!

Als Java developer word je dus onderdeel van 1 van de bijna 25 teams van het bedrijf. Ze staan open voor zowel fullstack als backend ontwikkelaars. title: Engineering Manager - DevOps
description:
About Pathlock

Pathlock is a leader in application security, access governance, and compliance automation. Our cloud solutions help organizations secure critical applications, mitigate risk, and enforce policies across diverse IT environments.

Our platform is built on modern cloud-native architecture, leveraging advanced services for compute, networking, security, and observability. Experience with enterprise-grade cloud platforms and container orchestration is highly valued in this role.


Role Overview

Pathlock is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our DevOps team. This role combines people leadership, operational excellence, and technical stewardship for a multi-tenant SaaS platform running across Azure and AWS globally. You will lead a globally distributed team of DevOps engineers and platform automation specialists responsible for reliability, performance, security, cost optimization, and delivery execution. The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform leader with a strong DevOps background who can build high-performing teams, drive operational rigor, lead through production incidents, and scale both people and systems through automation and AI-enabled engineering practices.


What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of 10 engineers across India, Israel, and Brazil.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, career development planning, and succession planning for team members.
  • Own the reliability, availability, performance, security posture, and operational health of a multi-region, multi-tenant SaaS platform running on Azure and AWS.
  • Define, measure, and continuously improve service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and operational KPIs.
  • Maintain clear visibility into team execution, operational risks, and delivery commitments, using data, metrics, and artifacts to drive accountability and decision-making.
  • Personally lead and coordinate P1 and P2 production incidents, ensuring timely resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and strong operational discipline.
  • Ensure customer-grade root cause analyses (RCAs) are delivered on schedule, with corrective and preventive actions tracked through completion.
  • Drive proactive monitoring, alerting, observability, and platform health initiatives using Grafana Cloud and modern cloud-native tooling.
  • Partner closely with Product, Security, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams to align platform priorities with business objectives.
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure and platform operations across Kubernetes, databases, networking, automation, and deployment systems.
  • Drive GitOps and infrastructure-as-code practices using ArgoCD, Helm, Bicep, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and related automation technologies.
  • Foster a strong culture of documentation, operational readiness, runbooks, postmortems, and continuous improvement.
  • Champion engineering excellence through automation, reliability engineering practices, security-by-default principles, and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Establish clear accountability, visibility, and execution discipline across the team while maintaining a high bar for operational ownership and customer experience.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years managing DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure teams of 5 or more engineers in multiple geographies.
  • Proven success operating within globally distributed engineering organizations spanning multiple time zones and cultures, with a track record of partnering effectively with leadership teams across North America, Israel, and India.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively as a bridge between globally distributed teams, translating business priorities into clear technical execution and ensuring alignment across regions and functions.
  • Track record of building high-trust, high-accountability engineering cultures that emphasize ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and operational topics clearly to engineers, executives, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on technical background in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure prior to moving into management.
  • Experience carrying production on-call responsibilities and operating mission-critical systems in a 24×7 environment.
  • Proven experience running large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, preferably across multiple regions and cloud providers.
  • Proven track record of leading organizational change by embedding AI-assisted workflows into engineering, operations, incident management, documentation, and software delivery processes, resulting in measurable improvements in productivity, quality, operational efficiency, and delivery outcomes.
  • Deep expertise with Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience, including AKS or EKS, containerized workloads, and production operations.
  • Experience with Helm, GitOps workflows, ArgoCD, or equivalent deployment automation platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code using Bicep, Terraform, ARM, or similar tools, with strong emphasis on reproducibility and version control.
  • Strong observability expertise using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent monitoring and telemetry platforms.
  • Experience operating and supporting relational databases (MSSQL) at scale, running on RDS and Azure Elastic Pool.
  • Deep understanding of incident management, escalation processes, operational readiness, and customer-facing RCA practices.

title: Principal Security Engineer
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Security Operations Manager to lead detection, response, and security monitoring for a self-clearing broker-dealer. You’ll build and lead the team and the 24x7 program that keeps our platform — and our advisors’ clients — safe.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the security operations / detection & response team, setting priorities and career paths.
  • Own our 24x7 security monitoring strategy across our managed detection & response provider
  • Run the incident response program end to end — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Define and report on SecOps metrics and SLAs (MTTD/MTTR, alert quality, coverage) to security and executive leadership.
  • Mature our detection engineering, threat-intelligence ingestion, and response automation (SOAR) capabilities.
  • Drive regular tabletop and purple-team exercises and partner with Cloud, IT, and Engineering to close gaps surfaced by monitoring.
  • Own the day-to-day operation and roadmap of the security operations tooling stack.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience - 6+ years in security operations, including 2+ years leading or managing a SOC or detection & response team:
  • Hands-on incident response and investigations in a cloud-first environment
  • Depth with SIEM (Datadog/Splunk), EDR/MDR (CrowdStrike/SentinelOne), and cloud telemetry (AWS)
  • Experience managing an MDR/MSSP and/or IR retainer relationship
  • Strong ability to lead through influence and operate with urgency
  • Education - A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
  • Technical aptitude - You’re technologically savvy and comfortable across modern cloud and detection stacks (i.e., AWS, Kubernetes, SIEM query languages, detection-as-code, Terraform, etc.)
  • Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
  • Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
  • Resilience - We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
  • Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
  • Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

  • Experience working in regulated environments (SEC/FINRA, fintech, or financial services)
  • Experience building or standing up a 24x7 SOC or transitioning to managed detection & response
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA)
Los Angeles, CA salary range
$203,000—$285,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

  • Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
  • 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
  • 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
  • Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
  • Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
  • One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Perform related duties as assigned.

title: Director, NPI and Sustaining Program Management – Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
The Director of NPI Program Management is responsible for leading and orchestrating end-to-end new product introduction (NPI) execution across OCI hardware and infrastructure programs. This role will lead a team of Operations Program Managers who drive and lead global, cross-functional teams to deliver new products on the product roadmap. These releases will require driving alignment with product development, other functions within supply chain, and the delivery teams to ensure seamless transition across various organizations. In addition, this role will manage any operational activities required through the life of the program. Operating in a highly distributed environment, the Director ensures disciplined program governance, clear executive communication, and risk-managed execution across all release builds and product lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

  • NPI Planning & Program Leadership

  • Own and manage all NPI planning for product release builds, ensuring alignment across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and quality.

  • Drive program structure, timelines, dependencies, phase gates, risk mitigation, and deliverables across globally distributed teams.

  • Execution & Change Management

  • Drive alignment and the plan of record between demand planning and manufacturing on NPI builds and ramp production schedules.

  • Ensure all supply chain, manufacturing, and engineering functions are completing checklists and delivering to critical milestones.

  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate program risks across product, supply chain, and manufacturing readiness.

  • Ensure all compliance requirements are met.

  • Governance & Phase Gate Management

  • Define and enforce phase gate exit criteria for all NPI milestones.

  • Lead readiness and executive reviews, clearly outlining risks, trade-offs, and required actions.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product Engineering, Test Engineering, and Quality to ensure manufacturability, scalability, and reliability.

  • Act as the central coordination point between design, manufacturing, and planning teams globally.

  • Product Life cycle Management

  • Manage products after NPI through sustaining and end-of-life

  • Drive stop/ship and purge activities and decisions, ensuring clear communication of impact, risk, and recovery plans.

  • Ensure any post NPI ECOs are implemented, and second source part qualifications are completed, to minimize supply risk and manufacturing disruptions.

  • Executive Communication

  • Deliver concise, high-impact updates to senior leadership, clearly articulating status, risks, and required decisions.

  • Standardize “net it out” communication practices across program teams.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in program management, product engineering, or NPI within complex hardware or cloud infrastructure environments.

  • Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional product launches.

  • Deep expertise in product lifecycle management (PLM), ECO processes, and manufacturing readiness.

  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across global, matrixed organizations.

  • Exceptional ability to distill complex issues into clear executive-level communication.

Impact of the Role
This role is critical to ensuring OCI products are launched with speed, quality, and operational readiness. By driving disciplined NPI execution and clear executive alignment, the Director accelerates time-to-market, reduces risk, and enables scalable deployment of next-generation cloud infrastructure.

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Full Stack - Node & React [T500-27990]
description:
About REA Group:

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way people experience property?”

Thirty years later, REA Group is a global digital real estate leader operating across multiple continents, building large-scale, consumer-facing platforms used by millions every day.

Our success comes from staying true to a day-one mindset—combining innovation, curiosity, and long-term thinking to evolve complex systems that power critical customer journeys.


REA Cyber City is an extension of REA Group’s global technology organization. Teams here work closely with counterparts in Australia and other regions to design, build, and operate core platforms and capabilities. Engineers in Cyber City contribute directly to REA’s long-term technology strategy, solving real-world problems at scale and shaping systems that need to perform, adapt, and endure over time.

If you’re excited by the challenge of building resilient systems, working on meaningful problems, and growing with a global engineering organization—read on.


Senior Lead Engineer – Full Stack

What the role is all about:

We’re seeking a Senior Lead / Staff Engineer who operates as a squad architect and systems thinker, owning complex technical problems end-to-end and shaping the evolution of REA’s platforms at scale.

This role is designed for a senior individual contributor who leads primarily through technical depth, architectural judgement, and operational ownership. The focus is on designing, building, evolving, and operating reliable systems over time—while influencing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and enabling predictable delivery across squads.

You will work closely with engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and stakeholders to solve domain-wide problems and ensure systems remain scalable, secure, and maintainable as REA continues to grow.


Core Behavioral Signals:

  • Shapes architecture and ensures long-term technical direction aligned with platform and domain goals.
  • Drives system health, stability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Solves domain-wide and cross-team technical problems.
  • Enforces quality, standards, and strong engineering practices.
  • Resolves complex dependencies across squads and systems.
  • Influences technical strategy and represents engineering in decision forums.


What you’ll do:

Technical Execution:

  • Design, build, review, and operate production-grade full-stack systems using modern engineering practices.
  • Own delivery of complex, high-impact features and subsystems, leading by example in code quality, correctness, and performance.
  • Work hands-on across frontend and backend codebases using technologies such as React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js.
  • Drive high engineering standards through pairing, deep code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


Design & Architecture:

  • Own architecture decisions for complex systems, documenting and communicating trade-offs through design reviews and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Shape subsystem and platform-level architecture aligned with REA’s long-term technical strategy.
  • Evaluate and articulate trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
  • Design and evolve APIs, services, and data flows that scale across teams and domains.
  • Design or contribute to event-driven and asynchronous architectures; experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka) is a plus.


System Ownership & Operational Excellence:

  • Own production systems end-to-end, including reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and technical debt management.
  • Own application performance across the stack by identifying bottlenecks, driving optimizations, and ensuring systems meet latency and scalability targets.
  • Design and operate containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Ensure systems are observable, resilient, and designed for safe failure and recovery.
  • Champion continuous improvement in operational practices and developer experience.


Delivery Leadership:

  • Contribute to planning and sequencing of work, helping teams balance scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies and technical risks early, unblocking teams through sound technical decisions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers and delivery leads to improve predictability without compromising quality.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship:

  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on guidance.
  • Raise the technical bar across squads by reinforcing strong engineering practices and architectural consistency.
  • Influence without formal authority, earning trust through technical credibility and clarity of thinking.


What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience operating as a senior contributor on complex, production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern full-stack technologies, including React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js.
  • Experience designing and operating systems on AWS and/or GCP, including cloud-native services.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles, including trunk-based development, automated testing, progressive delivery, and rollback strategies.
  • Experience designing and operating containerized systems using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ownership of system design, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and technical direction to diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong mentoring mindset with the ability to elevate others without direct people management responsibility.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and pragmatic trade-offs are required.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka), or large-scale asynchronous systems.
  • Exposure to platform engineering or shared services models.
  • Experience evolving legacy systems while delivering new capabilities.


Why join REA Cyber City:

  • Work on globally impactful products used by millions.
  • Be part of a growing global engineering organization with strong technical standards.
  • Influence systems, teams, and culture from an early stage.
  • Collaborate closely with global leaders and technologists.
  • Grow as a people leader, delivery owner, and technology leader.


The values we live by:

Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

title: Patent Professional (m/f/d)
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Today, Ericsson owns one of the ICT industry's most valuable portfolio of patents. The global patent portfolio consists of 60,000 granted patents within the areas of cellular technology, consumer electronics, cloud, networks and beyond. Ericsson’s Patent Creation Management is part of the global Ericsson GFGS IPR & Licensing Organization and is responsible for all inventions originating from all Ericsson R&D sites worldwide. The Patent Unit Continental Europe is part of the Ericsson’s Patent Creation Management Organization and is responsible for providing IPR support for Ericsson’s R&D centers on the continent of Europe and for all further IPR related tasks.

We are now expanding our team in Aachen, Germany, and are looking for motivated patent professionals who want to contribute to one of the industry’s largest and most valuable patent portfolios. The role is open both to young professionals at the beginning of their patent career and to more experienced patent professionals, including candidates who are qualified, partly qualified, or currently progressing towards a German or European Patent Attorney qualification. You will join a company dedicated to research and innovation, leading the development of cellular technology including 5G, 6G and beyond.

What you will do:

  • Provide IPR support for Ericsson’s R&D operations by working closely with inventors, technical experts and innovative technologies, with a particular focus on building a world-class patent portfolio.
  • Take responsibility for a patent docket appropriate to your experience level, including evaluating inventions, making value-based filing and prosecution recommendations, and drafting and prosecuting patent applications.
  • Contribute to key projects supporting licensing and litigation, such as patent mining, business-driven claim chart generation, rebuttal work, technical discussions, and reverse engineering activities.
  • Depending on your qualification, experience and interests, engage in patent portfolio management, oppositions and/or nullity actions to contribute to the value creation from Ericsson’s patents.
  • Engage in working groups and strategic projects to improve operations, processes and portfolio-related decision making.

The skills you bring:

  • Excellent university degree in engineering, physics, computer science or a related technical field; experience as an inventor, in standardization, or in technical project work is an advantage.
  • Interest in, and ideally understanding of, telecommunication technologies, cellular standards, networks, cloud, software or related ICT fields.
  • German or European Patent Attorney qualification, partial qualification, or ongoing preparation towards such qualification is highly welcome, but not mandatory for young professionals with strong technical and analytical skills.
  • Professional experience in patent drafting, prosecution, portfolio management, oppositions, litigation support or licensing-related patent work is an advantage and will be reflected in the scope of responsibilities.
  • Strong commitment to actively and systematically using modern digital tools, including AI-based drafting, analysis, search, workflow and portfolio-management tools, across all relevant areas of patent work to improve quality, efficiency and value creation.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills, accuracy, flexibility, and a collaborative mindset.
  • Excellent analytical skills, sound judgment and a solution-oriented working style.
  • Very good language skills in English; German language skills are a plus.

Additional information

As a suitable candidate, you are curious, adaptable and motivated to grow in a dynamic environment shaped by legal, business and technological developments. Whether you are at the start of your patent career or already bring substantial experience as a patent professional, we offer you the opportunity to become part of a highly professional and international team of patent professionals and paralegals. We will support your further development, including training towards the European Patent Attorney qualification where required.

The office location will be Aachen from January 2027.

Why join Ericsson?At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Client Intake Specialist
description:
About the Role
The Client Intake Specialist is the first human connection for people reaching out to Jimerson Birr.

Your job is to make that first interaction professional, responsive, and helpful while ensuring every inbound opportunity is accurately captured, qualified, and moved to the right next step.

You will respond to new inquiries, gather information, determine whether a prospective client fits the firm's criteria, schedule qualified prospects for consultations, and prepare them for what comes next.

This is a role where speed and accuracy matter equally.

You will work within clear processes, scripts, qualification standards, and escalation paths but you'll also need to sound like a real person. The people contacting the firm may be dealing with stressful or unfamiliar situations, so your ability to listen, communicate clearly, and create confidence is just as important as following the process correctly.

The ideal person is conscientious, organized, dependable, and comfortable working with deadlines and changing priorities. You like knowing what is expected of you, take pride in getting the details right, and want to become someone the team can trust to handle an important part of the client experience.
What You'll Do
Be the First Point of Contact
  • Respond quickly and professionally to inbound inquiries from web, phone, campaigns, and overnight queues.
  • Create a positive, high-trust first impression for every prospective client.
  • Listen carefully and gather accurate information during the initial conversation.
  • Confirm contact information, matter details, and required permissions.
  • Check existing records so returning clients and former clients are recognized appropriately.
  • Complete the required conflict flag before substantive outreach.
Qualify Prospective Clients
  • Follow the firm's intake and qualification process consistently.
  • Use the appropriate script, AI tools, and platform support for each lead source.
  • Ask thoughtful questions while keeping the conversation natural and professional.
  • Evaluate prospective clients against the firm's Ideal Client Profile and matter-fit standards.
  • Accurately categorize opportunities according to established qualification criteria.
  • Apply disqualification standards consistently and route declined opportunities to the appropriate destination.
  • Escalate borderline situations rather than guessing.
Schedule Consultations
  • Convert qualified opportunities into scheduled consultations.
  • Book consultations during the intake conversation whenever possible.
  • Match qualified prospects with the appropriate consultation path and closer.
  • Provide clear information about the consultation, including timing, expectations, documents, and next steps.
  • Complete warm transfers to on-call closers when appropriate.
  • Ensure the information needed by the next person in the process is complete and accurate.
Prepare the Prospect for the Consultation
  • Send consultation confirmations promptly.
  • Execute the appropriate pre-consultation communication and nurture sequence.
  • Gather and organize relevant information and documents.
  • Prepare the closer with a clear picture of the prospect and their matter before the consultation.
  • Reconfirm upcoming consultations and help prevent avoidable no-shows.
  • Rebook prospects when appropriate rather than allowing an opportunity to disappear.
Follow Up and Recover Opportunities
  • Follow up with prospective clients who have not responded or completed the next step.
  • Conduct scheduled chase calls and follow-up outreach.
  • Document the reason when an opportunity is lost or does not move forward.
  • Identify recurring patterns in non-engagement or lack of fit.
  • Communicate meaningful patterns to the Client Onboarding team and Demand team.
Who You Are

You are dependable, conscientious, and comfortable working within a clear process.

You like knowing what good looks like. Once you've been trained on the process, you take pride in following it accurately and consistently.

You notice details other people might miss. You naturally double-check your work because you understand that a small mistake at intake can create a much bigger problem later.

You are also comfortable with a changing workload. One moment you're responding to a new inquiry; the next you're confirming a consultation, following up with someone who went quiet, or helping prepare a closer for an upcoming call. You enjoy that variety, especially when there is a clear priority in front of you.

You communicate warmly and professionally. You can persuade without being pushy, ask questions without making someone feel interrogated, and keep a conversation moving without losing the human element.

You are comfortable talking to people you don't know, including people who may be frustrated, worried, or uncertain about what to do next.

You are respectful of established processes and understand why they exist. At the same time, you're comfortable asking questions when something is unclear rather than making assumptions.

You appreciate supportive leadership and clear expectations. Once you understand the role and the firm's standards, you want to be trusted to do your job well without someone constantly looking over your shoulder.

You care about accuracy, punctuality, and follow-through.

And when you've made a commitment to complete something, you want it done correctly and closed out.

What You Bring
  • Experience in client intake, customer service, administrative support, inside sales, call center, legal intake, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Excellent verbal communication and active listening skills.
  • The ability to build rapport quickly with people you've never spoken with before.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • The ability to follow established processes, scripts, and qualification standards consistently.
  • Comfort working with technology, CRM systems, scheduling platforms, AI-assisted tools, and other digital systems.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • Good judgment about when to follow the established process and when to escalate an issue.
  • Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential client and prospective-client information.
  • A calm, composed approach when conversations become difficult or emotionally charged.
  • A willingness to learn, accept coaching, and become highly knowledgeable about the firm's intake process.
  • Reliable follow-through and a strong sense of personal accountability.
You don't need to be a lawyer or have a legal background.

What matters most is your ability to listen, communicate, follow a process, get the details right, and make sure every opportunity receives the right next step.
Why Join Us
The Client Intake Specialist plays an important role in the firm's growth and client experience.

Every new opportunity starts here.

That means the work you do directly affects whether a prospective client gets connected with the right person, whether a qualified consultation gets booked, and whether the attorney receives a prospect who is actually prepared for the conversation.

You'll have clear standards, defined processes, supportive leadership, and the training needed to become highly confident in the role.

You'll also have enough variety to keep the day moving. You're not simply answering the same question over and over—you're talking with different people, handling different situations, managing different stages of the intake process, and helping move each opportunity toward the right outcome.

At Jimerson Birr, we value commitment to service, quality, and results. In this role, that means responding quickly, treating every prospective client with professionalism, capturing information accurately, following through on commitments, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

If you take pride in being the person who gets the details right, follows through, and creates a great first impression, this could be a great fit.

About the Role

Crenovent is looking for an early-career Cloud DevOps & Platform Operations Engineer who wants to build a career across cloud engineering, DevOps, platform operations, data integration, security, compliance, and eventually Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).

We are not looking for an experienced DevOps specialist.

We are looking for someone with strong technical fundamentals, hands-on curiosity, structured problem-solving ability, and the capacity to learn quickly while working on real production systems across Microsoft Azure and AWS.

This is deliberately a broader role than traditional DevOps.

The engineer will work across four interconnected areas:

Cloud & DevOps → Data & Enterprise Integrations → Security/Compliance → Reliability Engineering

The person joining this role should therefore be comfortable learning across disciplines rather than restricting themselves to infrastructure deployment alone.



What You Will Work On1. Microsoft Azure & AWS

You will learn to deploy, configure, operate, and troubleshoot cloud infrastructure across both Azure and AWS.

Your work may include:

  • Azure App Service
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure PostgreSQL and other managed databases
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Monitor and Application Insights
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Azure Virtual Networks
  • Azure Container Registry
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS RDS
  • AWS S3
  • AWS Lambda
  • AWS IAM
  • AWS VPC
  • AWS CloudWatch
  • AWS Secrets Manager
  • Containerized workloads using Docker

You are not expected to know all of these on Day 1. Strong fundamentals and demonstrated ability to learn cloud technologies are more important.



2. DevOps & CI/CD

You will help engineering teams move code safely and consistently from development into deployed environments.

This will include:

  • Git and GitHub
  • GitHub Actions
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Development, staging, UAT and production environments
  • Environment configuration
  • Deployment automation
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Terraform fundamentals
  • Docker
  • Secrets and configuration management
  • Release management
  • Deployment verification
  • Backup and recovery procedures
  • Basic infrastructure troubleshooting

You will gradually learn how to make deployments repeatable, observable, secure and auditable, rather than relying on manual operations.



3. Data, Demo Environments & CRM Integrations

An important part of this role is understanding that infrastructure exists to support applications and data.

Crenovent works with enterprise systems and CRM data. You will therefore develop practical knowledge of how data enters, moves through and is maintained within an enterprise application.

You may work with platforms such as:

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365
  • Salesforce
