  • Other CRM and enterprise applications
  • APIs and webhooks
  • CSV/Excel/JSON datasets
  • SQL databases
  • REST APIs
  • Data import/export mechanisms

Typical assignments may include:

  • Creating realistic synthetic/demo datasets
  • Preparing demo CRM accounts, contacts, leads and opportunities
  • Populating demonstration environments
  • Importing and exporting CRM data
  • Understanding CRM schemas and relationships
  • Mapping fields between source and destination systems
  • Moving data from CRM systems into Crenovent environments
  • Validating data after migration or ingestion
  • Identifying duplicate, malformed or missing records
  • Supporting API-based integrations
  • Understanding basic ETL/ELT concepts
  • Creating repeatable processes for resetting or rebuilding demo environments

You should develop the ability to understand not only where an application is deployed, but also where its data comes from, where it goes, and how it can be validated.



4. Security, Compliance & Audit Readiness

This role will progressively develop into a combination of DevOps + Cloud Governance + Compliance Engineering.

You will learn how enterprise software companies demonstrate that their technology and operational processes are secure and controlled.

You may support activities related to:

  • Access-control reviews
  • User and privileged-access management
  • IAM and RBAC
  • Secrets management
  • Environment separation
  • Audit logging
  • Infrastructure inventories
  • Configuration documentation
  • Security evidence collection
  • Backup verification
  • Vulnerability-management processes
  • Patch-management tracking
  • Change-management evidence
  • Incident documentation
  • Business continuity and disaster recovery
  • Security policies and operating procedures
  • Cloud security posture
  • Compliance evidence repositories

Over time, you will develop familiarity with frameworks and concepts such as:

  • SOC 2
  • ISO 27001
  • GDPR
  • Data privacy and protection
  • Security controls
  • Risk registers
  • Audit evidence
  • Control testing
  • Vendor/security assessments

You will not be expected to be a compliance specialist when you join. The expectation is that you can learn how technical systems, operational controls and compliance requirements connect.



5. Monitoring, Reliability & Future SRE Responsibilities

As your technical capability develops, the role will progressively move toward Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).

You will learn:

  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • Application monitoring
  • Centralized logging
  • Alerting
  • Health checks
  • Incident management
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
  • Availability and uptime measurement
  • Performance monitoring
  • Capacity management
  • Automated recovery
  • Production readiness
  • SLIs and SLOs
  • Reliability engineering

The long-term objective is to develop an engineer who understands the complete operational lifecycle:

Build → Deploy → Secure → Observe → Audit → Operate → Recover → Improve



What We Expect You to Know

For this 0–1 year role, we are looking for fundamentals rather than mastery.

You should have basic knowledge of several of the following:

  • Linux
  • Cloud computing concepts
  • Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
  • Git/GitHub
  • CI/CD concepts
  • Docker
  • Networking fundamentals
  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS and APIs
  • SQL
  • Databases
  • JSON and CSV
  • REST APIs
  • Python or another scripting language
  • Basic information-security concepts

Exposure through internships, personal projects, college projects, certifications, labs or self-learning is acceptable.



What We Do Not Expect

You do not need:

  • 3–5 years of DevOps experience
  • Expert-level Kubernetes knowledge
  • Deep multi-cloud architecture experience
  • Existing SOC 2 or ISO 27001 implementation experience
  • Advanced SRE experience
  • Expert knowledge of Salesforce or Dynamics 365
  • Experience managing very large production infrastructure

Those are capabilities that can be developed progressively within the role.

What matters more is whether you understand the fundamentals and can systematically learn unfamiliar systems.



The Candidate We Are Looking For

A strong candidate for this role is someone who:

  • Has strong computer-science and engineering fundamentals
  • Has experimented with Azure, AWS or both
  • Can work comfortably with Linux and command-line tools
  • Understands basic databases and APIs
  • Can write simple scripts to automate repetitive work
  • Is interested in understanding how systems work end-to-end
  • Can investigate technical problems rather than waiting for exact instructions
  • Documents work systematically
  • Pays attention to configuration, permissions and security
  • Can work with checklists, evidence and operational procedures
  • Is comfortable moving between infrastructure, application, data and security problems
  • Wants to develop broad engineering depth early in their career



A Typical Problem You Might Solve

A Crenovent demonstration environment needs data from a CRM.

Instead of simply receiving a narrowly defined infrastructure task, you may need to:

Understand the CRM → identify the relevant entities and fields → prepare synthetic demo data → configure credentials securely → connect through an API → move the data → validate it in the destination → configure the application environment → deploy the relevant service → verify logs → troubleshoot failures → document the setup → ensure credentials are not exposed → preserve the evidence required for audit.

That end-to-end ownership is what makes this role different from a conventional entry-level DevOps position.



How This Role Can Evolve

This role provides multiple potential development paths.

DevOps / Platform Engineering

Cloud Infrastructure → CI/CD → Infrastructure as Code → Containers → Platform Engineering

Site Reliability Engineering

Monitoring → Incident Management → Observability → SLOs → Reliability Automation → SRE

Cloud Security & Compliance

IAM → Cloud Governance → Security Controls → Audit Readiness → SOC 2 / ISO 27001 → Cloud Compliance Engineering

Data & Integration Operations

CRM Data → APIs → Data Pipelines → Integration Operations → Enterprise Data Platforms

The likely long-term profile at Crenovent is a combination of:

DevOps + SRE + Cloud Governance + Compliance Engineering

with sufficient data and integration knowledge to operate enterprise environments effectively.



Qualifications
  • B.Tech/B.E./BCA/MCA/B.Sc. Computer Science or equivalent technical background
  • 0–1 year of professional experience
  • Fresh graduates with strong hands-on projects are encouraged to apply
  • Azure or AWS certifications are useful but not mandatory
  • Relevant internships, GitHub projects, cloud labs or independently built systems will be considered positively



What We Will Evaluate

We are less interested in how many cloud-service names you can memorize and more interested in whether you can reason through technical systems.

The selection process may evaluate:

  • Linux fundamentals
  • Cloud fundamentals
  • Azure/AWS concepts
  • Networking basics
  • Git
  • CI/CD concepts
  • Docker fundamentals
  • SQL and databases
  • APIs and JSON
  • Basic scripting
  • Troubleshooting approach
  • Security awareness
  • Ability to understand data movement
  • Ability to learn an unfamiliar technical system
  • Documentation discipline

Candidates may also be given a practical assignment involving a small cloud deployment, API/data integration or DevOps automation problem.

title: Senior Analyst, Property Claims Analytics
description:
Description

The Loss Insights Analytics team sits within US Retail Markets Property Claims organization and is at the center of some of the most consequential decisions in our claims organization. We quantify the financial impact of changes across the full lifecycle of a claim — from first notice of loss through final resolution — including the adoption of new tools, vendors, and process innovations. We are a team of rigorous, intellectually driven analysts who believe that the right question, asked at the right time, is just as powerful as the right answer. If you are energized by complex problems, motivated by meaningful work, and want your analysis to directly shape how one of the world's largest insurers handles billions of dollars in property claims, this is your team.

**This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location**

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Senior Analyst to join the Loss Insights team. In this role, you will design and execute high-complexity analyses that drive tangible improvements to claims handling processes and financial outcomes. You will serve as a trusted analytical voice to senior stakeholders, translating nuanced data findings into clear, compelling recommendations. This is not just a reporting role — it is a thinking role. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, identify the stories hidden in data, and advocate for evidence-based decisions.

What You Will Do:

  • Drive Financial Insight: Design and conduct moderate-to-high complexity analyses evaluating the financial performance of claims operations, process changes, and newly adopted tools or vendor partnerships across the full claim lifecycle.
  • Measure What Matters: Build and maintain reporting frameworks that track initiative success, financial performance, and key operational metrics — ensuring stakeholders always have a clear, accurate picture of business outcomes.
  • Lead Analytical Projects: Own moderately complex, end-to-end analytical projects independently, partnering with Claims Process, Data Office, Product, and other key partners to develop rigorous solutions and see initiatives through to measurable impact.
  • Turn Data into Action: Synthesize complex, multi-source data into concise, actionable recommendations and present findings confidently to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Shape the Future of Claims: Contribute to a team culture of intellectual curiosity and continuous improvement, proactively identifying new analytical opportunities that enhance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For:

  • You are intellectually curious. You don't just answer the question asked — you interrogate it. You are energized by ambiguity, drawn to complex problems, and always looking for the insight beneath the surface.
  • You are analytically rigorous. You have hands-on experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing data across multiple sources. You are proficient in one or more of the following: SAS, SQL, Python, or R — and you know how to use these tools not just to pull data, but to build compelling analytical narratives.
  • You think critically and communicate clearly. You can translate a sophisticated analysis into a story that resonates with a non-technical audience. You are comfortable presenting to stakeholders and defending your methodology under scrutiny.
  • You are a proactive, organized self-starter. You manage your own workload with discipline, follow through without being prompted, and thrive in an environment where you are trusted to work independently.
  • You are a collaborative team player. You bring energy and engagement to the team, invest in the success of your colleagues, and build strong relationships across partner teams.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree plus a minimum 3 years, typically 4 or more years of experience, or equivalent, is required. Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or other quantitative field are preferred fields of study.
  • Advanced knowledge of data sources, tools, statistical principles and methodologies, and techniques.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (VBA, macros, scripts, formulas, data visualization, etc.), PowerPoint, and statistical software packages (SAS, Snowflake).
  • Must have good planning, analytical, decision-making and communication skills.
  • Solid understanding of business to improve business outcomes.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit:

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
At Pediatrics Plus, we are looking for an IT Support Engineer to join our team! Pediatrics Plus is a specialized pediatric healthcare provider. We are committed to helping children succeed in all stages of life through evidence-based therapy and education, diagnostic services, state-of-the-art facilities, specialized equipment, family support, and community investment.

What we offer:

  • Competitive Pay
  • Paid Time Off
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • State of the Art Facilities & Technology

What you will do:

The IT Support Engineer will install, troubleshoot, maintain, and support hardware, software, and technology systems throughout the company. They provide experienced technical support to team members both remotely and onsite at Pediatrics Plus locations. The IT Support Engineer will regularly travel to Pediatrics Plus locations to provide both reactive technical support and proactive maintenance, helping ensure technology is reliable and operating effectively across the company.

Hardware and Device Support

  1. Set ups, configures, maintains, and troubleshoots computers, monitors, printers, mobile devices, and other technology equipment.
  2. Diagnoses and resolves hardware and peripheral issues.
  3. Assists with deployment and replacement of technology equipment.

Software and User Support

  1. Troubleshoots Microsoft applications, operating systems, remote access, and other business applications.
  2. Manages users, passwords, permissions, and basic configurations in Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
  3. Installs, configures, updates, and troubleshoots software applications.
  4. Provides technical assistance to team members both remotely and onsite.

Network and Systems Support

  1. Troubleshoots common network and connectivity issues.
  2. Assists with wireless, printer, and network troubleshooting.
  3. Escalates more complex server, network, security, and infrastructure issues to the appropriate IT team member.
  4. Assists senior IT staff and outside providers with system maintenance and technology projects.

Help Desk and Customer Service

  1. Tracks, prioritizes, monitors, and resolves tickets in the ticketing system.
  2. Handles technical issues independently when within the scope of the role.
  3. Recognizes when an issue requires escalation and communicates relevant information to the appropriate resource.
  4. Provides excellent customer service and communicates technical information clearly to non-technical team members.

Clinic and Field Support

  1. Regularly travels to Pediatrics Plus locations within approximately a two-hour driving radius to provide onsite IT support.
  2. Responds to technology issues that require onsite troubleshooting and resolution.
  3. Conducts proactive visits to Pediatrics Plus locations to identify and address potential technology issues before they impact operations.
  4. Installs, configures, replaces, and troubleshoots computers, printers, network-connected devices, and other technology equipment at Pediatrics Plus locations.
  5. Builds strong working relationships with leadership and team members and serve as a trusted onsite IT resource.
  6. Coordinates with other IT team members and outside providers when issues require additional technical expertise.
  7. Documents work performed, equipment changes, and unresolved issues following site visits.

IT Operations

  1. Tracks and monitors technology inventory.
  2. Maintains accurate documentation of equipment, systems, and common support procedures.
  3. Assists with new team member technology setup and team member offboarding.
  4. Identifies recurring technical issues and recommends practical improvements.
  5. Communicates effectively with outside contractors and technology providers.

General

  1. Upholds and incorporates the core values, mission, and philosophy of Pediatrics Plus into all job responsibilities.
  2. Participates in one-on-one meetings with leader.
  3. Works collaboratively with other members of the IT team and departments throughout the company.
  4. Performs other related and non-related duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

What you have:

  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to independently resolve common hardware, software, user account, and connectivity issues.
  • Working knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft applications.
  • Basic understanding of Active Directory, Microsoft 365, networking, and server environments.
  • Ability to recognize when an issue should be escalated to a more senior technical resource.
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple support requests and prioritize work appropriately.
  • Ability to independently manage a schedule that includes both planned location visits and unplanned/reactive support needs.
  • Strong customer service skills and ability to work effectively with non-technical team members.
  • Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with a wide variety of people.
  • Ability to document technical issues and solutions clearly.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to complete tasks in a timely manner.
  • Ability to maintain regular and punctual attendance.
  • Travel will be required. Must possess a valid driver's license in the state of Arkansas and maintain an acceptable driving record.

Education/Certification/Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent, required.
  • Associate or college degree, preferred.
  • Technical training or relevant certifications, preferred.
  • 3+ years of IT support experience, preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting Windows computers, software applications, printers, and peripheral devices.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and Active Directory environments, preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting basic networking and connectivity issues.

AI & Machine Learning

Statistical Modeling & Analytics

Computer Vision & OCR

  • Develop computer vision and OCR solutions for image and document understanding, including detection, classification, segmentation, and feature extraction.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Partner with business, program, or mission owners to understand requirements, define measurable objectives, and translate them into analytical solutions.

title: Senior Associate Scientist, Gene Delivery and Editing Process Development
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Position Summary

Bristol Myers Squibb is seeking an enthusiastic, self-driven individual to join the Gene Delivery and Editing Process Development team within the Cell Therapy Development organization. The Gene Delivery and Editing Process Development team develops the processes and technologies underpinning critical raw materials used in the manufacturing of engineered T cells. The primary focus of this Associate Scientist will be to support process development, production, and characterization of early and late-stage viral vectors (lentiviral vectors and/or adeno-associated viruses). This position will be providing technical subject matter expertise with internal and/or external development and manufacturing collaborators for activities including tech transfer, process characterization, and pre-clinical or clinical process lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on experimental work in the early-phase development and optimization of primarily upstream (mammalian cell culture, stirred tank bioreactors, and transient transfection) unit operations for viral vector production. Experience in downstream (clarification, AEX chromatography, Tangential Flow Filtration) viral vector production is a bonus.
  • Support process and technology development for viral vector manufacturing platforms
  • Support late-phase development activities including process characterization
  • Design, plan, execute, and analyze lab experiments using statistical design of experiment (DOE) principles
  • Maintain proper documentation of experimental results using an electronic lab notebook
  • Summarize and present scientific data; communicate progress to project teams
  • Author technical documents including protocols and internal development reports
  • Follow lab safety rules and practices

Qualifications & Experience

  • B.S. with 5+ years or M.S. with 2+ years of hands-on upstream experience (downstream is a plus)
  • Ability to design experiments with design of experiment (DOE) approaches, perform experiments, and interpret the results using statistical software (ex. JMP)
  • Independently motivated with ability to multi-task, problem-solve, train team members on lab operations, and coordinate activities within a team
  • Desire and drive to learn the biological mechanism of cell and gene therapy products and passion for their impact on the lives of patients with serious diseases
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely through oral presentation and technical writing
  • Embrace BMS shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity.

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Seattle - WA: $88,430 - $107,151

We‘re building something new. From scratch. At speed.

Commotion is launching an entirely new line of work — and we need the kind of engineer who lights up when they hear that. Not someone who needs a perfectly scoped ticket to start moving. Someone who can hold ambiguity in one hand and ship production code with the other.

This is a founding-energy role inside an operating company. You‘ll have real ownership, real autonomy, and real consequences to your decisions. We‘re not looking for someone who ‘can‘ do full stack work. We‘re looking for someone who has — under pressure, with imperfect information, and came out the other side with something that worked.


What the work looks like

You‘ll be the engine. The person the team turns to when something needs to go from idea to live in days, not quarters. You‘ll make architectural calls that stick, ship experiments before the spec is ‘ready,‘ and iterate in tight loops with product and leadership.

But here‘s the thing — you also know that speed without intent is just chaos. You think before you build. You ask the right questions early so you don‘t have to ask them later. You‘ve learned (probably the hard way) that 30 minutes of upfront thinking saves 3 weeks of rework.

Day to day, you will:


Architect, build, and own full features end-to-end — database to UI, deploy to monitor.

Make fast, reversible decisions. And occasionally, fast irreversible ones with good judgment.

Work across the stack in TypeScript — React on the front, Node on the back, Postgres and MongoDB underneath.

Prototype rapidly. Kill what doesn‘t work. Double down on what does.

Operate with extreme ownership. No ‘that‘s not my problem.‘ It‘s all your problem.

Collaborate directly with founders and leadership — no layers, no politics, no waiting for permission.


What you bring

5+ years building production software across the full stack.

Deep fluency in TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB — not just ‘familiar with,‘ but built real things with.

A track record of being the go-to person when the team needed something built fast and built right.

Comfort with ambiguity. You‘ve shipped in environments where the map was being drawn while you were already driving.

Strong architectural instincts — you know when to reach for the simple solution and when the problem genuinely demands complexity.

The ability to context-switch without losing depth.


What you won‘t find here

A backlog of perfectly groomed Jira tickets waiting for you.

Three rounds of architecture review before you can write a line of code.

A culture where ‘that‘s how we‘ve always done it‘ is an acceptable answer.


What you will find

A team that moves fast because they trust each other, not because someone is cracking a whip.

Greenfield problems — the kind of work most engineers only talk about wanting.

Direct impact. Your code, your decisions, your fingerprints on the product.

A genuine shot at building something that matters, with people who care about getting it right.


This role is for you if…

You‘ve been the person who built the first version. The one who got the call at 10 PM because ‘we need this by tomorrow‘ and actually delivered. The one who chose boring tech when boring tech was right, and new tech when the problem demanded it. You don‘t need to be managed. You need to be unleashed.


Interested? Don‘t send us a cover letter about your ‘passion for technology.‘ Send us the thing you built that you‘re most proud of, and tell us why.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking an exceptional Senior DevOps Engineer with more than 10 years of hands-on experience in automation, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD pipeline development. This role demands advanced expertise in AWS, Infrastructure as code, and container orchestration. The ideal candidate excels in planning new environments, integrating Docker-based applications, and evolving CI/CD processes to meet business needs. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will work directly with engineering and cross-functional teams, leveraging deep AWS knowledge to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient cloud-native solutions.

Key Responsibilities

DevOps Strategy & Implementation

  • Lead the adoption and execution of DevOps practices across multiple projects, promoting automation, standardization, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive the evolution of DevOps culture and processes throughout the organization.

AWS Infrastructure Management

  • Create and maintain AWS environments using EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, ELB, CloudWatch, Route53, Systems Manager (SSM), and Secrets Manager.
  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and aligned with business requirements.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform for reproducible, version-controlled deployments.
  • Promote best practices in infrastructure automation and maintainability.



CI/CD Pipeline

  • Design and optimize CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitLab, Artifactory, Terraform Cloud and Helm
  • Integrate with SAST/DAST tools for security scans and Code Quality

Containerization & Application Integration

  • Design and deploy containerized workloads using EKS


GitOps

  • Implement GitOps workflows using ArgoCD to drive declarative, Git-based deployment and configuration management for Kubernetes (EKS) workloads.
  • Maintain Git as the single source of truth for infrastructure and application manifests, enabling automated sync, drift detection, and rollback.
  • Define branching and promotion strategies (dev → staging → production) to support safe, auditable, and repeatable releases.


Cost Efficiency

  • Conduct performance analysis and recommend on AWS cost-saving strategies.

Monitoring & Observability

  • Implement and maintain monitoring and alerting solutions using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, New Relic and CloudWatch.
  • Setup Alerts using Slack and JSM (on call support)
  • Enhance system visibility and maximize uptime across environments.
  • Leverage Grafana Cloud (Managed Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo) for unified metrics, logs, and tracing, reducing self-hosted observability overhead.
  • Build and maintain Grafana Cloud dashboards and SLO-based alerting to provide real-time visibility into service health and performance.

Security & Access Management

  • Create and manage IAM roles and policies, enforcing secure access control and least-privilege compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational security standards.

Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Participate in Quarterly Disaster Recovery drills, creating complete infrastructure replicas in alternate AWS regions.
  • Validate application recovery procedures and ensure business continuity readiness.

On-Call Support & Production Troubleshooting

  • Participate in on-call rotation to provide 24/7 production support, responding promptly to incidents and escalations via Slack and JSM.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot production issues across infrastructure, application, and network layers, using Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, and logs to identify root cause.
  • Drive incident response and resolution, ensuring timely restoration of service and minimal business impact.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews and root cause analysis, documenting findings and implementing preventive measures to reduce recurrence.

Collaboration & Feature Enablement

  • Work closely with development teams to plan, deploy, and test new features, while maintaining strong DevOps automation and reliability.

Required Skills & Technologies

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD Tools: GitLab Runners, Helm, Artifactory
  • Containerization & Orchestration: EKS, Docker
  • AWS Services: EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, ElastiCache, SNS, SQS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager (SSM), CloudWatch, CloudFront, Route53, ELB, API Gateway
  • Secrets & Configuration Management: 1Password, AWS Secrets Manager
  • Monitoring & Logging: New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki
  • GitOps: ArgoCD, Flux
  • Observability Platform: Grafana Cloud (Managed Prometheus, Loki, Tempo)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Proven expertise in AWS Cloud, CI/CD pipeline development, infrastructure automation, and container orchestration.
  • Strong proficiency with Terraform, GitOps and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Demonstrated success in CI/CD migration projects and AWS cost optimization initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills.
  • Effective communicator and mentor with leadership experience.

Preferred Attributes

  • AWS DevOps Engineer/Terraform/Kubernetes certifications

title: Senior Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - Hindi Speaking
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Singapore

This role is based in Singapore and supports customers and partners across India and APJC. Professional fluency in English and Hindi is required to lead technical and executive conversations in both languages to communicate with clients in those regions. Travel of up to 30% is expected, primarily within APJC, including India.

About Developer GTM

Developer GTM organization is a startup within Cloudflare, driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most exciting place for developers to build.

About the Role

As Senior Solutions Architect for Developer Platform, you will own the regional technical strategy for Cloudflare’s Developer Platform customer and partner engagements.

You will work with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and move production workloads onto Cloudflare. You will operate across a portfolio of engagements rather than focusing on a single account or project.

A central part of the role is turning field experience into broader impact. You will create reusable architectures and technical guidance, and provide product teams with clear evidence about regional customer needs.

This is a senior individual-contributor role combining hands-on architecture, executive influence and regional technical leadership. It reports to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for Developer Platform customers and partners.
  • Translate business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.
  • Lead architecture discovery, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions.
  • Advise engineering executives and other senior stakeholders on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.
  • Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that can be reused across customers and the APJC field organization.
  • Remain hands-on by building, reviewing, and troubleshooting representative applications and integrations.
  • Serve as a regional Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, public speaking, written guidance, and internal enablement.
  • Mentor solutions architects and other technical colleagues working on complex customer engagements.
  • Partner with sales, product management, Developer Relations, and marketing on account strategy, product launches, customer evidence, and technical content.
  • Build effective feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to customers, partners, and internal leaders.
  • Establish clear technical strategies and adoption plans for priority Developer Platform engagements.
  • Help customers validate and launch production workloads on Cloudflare.
  • Publish reference architectures and field guidance that are reused across accounts and teams.
  • Improve the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare developer and AI solutions.
  • Develop the technical leadership of architects and other colleagues through mentorship and enablement.
  • Provide product teams with consistent, evidence-based insight into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.
  • Be recognized as a Developer Platform expert across APJC.

What We’re Looking For

  • Substantial experience in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. Successful candidates will typically bring 10 or more years of relevant experience, although demonstrated scope and impact matter more than a specific number of years.
  • Professional fluency in English and one common Indian language, with the ability to lead technical and executive discussions in both languages.
  • Experience owning complex technical strategies involving developers, platform or infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed application architecture, including compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability.
  • Hands-on software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept.
  • Experience with modern web technologies and at least one widely used programming ecosystem, preferably JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of serverless or cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.
  • A record of influencing without direct authority, mentoring technical colleagues, and turning individual solutions into reusable organizational capabilities.
  • Excellent written, presentation, facilitation, and technical-communication skills across developer, architectural, and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare’s Developer Platform.
  • Experience designing AI inference, agentic, retrieval-augmented generation, or data-intensive applications.
  • Experience working with customers, technology partners, or developer communities in India.
  • A record of public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or developer-community leadership.
  • Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

  • Develop resilient parsing logic to support companion-guide variations, normalization, payer-ID resolution, and CARC/RARC enrichment.

  • Implement secure file-processing workflows, including SFTP automation, PGP encryption, third-party integrations, retry mechanisms, and dead-letter handling.
  • Design transaction lifecycle state machines, content-based routing, exception queues, escalation workflows, scheduled jobs, and event-driven orchestration components.
  • Design and develop secure, scalable REST APIs using FastAPI or similar Python frameworks.
  • Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication, role-based access control, API versioning, pagination, and schema validation.
  • Contribute to operational UI components such as monitoring dashboards, transaction viewers, configuration screens, exception-management views, and audit logs.
  • Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Pytest and ensure that application logging follows PHI-safe practices.
  • Participate in Agile activities, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, backlog refinement, and cross-module interface discussions.

Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of professional experience in production-grade Python application development.
  • Strong knowledge of Python programming, Object-Oriented Programming, typing, packaging, asynchronous I/O, and Pytest.
  • Hands-on experience developing production REST APIs using FastAPI or a similar backend framework.
  • Experience implementing OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, and Pydantic or comparable schema-validation technologies.
  • Experience with message queues, retry patterns, idempotency, dead-letter queues, and high-volume batch or file-processing systems.
  • Strong SQL skills, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Practical experience with SFTP automation, PGP encryption, REST integrations, and third-party systems.
  • Experience designing workflows, state machines, event-driven processes, and scheduled jobs using technologies such as Celery, APScheduler, or Cron.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, structured logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Understanding of healthcare EDI transactions, particularly X12 835 and X12 837.
  • Knowledge of ISA/GS/ST envelopes, loops, segments, TA1 acknowledgements, and 999 acknowledgements.
  • Understanding of healthcare Revenue Cycle Management processes, including claims lifecycle, remittance posting, denial management, and clearinghouse integrations.

  • Familiarity with modern SPA frameworks and experience building operational dashboards or data-heavy user interfaces is beneficial.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Strong ownership, analytical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work across multiple technical modules in a lean and fast-paced engineering environment.

description:
About the role: Aleph Digital Technologies builds AI-native software for process industries: chemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy and water. Our platform lets process engineers analyse plant data, digitise engineering drawings, build and run simulations, and deploy monitoring pipelines, all through natural language.


We are an early-stage engineering team. You will work across both frontend and backend from your first week, alongside the engineers who built the platform. Expect direct and frequent feedback, and real ownership of your work early on.


This is a junior, full-stack role on our FastAPI backend and Next.js / TypeScript frontend, with a path into our LangChain and LangGraph agent stack as you build context.


Working arrangement

  • Remote, based in India. Engaged and paid locally through an employer-of-record arrangement.
  • At least five hours of daily overlap with Singapore business hours (SGT, UTC+8: India is 2.5 hours behind).


Responsibilities

  • Translate scoped requirements into production-ready features across our FastAPI backend and Next.js / TypeScript frontend.

  • Use AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle: scaffolding, code generation, test writing, code review: while retaining full ownership of the correctness and security of what ships.
  • Critically review and validate AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value, catching issues in logic or security that automated generation can introduce.
  • Contribute to implementation trade-offs and edge-case decisions within an architecture that has already been validated.
  • Develop, maintain and optimise the services and integrations that power the platform.
  • Take on work in our LangChain / LangGraph agent stack as you build experience with the codebase and our practices.


Qualifications


Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor‘s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Solid full-stack fundamentals: hands-on backend experience (Python and FastAPI a strong plus) and real frontend experience with React / Next.js and TypeScript.
  • Comfortable debugging across the stack, from a UI symptom, through an API call, to the data layer.
  • Regularly uses AI coding assistants as part of your own development workflow, and can describe a time you caught one producing wrong or unsafe code.
  • Able to move from a rough idea to a working feature without a perfect spec, while flagging risks and edge cases along the way.
  • Clear, direct communicator, comfortable working closely with a small team.
  • Familiar with Git workflows and the software development lifecycle.


Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with workflow and orchestration tools such as Prefect, Airflow or Temporal.
  • Interest in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, water, or other industrial and regulated-data domains.


This role is not for

  • Engineers who want to work on only one layer of the stack:frontend only, or backend only.
  • People who need a complete, locked specification before they can start.
  • Developers who ship a feature and disengage from what happens to it after launch.
  • Candidates who are not comfortable using AI coding tools as a normal part of daily work.

Hiring Process

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn. If you have questions about the role before applying, reach out to our hiring team.

title: Hardware Sales Specialist

What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers accurate, timely, and well-positioned quotes that help Account Managers win business.
  • Builds productive relationships with vendors and secures favorable pricing and program benefits.
  • Identifies opportunities to grow hardware revenue within existing client relationships.
  • Protects margin through careful pricing, strong vendor management, and attention to detail.
  • Keeps multiple active quotes and client needs organized without sacrificing accuracy or follow-through.
This role will include a base salary of $65,000–$70,000, with on-target earnings of $85,000–$100,000 depending on performance.

Client Account Management
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with existing hardware clients and support a smooth transition of inherited accounts.
  • Respond to client questions related to pricing, availability, part numbers, compatibility, lead times, and equipment options.
  • Coordinate repair and refurbished-equipment requests with repair vendors, set clear turnaround expectations, and follow units through return to service.
  • Maintain knowledge of each client’s existing environment to make thoughtful, relevant hardware recommendations.
  • Partner with Account Managers to identify growth opportunities, including headset refreshes, handset upgrades, new-site needs, and aging equipment replacements.

Vendor Quoting & Sales Support
  • Serve as the primary quoting resource for the sales team across desktops, laptops, servers, networking equipment, wireless access points, monitors, docks, peripherals, VoIP phones, headsets, and related hardware.
  • Partner with Account Managers to confirm client requirements, including quantities, specifications, warranty terms, timelines, and site details.
  • Source and compare pricing from distributors, manufacturers, and specialty vendors; recommend the best-fit option based on client needs, availability, and value.
  • Register deals and pursue special pricing, promotions, rebates, and other available partner-program benefits.
  • Produce accurate, client-ready quotes with correct part numbers, current pricing, realistic lead times, and clear warranty or support terms.
  • Identify appropriate substitutions and alternatives for backordered or end-of-life equipment, clearly communicating any tradeoffs.
  • Hand approved quotes to the ordering team while remaining a consistent point of contact for the client.

Vendor Relationship Management
  • Own relationships with hardware distributors, manufacturers, and repair partners.

  • Stay current on product roadmaps, end-of-life announcements, supply constraints, and promotions, sharing relevant updates with the sales team.
  • Serve as an escalation point for quoting issues, pricing disputes, and pre-sales technical questions.
  • Identify and onboard additional vendors when there are gaps in available product offerings.

Margin, Pricing & Reporting
  • Apply approved markup guidelines while using sound judgment on competitive and strategic opportunities.
  • Track gross margin by quote, client, and vendor.
  • Provide periodic reporting on quote volume, win rate, hardware revenue, and margin performance.
  • Monitor market pricing for commonly sold equipment to maintain competitive pricing while protecting margin.
  • 2+ years of experience in technology sales, inside sales, sales support, vendor management, or distribution; experience in an MSP, VAR, or technology reseller environment is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of business IT hardware, including computers, servers, networking equipment, wireless solutions, and telephony hardware.
  • Experience with vendor portals, deal registration, and distributor quoting tools.
  • Ability to read technical specifications and accurately identify equipment by manufacturer, model, and part number.
  • Strong understanding of gross margin, markup, freight, and shipping considerations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to manage multiple quotes at various stages.
  • Clear written communication and strong client-service skills.

description:
ANSR is hiring for one of its clients.

ABOUT UNDER ARMOUR:

Our story is a classic American entrepreneurial journey, born from a simple, unmet need identified by an athlete. In 1996, founder Kevin Plank, then captain of the University of Maryland football team, set out to solve the problem of sweat-soaked cotton shirts by creating a moisture-wicking synthetic alternative. That innovation – HeatGear – redefined the athletic base layer and laid the foundation for what is today a global leader in performance apparel, footwear, and accessories.

Headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, Under Armour is driven by a clear mission – to make all athletes better. This relentless pursuit of better defines who we are, shaping our focus on performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.


OUR PURPOSE:

Building on this global foundation, Under Armour India is purpose-built to access India’s top-tier talent and embed the brand’s culture into scalable, tech-driven solutions. At its core, this is about empowering those who strive for more – a belief reflected in our values: Act Sustainably, Celebrate the Wins, Fight on Together, Love Athletes, and Stand for Equality.

These values serve as a shared framework that guides how we think, build, and collaborate. They connect teams across geographies, reinforce our purpose, and ensure that everything we do is aligned to a common goal – enabling better outcomes for athletes and the business.

At Under Armour India, this translates into an environment where individuals have the freedom to go further, regardless of role. Teams are empowered to develop and deliver state-of-the-art products and digital solutions that enhance performance and drive impact at scale.


VALUES & INNOVATION:

Across Under Armour globally, our values act as the thread that unites every teammate, shaping a culture grounded in purpose, accountability, and shared ambition. They are not just principles, but active drivers of how we operate, innovate, and grow together.

This culture is deeply anchored in innovation – a continuous pursuit of better that pushes boundaries and challenges convention. Whether through product innovation or digital transformation, teams are enabled to create solutions that elevate performance and redefine possibilities for athletes everywhere.


PURPOSE OF ROLE:

Under Armour is seeking a Lead Software Engineer, Full Stack to join the Personalization & Loyalty Squad, responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing digital experiences that drive customer engagement, loyalty, and personalization across global ecommerce platforms.

As a full stack engineer, the candidate will also contribute to backend services, APIs, GraphQL, integrations and data driven solutions. This role requires a strong engineering mindset, a passion for personalization experiences, and the ability to influence technical direction while mentoring team members. This position combines technical leadership, frontend expertise, and full stack development capabilities to help Under Armour deliver world-class personalization experiences that strengthen customer relationships and drive business growth.

title: Quality Program Manager – Global Hardware Supply Chain
description:
Oracle is seeking an experienced Quality Program Manager to lead the Global Stop Ship and Purge program across our hardware supply chain.

The Stop Ship and Purge program is Oracle’s global emergency-response system for managing critical hardware quality issues. When a potential quality concern is identified, this role leads the structured process for containing affected products, stopping movement through the supply chain, coordinating investigation and remediation, and safely restoring operations once the issue has been resolved.

This highly visible role provides end-to-end program leadership, from initial issue identification through containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, recovery, and closure. The Quality Program Manager will ensure every quality event follows a consistent framework, maintains complete traceability, meets audit requirements, and minimizes potential impact to Oracle’s customers, field operations, and OCI data centers.

The ideal candidate brings deep quality program-management experience within a manufacturing or complex hardware supply-chain environment. Success requires the ability to lead urgent, cross-functional programs involving external manufacturers, suppliers, product teams, engineering, field services, logistics, and data-center operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage Oracle’s Global Stop Ship and Purge program for hardware products and supply-chain quality events.
  • Lead the complete lifecycle of critical quality issues, including identification, containment, investigation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, recovery, and formal closure.
  • Establish clear decision gates for stopping, holding, purging, releasing, and restarting products within the supply chain.
  • Coordinate rapid-response and Tiger Team activities involving manufacturing, engineering, product, supplier quality, logistics, field services, and OCI data-center teams.
  • Ensure quality events are managed through consistent processes, tools, documentation, approvals, and escalation paths.
  • Maintain full traceability and audit-ready records demonstrating how quality issues and corrective actions were managed.
  • Lead Root Cause and Corrective Action training and promote consistent use of failure-analysis and corrective-action methodologies.
  • Partner with external manufacturers and suppliers to investigate quality concerns, identify root causes, implement containment measures, and track remediation through completion.
  • Engage with manufacturing, product-design teams, services, account teams, and customers to identify quality trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Define, track, analyze, and report quality metrics, case-rate data, emerging trends, corrective actions, and program health.
  • Present risks, decisions, recovery plans, and quality-performance insights to senior leadership.
  • Use Voice of the Customer and field-quality data to improve products, processes, controls, and customer outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen quality-management systems and improve the efficiency and consistency of global quality-response processes.
  • Manage assigned quality initiatives end to end, including requirements, schedules, dependencies, risks, milestones, executive reporting, and operational handoffs.
  • Establish operating rhythms that provide clear visibility into program status, decisions, ownership, escalations, and outstanding actions.
  • Support ongoing compliance with applicable quality standards, certification requirements, and internal controls.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong quality program-management experience within manufacturing, hardware, electronics, or another complex physical-product supply chain.
  • Demonstrated experience leading high-priority quality events from initial containment through investigation, corrective action, validation, and release.
  • Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, failure analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience collaborating with external manufacturers, suppliers, engineering, product, logistics, field-service, and customer-facing teams.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing and supply-chain control points, including how products or materials are stopped, contained, evaluated, released, and returned to production.
  • Experience creating and maintaining formal controls, process documentation, quality records, and audit traceability.
  • Ability to lead complex programs involving multiple organizations, competing priorities, incomplete information, and urgent timelines.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to identify trends, define meaningful quality metrics, and translate data into actions and recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex quality issues, risks, and decisions to technical teams and executive leaders.
  • Ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting server, networking, storage, semiconductor, data-center, or other complex hardware products.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001, TL 9000, or comparable quality-management standards.
  • Experience supporting product-compliance certifications or audits involving standards such as UL, CSA, TUV, CQC, or CCC.
  • Experience developing or delivering Root Cause and Corrective Action training.
  • Background in supplier quality, reliability engineering, manufacturing quality, or field-quality management.
  • Experience with supply-chain security, hardware authenticity, chain-of-custody controls, counterfeit-component prevention, or secure product lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with security and risk frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, DoD, or CMMC.
  • Experience conducting supplier risk or security assessments and tracking corrective actions and remediation plans.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will create a disciplined and repeatable approach to managing critical hardware quality events globally. They will ensure that Oracle responds quickly when issues arise, maintains complete visibility and traceability throughout the process, protects customers and field operations, and safely restores supply as efficiently as possible.

title: Principal Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - Mandarin Speaking
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Singapore

This role is based in Singapore and supports strategic customers and partners across Greater China and APJC. Professional fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required to lead technical and executive conversations in both languages for clients based in the two regions. Travel of up to 30% is expected, primarily within APJC, including mainland China.

About Developer GTM

Developer GTM organization is a startup within Cloudflare, driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most exciting place for developers to build.

About the Role

As Principal Solutions Architect for Developer Platform, you will own the regional technical strategy for Cloudflare’s most important Developer Platform customer and partner engagements.

You will work with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and move production workloads onto Cloudflare. You will operate across a portfolio of strategic engagements rather than focusing on a single account or project.

A central part of the role is turning field experience into broader impact. You will create reusable architectures and technical guidance, develop other architects, and provide product teams with clear evidence about regional customer needs.

This is a senior individual-contributor role combining hands-on architecture, executive influence, regional technical leadership, and mentorship. It reports to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for strategic Developer Platform customers and partners.
  • Translate business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.
  • Lead architecture discovery, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions.
  • Advise engineering executives and other senior stakeholders on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.
  • Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that can be reused across customers and the APJC field organization.
  • Remain hands-on by building, reviewing, and troubleshooting representative applications and integrations.
  • Serve as a regional Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, public speaking, written guidance, and internal enablement.
  • Mentor solutions architects and other technical colleagues working on complex customer engagements.
  • Partner with sales, product management, Developer Relations, and marketing on account strategy, product launches, customer evidence, and technical content.
  • Build effective feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to strategic customers, partners, and internal leaders.
  • Establish clear technical strategies and adoption plans for priority Developer Platform engagements.
  • Help customers validate and launch production workloads on Cloudflare.
  • Publish reference architectures and field guidance that are reused across accounts and teams.
  • Improve the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare developer and AI solutions.
  • Develop the technical leadership of architects and other colleagues through mentorship and enablement.
  • Provide product teams with consistent, evidence-based insight into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.
  • Be recognized as a leading Developer Platform architect across APJC.

What We’re Looking For

  • Substantial experience in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. Successful candidates will typically bring 15 or more years of relevant experience, although demonstrated scope and impact matter more than a specific number of years.
  • Professional fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese, with the ability to lead technical and executive discussions in both languages.
  • Experience owning complex technical strategies involving developers, platform or infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed application architecture, including compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability.
  • Hands-on software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept.
  • Experience with modern web technologies and at least one widely used programming ecosystem, preferably JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of serverless or cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.
  • A record of influencing without direct authority, mentoring technical colleagues, and turning individual solutions into reusable organizational capabilities.
  • Excellent written, presentation, facilitation, and technical-communication skills across developer, architectural, and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including mainland China.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare’s Developer Platform.
  • Experience designing AI inference, agentic, retrieval-augmented generation, or data-intensive applications.
  • Experience working with customers, technology partners, or developer communities in Greater China.
  • A record of public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or developer-community leadership.
  • Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
  • A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.
