title: Security Operations Manager
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Security Operations Manager to lead detection, response, and security monitoring for a self-clearing broker-dealer. You’ll build and lead the team and the 24x7 program that keeps our platform — and our advisors’ clients — safe.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the security operations / detection & response team, setting priorities and career paths.
  • Own our 24x7 security monitoring strategy across our managed detection & response provider
  • Run the incident response program end to end — from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Define and report on SecOps metrics and SLAs (MTTD/MTTR, alert quality, coverage) to security and executive leadership.
  • Mature our detection engineering, threat-intelligence ingestion, and response automation (SOAR) capabilities.
  • Drive regular tabletop and purple-team exercises and partner with Cloud, IT, and Engineering to close gaps surfaced by monitoring.
  • Own the day-to-day operation and roadmap of the security operations tooling stack.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience - 6+ years in security operations, including 2+ years leading or managing a SOC or detection & response team:
  • Hands-on incident response and investigations in a cloud-first environment
  • Depth with SIEM (Datadog/Splunk), EDR/MDR (CrowdStrike/SentinelOne), and cloud telemetry (AWS)
  • Experience managing an MDR/MSSP and/or IR retainer relationship
  • Strong ability to lead through influence and operate with urgency
  • Education - A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
  • Technical aptitude - You’re technologically savvy and comfortable across modern cloud and detection stacks (i.e., AWS, Kubernetes, SIEM query languages, detection-as-code, Terraform, etc.)
  • Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
  • Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
  • Resilience - We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
  • Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
  • Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

  • Experience working in regulated environments (SEC/FINRA, fintech, or financial services)
  • Experience building or standing up a 24x7 SOC or transitioning to managed detection & response
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA)
Los Angeles, CA salary range
$181,000—$265,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

  • Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
  • 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
  • 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
  • Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
  • Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
  • One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Provide advocacy, information, and referral services to participants staying in emergency shelters. Actively participate in shelter processes and work as part of a team to provide services to participants.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Supervise shelter activities to ensure the safety of participants.

  9. Maintain confidentiality of participants, staff, and agency.
  10. Coordinate with agency staff to ensure consistent delivery of services.
  11. Attend agency and program staff meetings.
  12. Supervise participant chore assignments.
  13. Perform urinalysis and breathalyzer testing on participants when requested.
  14. Rotate through assigned Post Positions if applicable.
  15. May be required to work at a temporarily reassigned location during a shift to provide coverage based on staffing needs. Transportation will be provided or reimbursed, as necessary.
  16. Other duties as assigned.

PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS

Each Transition Projects employee must:

  1. Acquire First Aid/CPR/AED certification within 30 days of hire and be retested biannually thereafter throughout employment.
  2. Complete Bloodborne Pathogens and Narcan Training within 30 days of hire and be retested annually thereafter throughout employment.
  3. Demonstrate reliability by being present for work as scheduled, arriving and leaving on time and taking breaks in expected time frames.
  4. Interact effectively with individuals of different backgrounds, beliefs, and perspectives, treating each person with respect and dignity.
  5. Attend agency and program staff meetings.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee, with or without accommodation, to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  1. Hearing and vision adequate for interaction with participants, interaction with staff and interaction with the general public.
  2. Hearing adequate for telephone work. Vision adequate for close work.
  3. Hand and finger dexterity adequate to operate standard office equipment.
  4. Ability to walk, bend, stand, sit, reach, stoop, pull, squat, kneel, climb stairs and ladders
  5. Sitting at a desk completing paperwork and working on a computer for lengthy periods.
  6. Ability to perform CPR and other emergency life-saving care with the assistance of teammates until emergency responders arrive.
  7. Ability to lift 50 pounds.

WORKING CONDITIONS / SAFETY CONSIDERATIONS

  1. Work environments may include exposure to animals/pets across various program sites.
  2. This position may have exposure to bloodborne pathogens or other infectious materials during the course of duties. Bloodborne pathogens training, safety protocols, and appropriate protective equipment are provided. The Hepatitis B vaccination is offered at no cost.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

The right individual for this position has a passion for helping others and a desire to work in an organization that serves people who are experiencing poverty and homelessness.

  1. 2 years of consistent work experience (in any field), equivalent educational qualifications may be considered in place of work experience.
  2. Demonstrated understanding of the issues surrounding homelessness, chemical dependency, domestic violence and sexual assault.
  3. Demonstrated ability to work independently. Ability to appropriately assess a situation and take corrective action as necessary.
  4. Knowledge of services available to low-income and homeless persons in Multnomah County through Transition Projects and other agencies or the demonstrated ability to obtain such knowledge.
  5. Demonstrated ability to provide crisis intervention and to follow procedure in crisis situations.
  6. Written and verbal communication skills. Good computer skills. Ability to use web-based data collection program.
  7. Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

title: Media Processing Operator
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Ingest. Receive and register incoming source media, artwork, timed text, and metadata. Verify file integrity, confirm the delivery matches the work order, and get assets into the right place with the right names.
  • Pre-Qualification. Audit client-supplied source assets against platform specifications before they enter the pipeline. Complete the pre-qual checklist for each asset, document findings, and flag deficiencies back to operations early enough to act on them.
  • Encoding and Transcoding. Execute and monitor encoding and transcode jobs, troubleshoot failures, and confirm every output meets the required video format, audio format, codec, and container spec before it moves downstream.
  • QC. Perform spot check and full linear pass QC on video, audio, and timed text. Write clear, timecoded QC reports and track issues through to resolution.
  • Compliance and S&P. Review content against broadcast, platform, and client Standards and Practices requirements. Notate material requiring modification and support the creation of compliant alternate versions.
  • Conformance. Conform captions, subtitles, and artwork to approved masters and platform specification, holding frame-accurate sync throughout.
  • Post and Editorial. Create mezzanines and alternate versions to spec. Perform picture and audio edits, fixes, and re-renders as required by QC or compliance findings.
  • Metadata. Build, validate, and correct title metadata against platform schemas. Catch the errors that cause a package to bounce before it ships.
  • Artwork. Prepare and validate key art, poster, backdrop, and chapter imagery to platform specification.
  • Packaging and Delivery. Assemble delivery packages in Telestream Switch, Apple Compressor, and comparable tools. Validate before submission, then deliver through the appropriate portal, aggregator, or accelerated transfer system and confirm acceptance.
  • Archive. Close out completed titles to archival storage with accurate records, so any version can be identified, retrieved, and redelivered on request.
  • Records and Coordination. Maintain accurate file naming, version control, asset tracking, and delivery records across every title. Work with internal teams and clients to keep orders moving and deadlines met.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Three or more years supporting end to end media workflows across ingest, transcoding, QC, packaging, and delivery, in both on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Deep understanding of professional video and audio standards, including:
    • Resolutions and formats: 1080i, 1080p, UHD, 4K, Dolby Vision, HDR10
    • Color science: color space, Rec.709, HLG, PQ
    • Timecode and frame rates
    • Codecs and compression
    • Audio: PCM, 5.1 surround, Dolby Atmos
    • Containers: MXF, transport stream, and common OTT wrappers
  • Working knowledge of color space conversion and HDR to SDR interoperability, and the ability to diagnose problems in an HDR pipeline.

  • Experience with high-performance file transfer and delivery systems such as IBM Aspera and Signiant Media Shuttle.

  • Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Apple Compressor, Adobe Media Encoder, and Telestream Switch.
  • Familiarity with caption and subtitle standards, including .scc and .itt, and with OTT, FAST, AVOD, and transactional delivery specifications.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced operational environment, working independently and exercising sound operational judgment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written communication skills. QC notes, pre-qual reports, and change logs are read by clients and platforms, so they need to be precise.
  • Genuine attention to detail and the discipline to follow a checklist the same way every time.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Direct experience with iTunes and Apple TV package creation and delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration and automated QC platforms such as Telestream Vantage or Interra Baton.
  • Experience with metadata formats including XML, JSON, CSV, XLS, and HTML/CSS.
  • Scripting and automation experience with Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
  • Familiarity with Smartsheet or a comparable work order and ticketing system.
  • Exposure to cloud storage and archival workflows, including S3 and Glacier.
  • Strong documentation discipline and the ability to produce and maintain clear technical documentation.

title: Lead-Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About this role


This is an ownership role.


You will inherit a working but evolving production system built by someone else. There is a real list of things that need fixing. Your first job is to understand it deeply, make it stable, and make it something a small team can safely change.


After that, you will extend it — one module at a time, sequenced against business priorities, alongside one other engineer.


We want to be direct about what this is: it is a rescue-and-build role at a company with real revenue and real clients, where you will be the most senior technical person and your decisions will stand. If you have been waiting for a role where you own the whole system rather than a slice of it, this is that role.


What you will do


First 60 days — take custody


  • Run the technical handover from our development partner
  • Read and map the entire codebase; produce the architecture documentation
  • Audit security, infrastructure, backup and restore, and access control
  • Produce a prioritised risk and remediation plan and walk the founders through it


Months 3–4 — make it solid


  • Fix the defect backlog, working directly with our agents who use the platform daily
  • Build automated test coverage on the paths that cost money when they break: booking, ticketing, cancellation, refund, amendment
  • Harden supplier integrations — timeouts, retries, idempotency, reconciliation when our records and a supplier's disagree
  • Improve search and booking performance
  • Set up proper CI/CD, staging, monitoring and alerting


Ongoing — own it


  • Lead technical design and make the architecture calls
  • Write code. This role is roughly 60% hands-on and stays that way.
  • Review all code that ships, including your own team's
  • Interview and onboard our second engineer, then mentor them
  • Own production: uptime, incidents, escalation
  • Work directly with the founders who know the travel domain deeply and act as product owners to turn business requirements into technical plans
  • Advise on what we should build versus buy


Our stack


  • Frontend: Next.js / React, deployed on Vercel
  • Backend & data: AWS
  • AI: OpenAI APIs, with more AI features on the roadmap
  • Source control & CI: GitHub



What we are looking for

Must have


  • 8+ years building and shipping production software, full-stack
  • Strong Next.js / React and TypeScript, and strong backend, you'll work across both daily
  • Hands-on AWS depth: compute, RDS or equivalent, networking, IAM, secrets management, cost control
  • Practical Vercel experience, including its constraints
  • GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD
  • Strong SQL and data modelling, including performance tuning on real workloads
  • Demonstrated experience taking over a codebase built by someone else and improving it incrementally, this matters more to us than greenfield experience
  • Production ownership: you have been the person responsible when a live system broke
  • Solid cloud infrastructure competence
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs
  • Fluent with AI-assisted development — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or equivalent and with clear judgement about where it helps and where it should not be trusted. You use it to move faster on comprehension, test generation and documentation, and you never ship code you cannot explain line by line.
  • Experience building with LLM APIs in production (we use OpenAI) — structured output extraction, function/tool calling, prompt design, and evaluating non-deterministic systems rather than shipping on impressions


Strongly Preferred


  • Travel technology: GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), NDC, hotel aggregators (TBO, Hotelbeds, Rezlive), airline ticketing, PNR workflows
  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) — building or operating MCP servers to expose internal systems and data to AI agents and coding tools
  • RAG architectures and vector search — retrieval over fare rules, supplier content and client travel policies
  • Speech pipelines (STT/TTS) for voice agents, or WhatsApp Business API — both are on our roadmap
  • Payment systems, settlement or reconciliation experience
  • Multi-tenant B2B SaaS
  • Prior first-engineer or early-stage experience at a startup
  • Experience mentoring engineers

title: Data Acquisition Engineer - Python
description:
About the job


Data Acquisition EngineerWe're looking for a Data Acquisition Engineer who can own how external data flows from the internet into our product: collecting it, structuring it, and automating the pipelines behind it.


Company

Eighty Days is building a new way to discover the world centred on taste, trust, and personal context. Today, travel discovery is fragmented across social media, search, and private conversations. We are creating a product that brings this together into a structured, map-based experience where recommendations are attributed, meaningful, and built over time.Our focus is not just on helping people plan trips, but on becoming the place where they continuously save, organise, and revisit places that matter.Website: https://eightydays.ai/


What you'll do

  • Identify and evaluate data sources (websites, public APIs, and app endpoints) and decide what's worth collecting.
  • Build Python data extraction services that reliably pull structured data from static HTML, JSON endpoints, and JavaScript-rendered pages.
  • Keep collection running smoothly as sources change, throttle requests, or restrict access, using proxies, sessions, retries, and backoff.
  • Normalize messy, inconsistent output into a single clean schema: addresses, timings, categories, coordinates, prices.
  • Deduplicate places across sources where the same venue appears under different names and coordinates.
  • Automate the pipeline end to end with scheduled, repeatable runs and no manual steps.
  • Validate data before it reaches production, and build the monitoring that catches problems before users do.


What we're looking for

  • 2-4 years building data extraction services and pipelines that ran in production.
  • Strong Python, including asyncio and concurrency control.
  • Experience with Playwright, Selenium, or similar tools for JavaScript-heavy pages, alongside plain HTTP-based data collection.
  • Practical experience working within rate limits and access controls: proxies, headers, backoff.
  • MongoDB or strong SQL: aggregation, indexing, bulk writes.
  • Comfortable with Docker, Linux, Git, and AWS (S3, SQS, EC2).
  • Ability to take a source from exploration, to a working collector, to structured data, to an automated production pipeline.
  • Genuine attention to data quality: you verify output before you trust it.


Bonus points

  • Experience building data pipelines for consumer or location-based products.
  • Familiarity with geospatial data and place matching across sources.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, or similar).
  • Great to have worked in a fast paced product-based startup.

We are seeking Entry Level Water Engineers to join our team in Tampa, Orlando, Plantation, or Coral Gables Florida! The focus of this role will be on water/wastewater projects which will provide the Entry Level Engineer with the opportunity to work on a variety of projects related to water supply, treatment, distribution, and wastewater collection and treatment systems.

We work to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations. Around the world, we’re feeling the effects climate change, rapid urbanization, loss of biodiversity. The rate at which we’re seeing large-scale, unforeseen events such as floods and wildfires, is becoming more frequent. We are here to protect our natural environment and water resources, while powering our world for future generations.

Role accountabilities:

As an Entry Level Water Engineer your role will involve a wide range of responsibilities related to the evaluation, planning, design, and support management of projects for water/wastewater treatment and conveyance. This includes pipelines, treatment facilities, and pumping facilities. Your expertise will be crucial in exercising judgment on the intricate details of work and making preliminary selections and adaptations of engineering alternatives. Additionally, you will actively engage in fieldwork activities such as conducting site visits, performing construction inspections, collecting samples, analyzing water quality, conducting asset inventory, setting up and monitoring flow monitoring systems, evaluations technologies, and gathering information on plant operations. You will also play a vital role in supporting professional engineering services during the construction phase which includes activities such as construction observation, reviewing shop drawings, responding to request information (RFI’s), and ensuring permit closeouts. Your contributions will be essential in ensuring the successful execution of water resources projects and maintaining high-quality standards throughout the entire process.

In addition to the responsibilities listed above, you will also be responsible for:

  • Coordination with manufacturer’s representatives and contractors.
  • Support Asset Management projects performing data analytics, operational and organizational assessments, condition assessments and overall performance. evaluations of water/wastewater/stormwater facilities.
  • Preparation of reports, presentations, cost estimates, and participation in client meetings.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of water and wastewater treatment processes.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, GIS, and other engineering software.
  • EIT certification.

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Full Stack - Node & React [T500-27989]
description:
About REA Group:

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way people experience property?”

Thirty years later, REA Group is a global digital real estate leader operating across multiple continents, building large-scale, consumer-facing platforms used by millions every day.

Our success comes from staying true to a day-one mindset—combining innovation, curiosity, and long-term thinking to evolve complex systems that power critical customer journeys.


REA Cyber City is an extension of REA Group’s global technology organization. Teams here work closely with counterparts in Australia and other regions to design, build, and operate core platforms and capabilities. Engineers in Cyber City contribute directly to REA’s long-term technology strategy, solving real-world problems at scale and shaping systems that need to perform, adapt, and endure over time.

If you’re excited by the challenge of building resilient systems, working on meaningful problems, and growing with a global engineering organization—read on.


What the role is all about:

We’re seeking a Senior Lead / Staff Engineer who operates as a squad architect and systems thinker, owning complex technical problems end-to-end and shaping the evolution of REA’s platforms at scale.


This role is designed for a senior individual contributor who leads primarily through technical depth, architectural judgement, and operational ownership. The focus is on designing, building, evolving, and operating reliable systems over time—while influencing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and enabling predictable delivery across squads.

You will work closely with engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and stakeholders to solve domain-wide problems and ensure systems remain scalable, secure, and maintainable as REA continues to grow.


Core Behavioral Signals:

  • Shapes architecture and ensures long-term technical direction aligned with platform and domain goals.
  • Drives system health, stability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Solves domain-wide and cross-team technical problems.
  • Enforces quality, standards, and strong engineering practices.
  • Resolves complex dependencies across squads and systems.
  • Influences technical strategy and represents engineering in decision forums.


What you’ll do:

Technical Execution:

  • Design, build, review, and operate production-grade full-stack systems using modern engineering practices.
  • Own delivery of complex, high-impact features and subsystems, leading by example in code quality, correctness, and performance.
  • Work hands-on across frontend and backend codebases using technologies such as React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js.
  • Drive high engineering standards through pairing, deep code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


Design & Architecture:

  • Own architecture decisions for complex systems, documenting and communicating trade-offs through design reviews and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Shape subsystem and platform-level architecture aligned with REA’s long-term technical strategy.
  • Evaluate and articulate trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
  • Design and evolve APIs, services, and data flows that scale across teams and domains.
  • Design or contribute to event-driven and asynchronous architectures; experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka) is a plus.


System Ownership & Operational Excellence:

  • Own production systems end-to-end, including reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and technical debt management.
  • Own application performance across the stack by identifying bottlenecks, driving optimizations, and ensuring systems meet latency and scalability targets.
  • Design and operate containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Ensure systems are observable, resilient, and designed for safe failure and recovery.
  • Champion continuous improvement in operational practices and developer experience.


Delivery Leadership:

  • Contribute to planning and sequencing of work, helping teams balance scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies and technical risks early, unblocking teams through sound technical decisions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers and delivery leads to improve predictability without compromising quality.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship:

  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on guidance.
  • Raise the technical bar across squads by reinforcing strong engineering practices and architectural consistency.
  • Influence without formal authority, earning trust through technical credibility and clarity of thinking.


What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience operating as a senior contributor on complex, production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern full-stack technologies, including React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js.
  • Experience designing and operating systems on AWS and/or GCP, including cloud-native services.
  • Strong experience with SQL databases and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles, including trunk-based development, automated testing, progressive delivery, and rollback strategies.
  • Experience designing and operating containerized systems using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ownership of system design, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and technical direction to diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong mentoring mindset with the ability to elevate others without direct people management responsibility.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and pragmatic trade-offs are required.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka), or large-scale asynchronous systems.
  • Exposure to platform engineering or shared services models.
  • Experience evolving legacy systems while delivering new capabilities.


Why join REA Cyber City:

  • Work on globally impactful products used by millions.
  • Be part of a growing global engineering organization with strong technical standards.
  • Influence systems, teams, and culture from an early stage.
  • Collaborate closely with global leaders and technologists.
  • Grow as a people leader, delivery owner, and technology leader.


The values we live by:

Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

title: ASIC SoC Verification Engineer
description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity:

Join our ASIC Top-Level Verification team and take on some of the most challenging verification tasks in the industry. You'll ensure that our ASICs meet our high standards for performance, functionality, and security while playing a critical role in developing environments and tests across multiple platforms.

We specialize in the top-level verification of cutting-edge ASICs that power complex high-performance systems. Our designs range from monolithic ASICs to integrated multi-chip modules containing hundreds of processor cores, DSPs, ARM cores, tailored hardware accelerator IPs, and high-speed interfaces including Ethernet, CPRI, and PCIe.

What you will do:

  • Develop SoC-level test cases with opportunities to specialize in areas such as:
  • External interface traffic patterns
  • ASIC internal functionality (DSPs, MCUs, CPU cores, ARM infrastructure)
  • Switches, security, SerDes, DDR, Coresight, and external memory systems
  • Define and document verification strategies for assigned ASIC components
  • Develop and execute tests in SystemC/TLM simulation, RTL environments, and hardware emulation
  • Participate in silicon-level verification activities
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure comprehensive coverage and quality

The skills you bring:

  • Proven background in IP, SubSystem, or SoC-level verification
  • Strong understanding of SoC verification methodologies and best practices
  • Experience with SystemC/TLM simulation and RTL verification environments
  • Familiarity with hardware emulation platforms
  • Knowledge of high-speed interfaces and complex system architectures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and documentation abilities

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with DSP, CPU, or ARM verification
  • Knowledge of security verification techniques
  • Exposure to SerDes, DDR, or Coresight verification
  • Hardware emulation or silicon-level verification experience
  • Familiarity with industry-standard verification languages and methodologies

Success Looks Like:

  • Demonstrable growth in verification expertise and scope of responsibility
  • Delivering comprehensive test coverage and catching critical design issues
  • Contributing value to the overall team through effective collaboration
  • Advancing technical capabilities within the verification organization

title: Lead Engineer - Full Stack [T500-28054]
description:
About REA Group:

In 1995, in a garage in Melbourne, Australia, REA Group was born from a simple question: “Can we change the way people experience property?”

Thirty years later, REA Group is a global digital real estate leader operating across multiple continents, building large-scale, consumer-facing platforms used by millions every day.

Our success comes from staying true to a day-one mindset—combining innovation, curiosity, and long-term thinking to evolve complex systems that power critical customer journeys.


REA Cyber City is an extension of REA Group’s global technology organization. Teams here work closely with counterparts in Australia and other regions to design, build, and operate core platforms and capabilities. Engineers in Cyber City contribute directly to REA’s long-term technology strategy, solving real-world problems at scale and shaping systems that need to perform, adapt, and endure over time.

If you’re excited by the challenge of building resilient systems, working on meaningful problems, and growing with a global engineering organization—read on.


Senior Lead Engineer – Full Stack

What the role is all about:

We’re seeking a Senior Lead / Staff Engineer who operates as a squad architect and systems thinker, owning complex technical problems end-to-end and shaping the evolution of REA’s platforms at scale.

This role is designed for a senior individual contributor who leads primarily through technical depth, architectural judgement, and operational ownership. The focus is on designing, building, evolving, and operating reliable systems over time—while influencing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and enabling predictable delivery across squads.

You will work closely with engineers, Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and stakeholders to solve domain-wide problems and ensure systems remain scalable, secure, and maintainable as REA continues to grow.


Core Behavioral Signals:

  • Shapes architecture and ensures long-term technical direction aligned with platform and domain goals.
  • Drives system health, stability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Solves domain-wide and cross-team technical problems.
  • Enforces quality, standards, and strong engineering practices.
  • Resolves complex dependencies across squads and systems.
  • Influences technical strategy and represents engineering in decision forums.


What you’ll do:

Technical Execution:

  • Design, build, review, and operate production-grade full-stack systems using modern engineering practices.
  • Own delivery of complex, high-impact features and subsystems, leading by example in code quality, correctness, and performance.
  • Work hands-on across frontend and backend codebases using technologies such as React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and Java.
  • Drive high engineering standards through pairing, deep code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


Design & Architecture:

  • Own architecture decisions for complex systems, documenting and communicating trade-offs through design reviews and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Shape subsystem and platform-level architecture aligned with REA’s long-term technical strategy.
  • Evaluate and articulate trade-offs across performance, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability.
  • Design and evolve APIs, services, and data flows that scale across teams and domains.
  • Design or contribute to event-driven and asynchronous architectures; experience with streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka) is a plus.


System Ownership & Operational Excellence:

  • Own production systems end-to-end, including reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and technical debt management.
  • Own application performance across the stack by identifying bottlenecks, driving optimizations, and ensuring systems meet latency and scalability targets.
  • Design and operate containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments.
  • Ensure systems are observable, resilient, and designed for safe failure and recovery.
  • Champion continuous improvement in operational practices and developer experience.


Delivery Leadership:

  • Contribute to planning and sequencing of work, helping teams balance scope, quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Identify cross-team dependencies and technical risks early, unblocking teams through sound technical decisions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers and delivery leads to improve predictability without compromising quality.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship:

  • Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on guidance.
  • Raise the technical bar across squads by reinforcing strong engineering practices and architectural consistency.
  • Influence without formal authority, earning trust through technical credibility and clarity of thinking.


What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience operating as a senior contributor on complex, production systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with modern full-stack technologies, including React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, and Java.
  • Experience designing and operating systems on AWS and/or GCP, including cloud-native services.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD principles, including trunk-based development, automated testing, progressive delivery, and rollback strategies.
  • Experience designing and operating containerized systems using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated ownership of system design, performance, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Ability to clearly communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, and technical direction to diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong mentoring mindset with the ability to elevate others without direct people management responsibility.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and pragmatic trade-offs are required.


Nice to have:

  • Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming platforms (e.g. Kafka), or large-scale asynchronous systems.
  • Exposure to platform engineering or shared services models.
  • Experience evolving legacy systems while delivering new capabilities.


Why join REA Cyber City:

  • Work on globally impactful products used by millions.
  • Be part of a growing global engineering organization with strong technical standards.
  • Influence systems, teams, and culture from an early stage.
  • Collaborate closely with global leaders and technologists.
  • Grow as a people leader, delivery owner, and technology leader.


The values we live by:

Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full Stack Developer


Gurgaon

· Full-time

· Level: Open, we hire the right person first, then decide the level


About Enrich Labs


We're a venture studio, and we build the products that sales, marketing, and GTM teams run their outreach and operations on. Everything we ship is our own. Three products are live and growing: InboxKit for email infrastructure, Enrich.so for lead data, and our sending platform for running campaigns at volume. More than thousands of customers across the globe use them to find the right people, reach them, and keep the whole machine running.


It looks simple on the outside, but it's a hard problem underneath. The infrastructure has to be right the first time, at scale, against systems we don't control, and a single mistake can take weeks to undo. Agencies and outbound teams trust us with infrastructure their business depends on.


The Role


You'll own features from start to finish, both the backend and the frontend. We're a small team, so if you build something, you're also the one who fixes it when it breaks.


You'll also have a real say in what gets built. Not just picking up tickets, but helping plan what we ship next across the studio, testing it properly before it goes out, pushing it to production for 10,000+ customers, and then staying with it long enough to know whether they actually got value from it. A feature that ships and nobody uses is a feature that failed.


We're open on experience level. Someone junior who thinks clearly is more valuable to us than someone senior who's coasting.


What You'll Work On


  • New features across our products, from a rough idea to something live in front of 10,000+ customers, including the judgement call about whether it's worth building at all.

  • Automation that runs at scale, the systems that do in seconds what would otherwise take a customer days of manual setup.

  • Monitoring and reliability, catching problems before a customer notices, and sending alerts that are actually useful rather than noise.

  • The interfaces customers live in, dashboards and flows that make something genuinely complicated feel obvious.

  • Our public API and integrations, the webhooks and 24+ tool connections customers build their workflows on.


What We're Looking For


  • You understand how the internet actually works. This is the most important part of the job. You know how DNS, HTTP, proxies, and TLS work, and you understand why things load slowly. You can look at a network trace and figure out what happened, and you've fixed problems that needed this kind of knowledge, not just worked at a level above it.


  • You're curious about how things break. You think about how a feature could be misused while you're still building it. Maybe you've done CTFs, bug bounties, or authorised security testing, or you just enjoy reading about how things went wrong elsewhere. If you've ever found a bug in someone else's product, you reported it the right way. That matters to us as much as the curiosity itself.


  • You can build a full feature, start to finish. You've taken something from a blank file to a live product, and kept it running afterward. You're equally comfortable with backend and frontend work, and you don't need someone else to hand things off to you.


  • You ask why before how. You talk about your work in terms of what it did for users, not just tasks you finished. You've said no to building something before, and you know how to cut scope to ship on time.


  • You have good taste. You can look at a screen and say exactly what's wrong with it. You think about the boring parts too, the loading, the empty states, the errors, the slow connections, because that's where real products are tested.


  • You build things on your own, just because you're curious. This isn't about how much free time you have. Plenty of great engineers have full lives outside work. We just want to see that curiosity somewhere.


Good to Have


  • MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), a good part of our product surface is built on it.

  • Next.js or similar modern frontend tools, actually built with them, not just read about them.

  • Better Auth, or real work with logins, sessions, and tokens.

  • Golang, helpful for our backend, and easy to learn if you think clearly.

  • Browser automation like Playwright or Puppeteer, useful for a lot of our setup work.

title: Senior Detection and Response Engineer
description:
About Altruist

Altruist is transforming the multi-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients.

We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you!

But first, our values

Kindness - Kindness doesn’t just equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully.

Brilliance - Humility is the skill we’re most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one.

Grit - When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it’s hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles.

About the position

Altruist is in the midst of an exciting phase and we’re excited to hire a Senior Detection and Response Engineer to join our growing Security team. You’ll build the detections and response capability that find and stop threats across our cloud, endpoints, and identity providers.

This role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week onsite in our San Francisco FiDi or Culver City office.

Your impact

  • Build, tune, and maintain high-fidelity detections as code across SIEM, cloud, endpoint , and identity telemetry.
  • Triage and investigate alerts, lead response on security incidents, and proactively threat-hunt for “low and slow” and insider activity.
  • Operationalize threat intelligence and IOC ingestion into detections and edge/WAF rules.
  • Develop response playbooks and automation (SOAR) to reduce toil and speed containment.
  • Partner with our MDR and IR partners and run purple-team exercises with our red team security engineers.
  • Continuously improve logging coverage and detection efficacy, measured against MITRE ATT&CK.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience - 4+ years of experience in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting:
    • Hands-on authoring of detections in a modern SIEM
    • Investigations across cloud (AWS), endpoint, and identity data sources
    • Comfort scripting and automating (e.g., Python)
    • Strong ability to work independently
  • Education - A B.A. / B.S. degree in relevant fields such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering or Information Security or relevant experience
  • Technical aptitude - You’re technologically savvy and can easily get up to speed on modern tech stacks (i.e., AWS, Kubernetes, Datadog/Splunk, SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Terraform, etc.)
  • Ownership - The pride you put into every aspect of your work is unparalleled and undeniable
  • Superb communication - Intentional dialogue is a superpower. You listen as well as you share your perspective with others.
  • Resilience - We’re inspired by your unwavering determination to achieve success, no matter the adversity you face along the way.
  • Assurance - Your confidence is brilliant, yet ego-less. You possess a strong knowledge base, the ability to discover the unknown, and are open to differing perspectives.
  • Creative problem solving - Identifying the problem is simply not enough. You’re instinctually creative with your approach in finding solutions to roadblocks.

Bonus points if you bring

  • Experience working in regulated environments (fintech / financial services)
  • Cyber threat intelligence or insider-threat detection experience
San Francisco, CA salary range
$200,000—$240,000 USD

What we bring

Attracting and retaining top-tier talent is a priority. We are proud of the culture we’ve built and are cognizant of the ever-changing professional landscape. Our dynamic offering of perks and benefits are tailored for you to feel your best while doing your best.

  • Stunning, amenity-filled office spaces in Culver City, CA, San Francisco, CA, and Dallas, TX. Our offices are intentionally designed for comfort, collaboration, and productivity.
  • Competitive total compensation.
  • Premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance plans (HMO and PPO).
  • 401k savings plan with a 4% match and immediate vesting.
  • 16 week paid parental leave after one year of employment.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities including an employee mobility program and an annual L&D budget allocation for each employee.
  • Company perks program (includes discounts on pet insurance, fitness, cell phone plans, and travel, etc.).
  • Financial guidance program (includes counseling on navigating debt, tracking personal spend, saving and planning goals, home-purchasing preparedness, etc.).
  • One month work from anywhere policy (with the exception of a few countries).

Total compensation includes a competitive benefits package, along with a bonus program for eligible roles. For salaried positions, a salary offer will be determined by a number of factors including experience, skill level, internal pay equity, geographic location, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs regularly to ensure fair, equitable, and competitive pay. At Altruist, we are committed to providing fair, equitable, and competitive compensation by leveraging market data to inform our pay bands. Base salaries will be reviewed at regular intervals throughout the year, typically in conjunction with performance review cycles. By evaluating compensation on a regular basis, we are able to reward high performance and ensure all employees have opportunities for growth.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Altruist we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

description:

Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance

About the role:

Boston Scientific was recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2026, ranking No. 15 on the Top 100 list, reflecting the culture our employees experience every day.

Interested in hearing from an Electrophysiology Mapping Specialist at Boston Scientific? Check out our video featuring Gianna to learn more about the role.

Now is an exciting time to join our Cardiology team as we launch groundbreaking solutions in the electrophysiology (EP) market — one of the fastest-growing areas in med tech. Boston Scientific offers a comprehensive portfolio to treat atrial fibrillation (AFib), including cryoablation, radiofrequency ablation and FARAPULSE™ Pulsed Field Ablation therapy.

Our technologies include 3D mapping and navigation systems, radiofrequency ablation catheters, diagnostic catheters, EP recording systems and intracardiac access sheaths designed to help diagnose and treat heart rhythm disorders.

In this field-based role, the Electrophysiology Mapping Specialist will begin with an intensive training and development program to gain in-depth knowledge of our technologies and prepare for success. Upon completion, the specialist will provide expert clinical, technical and educational support to physicians, EP lab staff and sales representatives during cardiac procedures using the Opal HDx™ Mapping System within a defined territory, contributing directly to patient care and business objectives.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Maintain advanced clinical knowledge of EP diagnostic and ablation technologies, pulsed field ablation, mapping and recording systems, transseptal access tools and left atrial appendage occlusion technologies.
  • Attend procedures in cardiac CV/EP labs to provide clinical support for Boston Scientific AF Solutions products, including the Opal HDx™ Mapping System, FARAPULSE™, transseptal access tools, diagnostic and therapeutic catheters, and WATCHMAN FLX™ devices.
  • Educate customers on the clinical use and benefits of AF Solutions products through customized presentations, demonstrations and ongoing training.
  • Meet with physicians and clinical stakeholders to assess their needs and demonstrate how Boston Scientific products support optimal patient outcomes.
  • Develop relationships with hospital staff, physicians and administrators to expand influence across departments and facilitate strategic decision-making.
  • Respond to clinical and technical inquiries by collaborating across functions, including sales, clinical research, marketing and technical support.
  • Demonstrate change leadership and collaborate cross-functionally to align local activities with broader strategic goals.
  • Implement strategies outlined in quarterly action plans and coordinate efforts with sales teams to advance business objectives.
  • Support physician education and market development by engaging referring physicians, fellows and key opinion leaders.
  • Train on and adhere to clinical trial protocols and compliance standards in accordance with global regulatory expectations.
  • Manage clinical trial activity within the territory, including interest visits and site initiation visits, and educate investigators on study procedures and products.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education and experience.
  • Minimum of 4 years' experience with 3D cardiac mapping systems, or minimum of 8 years' experience in medical device sales, clinical electrophysiology or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and ability to discuss and explain complex technical product information.

Preferred qualifications:

  • NASPE/IBHRE CEPS certification.
  • Degree in biomedical or mechanical engineering.
  • Experience with atrial fibrillation, cardiac mapping or structural heart procedures.
  • Current experience using a 3D cardiac mapping system.
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in business or health care.

Requisition ID: 634397

The anticipated annualized base amount or range for this full time position will be $70,000 to $115,000, plus variable compensation governed by the Sales Incentive Compensation Plan (which includes certain annual non-discretionary incentives based on predetermined objectives) as well as the value of core and optional benefits offered at BSC, which can be reviewed at www.bscbenefitsconnect.com. Actual compensation will be commensurate with demonstrable level of experience and training, pertinent education including licensure and certifications, and other relevant business or organizational needs.

Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. title: Senior EDI Java Full Stack Developer(10+ Years) - REMOTE
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior EDI Java Full Stack Developer to help build and scale our EDI and supply-chain visibility platform. You’ll work across the full stack — from high-throughput, stateful stream-processing services that correlate millions of EDI documents a day, to the web UI our customers use to track their orders, shipments, and invoices in real time. This is a hands-on senior role: you’ll own the design of complex features, dig into production issues at scale, and mentor other engineers, while staying close to the code.

The platform processes standard EDI transactions (X12 and EDIFACT) for large retailers, manufacturers, and logistics providers — think purchase orders, invoices, advance ship notices, and functional acknowledgments flowing through translation, correlation, and lifecycle tracking, all backed by distributed data stores and a modern web front end.

What You’ll Do

• Design, build, and maintain Java/Spring Boot microservices that ingest, translate, correlate, and track EDI documents end to end.

• Develop and tune stateful, high-volume stream-processing pipelines (Apache Flink / Kafka) that correlate related documents (PO ↔ ASN ↔ Invoice ↔ FA) and maintain document lifecycles.

• Build full-stack features: REST/GraphQL APIs on the back end and responsive, data-rich screens on the front end (React or Angular / TypeScript).

• Work with a range of data stores at scale — MongoDB (sharded), PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and ArangoDB (graph) — including schema design, indexing strategy, and query performance.

• Deploy and operate services on IBM Cloud with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.

• Implement and troubleshoot EDI translation and mapping (X12 / EDIFACT), partner identifiers, and trading-partner onboarding.

• Investigate and resolve complex production issues — trace data through streaming state, databases, and search indexes; perform root-cause analysis; and deliver durable fixes.

• Own solution design for significant features: weigh trade-offs, document the approach, and drive it through implementation, review, and release.

• Write automated tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards for reliability, performance, and security.

• Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, and partner with product, QA, and support teams to deliver customer-facing value.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of professional software development experience, with deep, recent work in Java (11/17+) and Spring Boot.

• Proven full-stack experience — production front-end work in a modern framework (React or Angular) with TypeScript/JavaScript, alongside back-end services.

• Hands-on experience with EDI standards and document types (X12 and/or EDIFACT — e.g., 850, 810, 856, 855, 997, 214) and EDI translation/mapping concepts.

• Solid experience designing and operating microservices and REST (and/or GraphQL) APIs.

• Strong experience with multiple data stores at scale — MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and ArangoDB (or comparable graph databases) — including performance and indexing considerations.

• Production experience deploying and operating on IBM Cloud (or a comparable cloud) with Kubernetes and Docker.

• Strong debugging and root-cause skills across distributed systems, and comfort operating in production.

• Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD.

• Excellent communication skills and a track record of technical leadership, design ownership, and mentoring.

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Experience with stream processing (Apache Flink, Kafka Streams, or similar) and stateful streaming patterns.

• Deep experience with graph databases (ArangoDB, Neo4j) for correlation/relationship modeling.

• Familiarity with B2B integration protocols (AS2, SFTP, API-based) and trading-partner onboarding.

• Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipeline ownership.

• Background in supply chain, logistics, or B2B/EDI SaaS.

What Makes You a Fit

You’re a seasoned engineer who’s equally comfortable reasoning about distributed state in a streaming pipeline and polishing a customer-facing screen. You like untangling hard production problems, you write code others can build on, and you raise the bar for the team around you.

title: Full Stack Engineer – Payments
description:
Detailed Job Description – Full Stack Engineer – Payments

Experience: 6+ Years

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Payment Systems

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in payment systems, Java/backend development, REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and modern frontend technologies.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working with Wire, ACH, and RTP payment systems, along with a strong understanding of backend processing, concurrency, thread-safe programming, event-driven architectures, and API integrations.

The role involves developing scalable and resilient payment applications across the full technology stack, including backend services, APIs, event-driven components, and frontend applications using Angular, React, or Vue. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, APIC, and spec-driven development is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

1. Payment Systems Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications supporting Wire, ACH, and RTP payment processing.
  • Understand and implement end-to-end payment transaction workflows.
  • Develop solutions for payment initiation, validation, processing, routing, status management, exceptions, and reconciliation.
  • Handle transaction failures, retries, reversals, duplicate transactions, and timeout scenarios.
  • Ensure payment applications are reliable, scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Collaborate with payment-domain SMEs and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

2. Backend Development

  • Design and develop robust backend services using modern programming languages and frameworks.
  • Build scalable backend processing components for high-volume financial transactions.
  • Develop reusable business logic and service components.
  • Implement appropriate error handling, validation, logging, and monitoring.
  • Optimize backend services for performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to enterprise coding standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex production and application issues.

3. API & Microservices Development

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Build scalable and loosely coupled services using microservices architecture.
  • Develop API contracts, request/response models, validation, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Integrate internal and external payment systems through APIs.
  • Work with APIC (API Connect) and related API management/integration capabilities.
  • Implement API security, authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and versioning.
  • Ensure APIs are backward compatible and meet performance requirements.
  • Support API monitoring, troubleshooting, and production operations.

4. Distributed Systems & Concurrency

  • Design and develop highly available distributed applications.
  • Apply strong understanding of distributed systems concepts to payment-processing solutions.
  • Design applications to handle high transaction volumes and concurrent requests.
  • Implement thread-safe and concurrency-aware solutions.
  • Identify and resolve race conditions, deadlocks, synchronization issues, and resource contention.
  • Apply appropriate concurrency patterns and synchronization mechanisms.
  • Design resilient systems capable of handling partial failures and service dependencies.
  • Implement appropriate retry, timeout, circuit breaker, and fallback strategies.
  • Ensure transaction processing maintains consistency and integrity across distributed services.

5. Event-Driven Architecture

  • Design and develop event-driven payment processing solutions.
  • Implement asynchronous communication between microservices and enterprise systems.
  • Work with messaging/event-streaming platforms where applicable.
  • Design reliable event-processing workflows.
  • Handle duplicate events, retries, ordering, idempotency, and failure scenarios.
  • Ensure asynchronous processing meets business and transaction-processing requirements.
  • Contribute to modernization of traditional synchronous applications into event-driven architectures.

6. Frontend Development

  • Develop responsive and user-friendly web applications using modern frontend technologies.
  • Work with one or more of:
  • Angular
  • React
  • Vue.js
  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and backend microservices.
  • Implement reusable UI components and application workflows.
  • Handle client-side validation, error handling, and API integration.
  • Work closely with UX/UI teams and backend engineers.
  • Ensure applications meet performance, security, accessibility, and usability standards.

7. Containerization & Kubernetes

  • Containerize applications using Docker.
  • Deploy and manage microservices in Kubernetes-based environments.
  • Work with Kubernetes concepts including:
  • Pods
  • Deployments
  • Services
  • ConfigMaps
  • Secrets
  • Ingress
  • Scaling
  • Troubleshoot application and container-related issues.
  • Support deployment, configuration, scaling, and monitoring of applications.
  • Work with platform/DevOps teams to improve containerized application delivery.

8. APIC & Enterprise Integrations

  • Develop and maintain integrations using API Connect (APIC).
  • Configure and consume APIs across internal and external systems.
  • Support API gateway and integration requirements.
  • Collaborate with integration teams to troubleshoot API connectivity and transaction issues.
  • Ensure APIs follow enterprise security, governance, and design standards.
  • Support integration between payment systems, microservices, databases, and third-party platforms.

9. Spec-Driven Development

  • Apply spec-driven development practices where applicable.
  • Translate functional and technical specifications into API contracts, implementation tasks, and test scenarios.
  • Work with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and contract-first API development.
  • Ensure API implementations remain aligned with approved specifications.
  • Collaborate with product, architecture, and QA teams to identify gaps between specifications and implementation.
  • Promote reusable API contracts and consistent development standards.

10. Testing & Quality

  • Develop unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests.
  • Validate payment transaction flows across multiple services.
  • Implement automated testing practices to improve regression coverage.
  • Test concurrency, performance, resiliency, and failure scenarios.
  • Validate API contracts and integration points.
  • Participate in code reviews and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot defects across frontend, backend, API, and infrastructure layers.

11. DevOps & Production Support

  • Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on application deployment and production operations.
  • Participate in CI/CD processes and automated deployments.
  • Support application monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Analyze production incidents and perform root cause analysis.
  • Implement improvements to application reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Support release activities, deployment validation, and rollback procedures.

12. Security & Reliability

  • Follow secure coding and secure API development practices.
  • Protect sensitive financial and customer data.
  • Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms.
  • Ensure appropriate access controls and data protection.
  • Design applications for high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Implement resiliency patterns for payment processing.
  • Ensure applications meet enterprise security, compliance, and reliability requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong experience with payment systems, particularly:
  • Wire
  • ACH
  • RTP
  • Strong experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency and thread-safe design.
  • Hands-on experience with backend processing and high-volume transaction systems.
  • Experience with event-driven architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with API Connect (APIC) or equivalent API management platforms.
  • Experience with at least one modern frontend framework:
  • Angular
  • React
  • Vue.js
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with spec-driven/contract-first development.
  • OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Kafka or other event-streaming platforms.
  • Spring Boot/Spring Cloud or equivalent microservices frameworks.
  • SQL and relational databases.
  • NoSQL databases.
  • Redis or distributed caching.
  • CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Harness.
  • Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Observability tools for logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Experience with high-volume financial transaction processing.
  • Knowledge of payment messaging standards and formats.

Payment Domain Knowledge

The candidate should understand the fundamentals of payment transaction processing, including:

Wire Payments

  • Payment initiation and validation.
  • Transaction routing and processing.
  • Status tracking and exception handling.
  • Reversals and transaction failures.

ACH

  • ACH transaction lifecycle.
  • Payment validation and processing.
  • Returns and exceptions.
  • Batch and transaction processing concepts.

RTP

  • Real-time payment processing.
  • Low-latency transaction processing.
  • Real-time validation and response.
  • Timeout, retry, and failure handling.
  • High-availability requirements.

title: Growth Engineer
description:
GROWTH ENGINEER


⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING


To be considered for this role, candidates must meet the following requirements:

• Professional English proficiency. You must be comfortable communicating clearly and confidently in English in a fully remote, international environment.

• A personal portfolio website is required. Your portfolio should showcase real, live web projects you have designed and/or built, with links to the actual work whenever possible. GitHub profiles, Behance/Dribbble profiles, or a list of repositories alone will not be considered a portfolio.

• Hands-on AI-native development experience. This role requires practical experience with Claude Code and AI-native development workflows. Using AI only for basic code generation or autocomplete is not sufficient.

Applications that do not meet the requirements above will not be considered.


ABOUT THE ROLE


FX Replay is looking for a Growth Engineer to join our Growth organization and own the technical execution of our web, acquisition, experimentation, and conversion infrastructure.

This is not a traditional marketing role and not a core product engineering role.

You will operate at the intersection of growth, software engineering, web design, analytics, infrastructure, experimentation, and AI-native development.

You should be capable of taking a growth opportunity from idea to production independently: understanding the business objective, designing the experience, building it, integrating the required systems, instrumenting analytics, deploying it, and measuring the outcome.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN


• Build and evolve FX Replay's marketing and growth web experiences using Astro, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Create high-quality landing pages, acquisition flows, pricing experiences, onboarding surfaces, and conversion experiments.

• Translate ideas and business objectives into polished experiences without requiring constant engineering or design support.

• Integrate APIs, payments, authentication, CRM, CMS, marketing platforms, analytics systems, and third-party services.

• Own advanced web analytics and tracking architecture, including events, attribution, funnels, conversion tracking, experimentation, and data quality.

• Design and execute A/B tests and growth experiments from implementation through measurement.

• Own Core Web Vitals, performance, caching, CDN/edge behavior, rendering strategies, technical SEO, structured data, and accessibility.

• Understand and operate the supporting infrastructure, including DNS, CDN, hosting, CI/CD, observability, security, and production reliability.

• Build and maintain reusable components, design systems, tokens, and patterns for rapid experimentation.


AI-NATIVE GROWTH


AI should be a fundamental part of how you operate.

We expect deep practical experience with:

• Claude Code as a primary environment for building and operating software.

• Creating and orchestrating AI agents for research, development, analytics, testing, and optimization.

• Building reusable Skills, commands, instructions, and agent workflows.

• Connecting agents to external systems through MCP servers.

• Designing workflows where multiple agents can independently research, build, validate, and improve growth initiatives.

• Using AI-native design tools alongside Figma and modern design systems.

• Using agents to investigate analytics, generate experiments, analyze performance, debug production issues, and accelerate iteration.

Using AI to autocomplete code is not enough. We expect you to understand how to design systems of agents that materially increase your execution capacity.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


• 5–8+ years of strong technical experience building production web systems.

• Deep expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, modern browser technologies, HTML, and CSS.

• Strong understanding of APIs, HTTP, networking, caching, CDNs, cloud infrastructure, and web architecture.

• Proven experience with high-performance and high-traffic web experiences.

• Deep experience with GA4, GTM, PostHog/Amplitude, Segment/CDPs, attribution, event instrumentation, and experimentation platforms.

• Strong understanding of conversion optimization, experimentation, funnels, and growth analytics.

• Strong visual and product judgment, including Figma, responsive design, interaction design, typography, hierarchy, and design systems.

• Strong knowledge of technical SEO, performance, accessibility, observability, and security.

• Advanced practical experience with Claude Code, AI agents, Skills, MCPs, and AI-native development workflows.

• Ability to operate independently from growth opportunity → design → implementation → instrumentation → deployment → analysis → iteration.


IDEAL PROFILE


You are a technically exceptional Growth Engineer who can operate across marketing, design, software, data, and infrastructure.

You do not need an engineer to implement your experiments, a designer to solve every interface decision, or an analyst to tell you whether something worked.

You can understand a growth problem, build the complete solution, measure its impact, and continuously improve it.

Your leverage comes not only from your technical depth, but from your ability to combine engineering, growth judgment, design quality, analytics, and AI-native execution.
